jobs.title: (73) Gestionnaire de Zone (H/F)
jobs.description:
Saison d'hiver 2026 /2027
Novembre à Mai

Pendant la saison opérationnelle, le travail implique des heures de travail flexibles en hiver, en particulier lorsque vous êtes sur la route, le jour du transfert et pendant les périodes chargées. Le travail implique également d'être joignable en permanence en cas de besoin. 35 heures par semaine.

Objectifs du poste :
- Être responsable de tous les aspects des opérations dans les stations sous votre responsabilité, en maximisant le service à la clientèle et la satisfaction du personnel.
- Agir en tant que responsable hiérarchique des Directeurs de Station pour atteindre tous les objectifs liés aux performances.
- Être responsable de la formation du nouveau personnel et du coaching du personnel existant.
- Aider le responsable des opérations de la station et l'équipe de soutien aux opérations à peaufiner notre programme de chalets et à proposer des améliorations.
- Être responsable des performances de tout le personnel de la station dans vos stations.
- Maintenir les coûts opérationnels au minimum.

Formation et Mise en place
- Être responsable de la prestation du cours de formation du personnel à l'étranger, y compris les sessions de formation et la logistique, en veillant à ce que tous les aspects du service à l'étranger soient adéquatement couverts.
- Travailler avec le responsable des opérations de la station et l'équipe de soutien aux opérations pour s'assurer que toute la documentation de la station pour les transferts est complétée selon les normes nécessaires. Cela peut nécessiter une participation directe à certains transferts, en particulier les plus délicats.

En Saison
- Être responsable hiérarchique des Directeurs de Station.
- Assumer la responsabilité de tous les aspects de la performance des Directeurs de Station.
- Surveiller, analyser et agir en fonction des résultats GSQ hebdomadaires, des budgets, des commentaires des plaintes et des commentaires du personnel en cours de saison.
- En collaboration avec l'équipe de soutien aux opérations, veiller à ce que toute la documentation de la station soit complétée à temps chaque semaine.
- Travailler avec le responsable des opérations de la station et l'équipe de soutien aux opérations pour promouvoir des programmes d'amélioration des propriétés et s'assurer que les chalets et les logements du personnel sont maintenus dans le meilleur état possible.
- Assurer les fonctions de gestion des centres de transport un samedi, soit à l'aéroport soit au centre de transport, comme l'indique le responsable des opérations de la station.
- Sous la direction du responsable des opérations de la station, veiller à ce que toutes les politiques en matière de ressources humaines et de légalité soient suivies dans vos stations.
- Travailler avec le responsable des opérations de la station pour proposer des idées et des suggestions visant à améliorer les niveaux de service des chalets en examinant les détails de nos propriétés actuelles et de nos politiques de service.

Fermeture
- Planifier et assister activement vos équipes de la station lors des transferts.
- Superviser les procédures de fermeture en veillant à ce que les opérations soient efficacement clôturées à la fin de chaque saison et que tout soit correctement comptabilisé et remis à l'équipe à l'étranger ou stocké dans les emplacements de la station ou de stockage appropriés.
Général / Autre
- Exécuter toutes autres tâches qui pourraient être raisonnablement requises de temps à autre.

SPÉCIFICATIONS DE LA PERSONNE :
Expérience antérieure en tant que Directeur de Station ou Gestionnaire de Zone
Expérience de travail pour un voyagiste de ski à l'étranger
Expérience antérieure prouvée de gestion réussie du personnel / motivation
Expérience avérée de vente, démontrant la capacité à atteindre et à dépasser les objectifs de vente

jobs.title: Operatiivinen päällikkö, Relove Airport, Helsinki-Vantaa
jobs.description:
Relove on kotimainen perheyritys, second hand -alan pioneeri ja rakastettu lifestyle-brändi, joka yhdistää laadukkaan second hand -myymälän ja tunnelmallisen kahvilan saman katon alle. Reloven maailmassa vastuullisuus, yhteisöllisyys ja ensiluokkainen asiakaskokemus kulkevat käsi kädessä. Liikkeissämme asiakkaat voivat tehdä upeita löytöjä, nauttia herkullisesta ruoasta ja kahvista sekä viettää aikaa inspiroivassa ympäristössä. Etsimme nyt Helsinki-Vantaan lentoasemalla sijaitsevaan Relove Airportiin operatiivista päällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Operatiivisena päällikkönä pääset johtamaan yhtä Reloven näkyvimmistä ja vauhdikkaimmista toimipisteistä. Relove Airport on ainutlaatuinen yhdistelmä second hand -myymälää ja kahvilaa kansainvälisessä ympäristössä, jossa jokainen päivä on hieman erilainen. Johdettavanasi on noin 30 hengen tiimi ja toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä muun organisaation, HR:n sekä yrityksen johdon kanssa. Pääset vaikuttamaan liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen, rakentamaan menestyvää tiimiä sekä varmistamaan, että asiakkaamme saavat ikimuistoisen Relove-kokemuksen jokaisella vierailullaan.

Operatiivisena päällikkönä vastaat koko Airport-yksikön päivittäisestä johtamisesta, liiketoiminnan tuloksesta sekä kahvila- ja second hand -liiketoimintojen kokonaisuudesta. Erityisenä painopistealueena työssäsi on vastuu henkilöstöjohtamisen kokonaisuudesta rekrytoinneista perehdytykseen, työvuorosuunnitteluun, osaamisen kehittämiseen sekä työhyvinvoinnin ja työkyvyn johtamiseen. Tuet kahvilapäällikköä ja myymäläpäällikköä heidän esihenkilötyössään, seuraat aktiivisesti myyntiä ja kannattavuutta sekä huolehdit siitä, että tavoitteet saavutetaan arjen muuttuvissa tilanteissa hallitusti, tehokkaasti ja laadukkaasti. Olet vahvasti mukana yksikön arjessa ja läsnä työvuoroissa, työskentelet lähellä tiimiäsi sekä rakennat omalla toiminnallasi positiivista työilmapiiriä ja avoimuuden kulttuuria, jossa ihmiset viihtyvät ja kehittyvät. Johdat vierestä - napakasti, mutta rennolla otteella - ja näytät omalla esimerkilläsi, mitä hyvä johtaminen ja asiakaspalvelu tarkoittavat käytännössä.

Tarjoamme sinulle

- Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn uniikissa ja kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä
- Vaihtelevat työajat yksikön aukioloaikojen mukaan; työskentelet pääsääntöisesti arkipäivisin, mutta edellytämme valmiutta osallistua kaikkiin vuoroihin ma-su varhaisesta aamusta myöhäiseen iltaan
- Kiinteän kuukausipalkan aiempi osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi huomioiden 3500-4700 €/kk välillä, sisältäen lisät
- Mahdollisuuden johtaa ainutlaatuista second hand- ja kahvilakonseptia sekä vaikuttaa yksikön toimintaan, kehittämiseen ja tulokseen
- Itsenäisen ja vastuullisen roolin, jossa saat vapautta tehdä päätöksiä ja kehittää toimintaa omalla kädenjäljelläsi
- Lämminhenkisen työyhteisön ja Reloven arvoihin perustuvan ihmisläheisen yrityskulttuurin sekä tiiviin yhteistyön yrityksen johdon sekä HR:n kanssa
- Hyvät työsuhde-edut (mm. työterveyshuolto, ePassi flex, jopa -50% alennus Relovessa ja -20% Rue Madamessa ruoka- ja juomatuotteista itselle ja pöytäseurueelle)

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Airport on toimintaympäristönä vauhdikas ja vaativa. Pitkät aukioloajat, suuri henkilöstömäärä ja nopeat muutokset edellyttävät operatiiviselta päälliköltä kykyä johtaa määrätietoisesti myös haastavissa tilanteissa.

Osaaminen ja kokemus

- Useamman vuoden kokemus ravintola-alan operatiivisesta johtamisesta
- Monipuolinen ja kattava kokemus henkilöstöjohtamisen kokonaisuudesta
- Osaamista ja halua ihmisläheiseen henkilöstöjohtamiseen; olet tottunut johtamaan suuria tiimejä sekä rakentamaan toimivaa ja tavoitteellista työyhteisöä
- Ymmärrät liiketoiminnan tunnuslukuja ja osaat johtaa toimintaa myynti-, kannattavuus- ja henkilöstötavoitteiden kautta
- Reagoit nopeasti muutoksiin ja pystyt tekemään itsenäisiä päätöksiä oikea-aikaisesti ja johdonmukaisesti

Persoona, joka menestyy tässä roolissa

- Olet energinen, innostava ja läsnä oleva johtaja ja haluat osallistua arjen tekemiseen yhdessä tiimisi kanssa
- Nautit vauhdikkaasta arjesta, osaat priorisoida ja pidät suunnan kirkkaana myös kiireen keskellä
- Johdat esimerkilläsi määrätietoisesti, oikeudenmukaisesti ja aidosti välittäen
- Rakennat ympärillesi luottamusta, avointa vuorovaikutusta ja hyvää työilmapiiriä
- Sinulla on vahvat organisointi- ja yhteistyötaidot sekä kyky innostaa ihmisiä yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamiseen
- Arvostat ihmisläheistä yrityskulttuuria ja haluat rakentaa työyhteisöä, jossa ihmiset voivat hyvin, kehittyvät ja sitoutuvat yhteisiin tavoitteisiin

Tehtävä edellyttää täysi-ikäisyyttä sekä hygienia- ja anniskelupassia. Kansainvälisen asiakaskunnan ja työyhteisön vuoksi on tärkeää, että kommunikoit sujuvasti englanniksi ja hyvin myös suomeksi. Terveydentilan selvitys salmonellatartunnasta on esitettävä ennen töiden aloitusta.

Me Relovessa uskomme siihen, että parhaat asiakaskohtaamiset syntyvät hyvinvoivista tiimeistä. Operatiivisena päällikkönä pääset rakentamaan ympärillesi työyhteisön, jossa ihmiset voivat onnistua, kehittyä ja innostua yhdessä. Kuulostaako hyvältä, kiinnostuitko? Jos sytyt ihmisten johtamisesta, nautit tavoitteellisesta tekemisestä ja haluat olla rakentamassa Reloven menestystarinaa, haluamme kuulla sinusta. Lähetä siis hakemuksesi meille! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Rekrytoinnista vastaa yhteistyökumppanimme Barona, valittu henkilö solmii työsopimuksen Reloven kanssa.

Lentoaseman henkilökorttiprosessin takia varmistamme hakijan taustat (henkilöllisyyden, työ- ja opiskeluhistorian sekä työtodistukset) jo hakuprosessin aikana. Tehtävään valitulle henkilölle tehdään lisäksi Finavian henkilökorttiprosessin aikana turvallisuusselvitys Suojelupoliisin toimesta. Työsuhde alkaa aikaisintaan, kun henkilö on läpäissyt turvallisuusselvityksen.

**********************

Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia. Hakeaksesi avoimia työpaikkoja, sinun tulee luoda työnhakuprofiili Barona Careersiin. Täytät profiilisi vain kerran, minkä jälkeen voit hakea kaikkia Baronan työpaikkoja samalla profiililla.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. jobs.title: Site Director Stenungsund

jobs.title: Socialsekreterare till Vuxen, Socialförvaltningen i Perstorps kommun
jobs.description:
Vi söker dig som vill vara en del av vår resa mot en bättre vardag, starkare framtid och ökad livskvalitet för invånarna i Perstorp. Hos oss får du en arbetsplats där arbetsglädje, engagemang och utveckling är en självklar del av vardagen. Vi tror på att tänka nytt, arbeta smart och hela tiden bli lite bättre tillsammans.

Perstorps kommun ligger i hjärtat av norra Skåne, mitt i den dynamiska Öresundsregionen – ett av Sveriges mest expansiva områden. Här kombineras småstadens närhet och trygghet med närhet till både naturupplevelser och större städer. Kommunen har cirka 7 300 invånare och omkring 560 medarbetare som tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.

Vi är stolta över vårt starka näringsliv och vårt fokus på folkhälsa, hållbarhet och livskvalitet. Här finns goda möjligheter att påverka, utvecklas och göra skillnad varje dag.

Beskrivning

Perstorps kommun ligger i hjärtat av norra Skåne med goda tågförbindelser till närliggande orter såsom Helsingborg och Hässleholm

Är du en driven och engagerad socionom? Perstorps kommun satsar på Individ- och familjeomsorgen och söker nu fem socialsekreterare till olika roller inom Socialförvaltningen.

Myndighet består av drygt 20 medarbetare och ansvarar för socialtjänstens myndighetsutövning i Perstorps kommun.

Arbetet är varierat, självständigt och socialt med många samarbetspartners. Arbetet med målgrupperna innebär ofta oförutsedda händelser och ställer krav på att du kan ställa om och anpassa ditt arbete efter rådande omständigheter. Arbetet med målgrupperna ställer även krav på god kommunikativ förmåga.

Vi söker nu två socialsekreterare till vuxen.

Arbetsuppgifter socialsekreterare Vuxen inom individ- och familjeomsorgen

Vuxengruppens arbetar med frågor rörande:

    Skadligt bruk och beroende
    Socialpsykiatri
    Våld i Nära Relation (VINR).

Dina arbetsuppgifter består bland annat av att genomföra utredningar enligt Socialtjänstlagen (SoL) och LVM samt uppföljning av beviljade insatser. Arbetet innefattar även planering och deltagande i möten, vårdplaneringar och uppföljningar. Du arbetar nära kollegor inom förvaltningen, kollegor inom övriga förvaltningar, familjer och externa samarbetspartners för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för individen att erhålla det stöd individen är i behov av.

Du ska bidra till att arbetet inom Vuxen bedrivs rättssäkert och kvalitativt.

Kvalifikationer

    Socionomexamen på 210 högskolepoäng.
    B-körkort

Meriterande

    Erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänsten.
    För tjänsten som socialsekreterare till vuxen är det meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med ASI och Freda.
    Erfarenhet av verksamhetssystemet LifeCare

Personliga egenskaper

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och för att trivas i rollen ser vi att du är:

    Trygg, empatisk och lyhörd i mötet med människor
    Professionell och lösningsfokuserad, även i pressade situationer
    Engagerad i ditt arbete och intresserad av metod- och verksamhetsutveckling
    God förmåga att planera och strukturera ditt arbete

Vad vi erbjuder

    Engagerade kollegor och nära samarbete mellan verksamheterna
    Stöd av erfarna chefer och möjlighet till extern handledning
    En arbetsplats med en god teamkänsla
    Friskvård via Epassi
    Möjlighet till distansarbete

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Assistant

The opportunity

Do you thrive in a role where structure, service, and coordination help teams perform at their best? Are you someone who enjoys supporting others, keeping track of many moving parts, and ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes? Then this could be your next opportunity.

We are now looking for an experienced and proactive Assistant to support the Service organization within Power Quality in Västerås. While belonging to the Service function, the role also provides administrative and coordination support to several smaller teams and functions across the organization.

In this role, you will act as a trusted point of contact for managers, employees, consultants, and external stakeholders, playing a key role in enabling efficient daily operations. A significant part of the assignment is to provide close support to the Service Manager, including calendar management, travel and expense administration, meeting and workshop coordination, and various executive support activities in both a local and global context.

You will be involved in a wide range of administrative and coordination activities, acting as a central link between people, processes, and systems. The role requires a high degree of structure, professionalism, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining excellent service and confidentiality.

We offer you a varied and responsible role in a collaborative environment, with close interaction across the organization and great opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with—so don't hesitate to apply even if you don't meet all requirements.

Your responsibilities

    Provide dedicated support to the Service Manager, including calendar management, travel and expense administration, meeting/workshop planning, and coordination activities in both local and global environments
    Coordinate meetings, workshops, events, business travel, and related logistics while supporting efficient planning and execution
    Support several smaller functions and departments with administrative and operational coordination, while being organizationally part of the Service team
    Manage onboarding and offboarding activities, including system access, equipment, permissions, and introductions to internal processes
    Administer access, permits, and training systems such as access cards, SSG, ID06, and parking solutions
    Handle purchasing and financial administration, including purchase orders, invoices, Ariba, VIM, and Concur-related support
    Maintain departmental administration, including distribution lists, organization charts, internal communication channels, and documentation
    Act as a key contact for workplace coordination, facility-related matters, PPE/workwear administration, and continuous improvement of administrative processes

Your background

    Experience in an administrative, assistant, executive assistant, or coordination role
    Demonstrated ability to support managers, teams, and stakeholders in a structured and service-oriented manner
    Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
    High level of integrity, professionalism, and discretion when handling confidential information
    Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, especially Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams
    Experience working with systems such as Concur, Ariba, ServiceNow, VIM, or similar is considered an advantage
    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
    Experience from an international, project-driven, or matrix organization is considered an advantage

jobs.title: Area Tech Manager - Finance
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

Following the evolvement of our shared operating model, two new roles have been introduced that will lead the work in our Areas together – Area Tech Manager and Area Business Manager. We believe that the dual leadership helps establish clear ownership of responsibilities and supports balanced decision-making across areas such as customer value, technical feasibility, and overall cost. We want to establish clear tech accountability for engineering execution, delivery quality, and operational excellence – ensuring end‑to‑end responsibility for technology delivery. We also want to create clear business accountability for driving key outcomes, ensuring value realization – ensuring high focus on customer and business value.

We are now looking for an Area Tech Manager Finance in Corporate.

The Area Tech Manager is a senior tech leader accountable for end-to-end delivery and execution within a tech area covering related products and services aligned to key business capabilities.

The role ensures efficient, secure, and scalable delivery in line with strategic objectives, while maintaining strong operational performance. You will oversee multiple teams and be accountable for building and developing high-performing tech talent within the area.

By enabling effective day-to-day operations, the Area Tech Manager drives delivery, addresses technical debt, and supports the development of scalable, forward-looking solutions. The role contributes to the broader Tech Center portfolio and plays a key part in delivering business outcomes through aligned and integrated technology initiatives, while fostering an inclusive and high-performing engineering culture.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Domain Specific Responsibilities

    Leading the delivery of finance technology solutions across financial accounting, tax management, treasury and financial controlling, ensuring end‑to‑end operability and seamless integration with core business and enterprise processes.
    Ensuring robust, scalable and enterprise finance platforms, through close cross‑area collaboration, built on SAP as ERP and a variety of bought and in‑house developed solutions, enabling compliant, accurate and efficient financial processes.
    Driving architectural coherence and continuous modernization across the finance technology landscape, securing resilient system flows, high data quality and strong alignment with enterprise platforms, integration patterns and data foundations.

Strategic & Delivery Leadership

    Translate tech strategy and business objectives into actionable plans and take overall accountability for RUN/Tech Operations within the area
    Oversee the delivery structure across products, services, and programs to ensure stable, scalable, and cost‑efficient tech solutions
    Manage dependencies, resources, and capacity to enable effective roadmap execution and support business outcomes
    Drive adoption of secure, robust, and scalable technologies and promote continuous improvement across the area
    Partner with Area Business Manager/business counterparts to align priorities and synchronize delivery
    Contribute to portfolio planning to ensure strategic alignment with enterprise architecture and tech strategy

Financial Accountability

    Own and manage the area’s tech budget, ensuring efficient, transparent allocation and spend
    Maintain budget planning and implementation in alignment with workforce plans
    Optimize resource utilization while upholding strong financial accountability

Architecture & Development

    Ensure solution architecture aligns with target architecture and collaborate with the CTO Office on strategic direction
    Promote effective use of tools, methodologies, and engineering standards, technical quality, operational resilience, and modern engineering practices

Operational Excellence

    Oversee operational stability and performance, ensuring secure and resilient operations aligned with strategic goals
    Monitor and report technical KPIs (e.g., uptime, compliance, support)
    Lead proactive risk management, including incident handling and mitigation planning
    Drive innovation, simplification, and reduction of technical debt.
    Engage internal teams and external partners to support aligned and timely delivery

People & Culture

    Lead and develop engineering talent, coaching leaders and enabling technical and delivery excellence
    Cultivate a culture of innovation, collaboration, and psychological safety
    Hold formal staff responsibility, including recruitment, contribution talks, and workforce planning aligned with broader tech strategy and capability needs

Stakeholder Engagement

    Work closely with business stakeholders to coordinate cross‑area dependencies and secure delivery of business outcomes
    Act as the primary technology contact within the area and manage relevant vendor and partner relationships

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for someone who brings:

    Experience delivering technology solutions within Finance, covering business areas such as financial accounting, tax management, treasury management, and financial controlling.
    Strong understanding of end‑to‑end finance processes and workflows, where technology enables compliance, accuracy, timely reporting, and efficient business value delivery.
    Strong experience with enterprise finance platforms (e.g. SAP suite, Anaplan) and how these integrate with a broader ecosystem of SaaS solutions, in‑house built applications, and data platforms, with a continuous focus on modernization, integration, and high data quality.
    Deep expertise in software engineering, technology execution and architecture principles
    Proven experience in technology leadership, preferably across multiple products/services in a complex environment requiring collaboration with multiple business stakeholders
    Demonstrated success in leading cross-functional tech teams and delivering tech solutions at scale
    Experience in agile methodologies, DevOps, and continuous improvement
    Financial acumen and experience managing budgets and resource allocation

This is a full-time position with the possibility to be based in one of our Tech locations, Stockholm or Bangalore.

We recommend applying as soon as possible, but no later than 15th of August, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Direktoriaus pavaduotojas (-a) ūkio reikalams
jobs.description:
Vadovauti tiesiogiai pavaldiems darbuotojams, teikti jiems pagalbą, prižiūrėti jų darbą ir atsakyti už jų darbo rezultatus.
Organizuoti ūkinę veiklą, priešgaisrinę saugą, civilinę saugą,  darbo saugą, nelaimingų atsitikimų tyrimą, darbuotojų saugos ir sveikatos priežiūrą lopšelyje – darželyje bei tvarkyti reikiamus dokumentus.
Vykdyti lopšelio-darželio teritorijos, pastatų ir patalpų, baldų, inventoriaus priežiūrą, pildyti atitinkamus dokumentus, organizuoti patalpų remonto darbus ir inventoriaus remontą.
Tikrinti apšvietimo, šildymo, vėdinimo, kanalizacijos, vandentiekio ir kitų lopšelyje – darželyje esančių sistemų būklę, organizuoti gedimų šalinimą bei užtikrinti jų normalų veikimą.
Rūpintis lopšelio–darželio ilgalaikio turto, atsargų įsigijimu, jų apskaita, aprūpinti būtinais materialiniais resursais (baldais, inventoriumi, kompiuteriais, kanceliarijos, švaros priemonėmis ir kt.)
Vykdyti ilgalaikio turto, atsargų (ūkio inventoriaus) apskaitą, sudaryti jų inventorizacijos aprašus – sutikrinimo žiniaraščius.
Organizuoti viešuosius pirkimus pagal lopšelyje-darželyje nustatytą tvarką, tvarkyti viešųjų pirkimų dokumentus ir (ar) dalyvauti viešųjų pirkimų komisijoje.
Dalyvauti vykdant finansavimo apskaitą, rengiant finansines ataskaitas bei pateikti reikalingą informaciją finansinėms ataskaitoms parengti.
Dalyvauti strateginio plano, metinio veiklos plano rengime ir įgyvendinime.
Rengti ir dalyvauti rengiant, įgyvendinant metines turto programas, lopšelio-darželio pastatų einamojo remonto planus, sąmatas ir kt.
Atsižvelgiant į higienos normų reikalavimus, užtikrinti saugias lopšelio-darželio darbuotojų darbo sąlygas.
Rengti įsakymų projektus susijusius su ūkio reikalais, viešaisiais pirkimais.
Vykdyti kitus, su įstaigos veiklos tikslais, funkcijomis ir savo tiesioginiu darbu susijusius, įstaigos direktoriaus teisėtus pavedimus ir užduotis.

jobs.title: Lärare åk 4-6 till Kroppkärrsskolan
jobs.description:
Beskrivning

Vi på Kroppkärrsskolan söker en passionerad och engagerad lärare för årskurs 4-6 som vill vara med och forma framtiden för våra elever. I rollen som lärare får du möjlighet att odla en inspirerande och inkluderande lärmiljö där varje elev känner sig sedd och hörd. Vi värdesätter pedagogisk insikt och förståelse, och vi tror att en trygg relation mellan lärare och elev är nyckeln till framgång.

Som en del av vårt team förväntar vi oss att du är:

    Stabil och uthållig, med förmåga att motivera och stötta elever genom deras lärande.
    Relationsskapande, med en stark vilja att bygga positiva och meningsfulla relationer med både elever och kollegor.
    Tydlig i din kommunikation och pedagogik, så att alla elever kan förstå och ta del av undervisningen.

Om du är redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär och göra skillnad i elevers liv, är detta din chans! Tillsammans med oss på Kroppkärrsskolan kommer du att spela en avgörande roll i att inspirera nästa generation. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Arbetsuppgifter

Som lärare för åk 4-6 på Kroppkärrsskolan kommer du att spela en central roll i våra elevers lärande och utveckling. Du får möjligheten att skapa engagerande och stimulerande undervisningsmiljöer där varje elev kan blomstra. Ditt arbete innebär att:

    Planera och genomföra undervisning i enlighet med läroplanens mål och riktlinjer.
    Som en stabil och uthållig ledare bygga starka relationer med eleverna, vilket skapar en trygg och positiv lärandemiljö.
    Adaptivt och pedagogiskt erbjuda stöd och utmaningar som passar varje elevs unika behov och förutsättningar.
    Uppmuntra samarbete och gemenskap mellan eleverna för att stärka deras sociala färdigheter.
    Bedöma och följa upp elevers utveckling, ge konstruktiv feedback och anpassa undervisningen efter behov.
    Delta aktivt i skolans utvecklingsarbete och samarbeta med kollegor för att ständigt förbättra utbildningen.

Vi söker dig som brinner för att inspirera och motivera elever och som har förmågan att tydligt kommunicera och förmedla kunskap på ett engagerande sätt. Tillsammans formar vi framtiden och gör Kroppkärrsskolan till en plats där varje elev känner sig sedd och hörd!

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har lärarlegitimation och som är en stabil och uthållig lärare med en passion för att skapa relationer och engagera elever i åk 4-6! Du har en gedigen pedagogisk insikt som gör att du kan anpassa undervisningen efter varje elevs behov och lärstil. Vi värdesätter att du är tydlig i din kommunikation och kan skapa en trygg lärmiljö där eleverna känner sig sedda och hörda. I din roll kommer du att:

    Bygga starka relationer med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare
    Planera och genomföra inspirerande lektioner som väcker nyfikenhet och lust att lära
    Arbeta aktivt med individuella utvecklingsplaner för att stödja varje elevs lärande
    Uppmuntra samarbete och social utveckling i klassrummet

Ditt engagemang och din förmåga att skapa en positiv lärandemiljö kommer att bidra starkt till vårt team på Kroppkärrsskolan. Tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vår dynamiska skola där varje elevs framgång står i fokus!

Tjänsten är en tidsbegränsad anställning under läsåret 2026/2027.

Tjänsten tillsätts om erforderliga beslut fattas.

Vi erbjuder

Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba i Karlstads kommun på karlstad.se/jobbahososs

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Information om lönenivåer hittar du här (välj "Se lönestatistik"). Den här rekryteringen rör AID-kod [401010].

När du söker jobb hos oss kommer du att få ange ditt CV samt svara på ett antal frågor där vi ber dig beskriva din kompetens inom efterfrågat område. Det innebär att du inte ska bifoga ett personligt brev som en del av din ansökan.

Om Karlstads kommun

Barn- och ungdomsförvaltningen ansvarar för förskola och skola för cirka 13 200 barn och elever och är kommunens största förvaltning med drygt 2 400 medarbetare. Vi har förskolor, familjedaghem, öppna förskolor, förskoleklasser, grundskolor, anpassad grundskola, fritidshem och kulturskola och arbetar även med barn- och elevhälsofrågor. Vi rustar barnen för framtiden.

Vill du vara med och skapa framtidens Karlstad? Hos oss i koncernen Karlstads kommun kan du göra skillnad på riktigt. Här är varje medarbetare en viktig del i helheten och tillsammans hjälps vi åt att förverkliga vår vision om "Ett bättre liv i Solstaden". Kom och väx med oss!

Övrig information

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen och förenkla kommunikationen med våra sökande ber vi dig skicka in din ansökan via våra rekryteringssystemoch inte via e-post eller pappersformat. Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte registrera dina ansökningshandlingar i vårt rekryteringssystem och inte heller skicka in dem via e-post. Vänd dig istället till kommunens växel 054-540 00 00 för vidare hantering.

Työnantaja käy lapsensa kanssa uimahallissa ja avustajan apua tarvitaan siellä. Perheessä on koira, avustajan tehtäviin voi joskus kuulua koiran ulkoiluttamista.

Työnantaja toivoo naisavustajaa työn luonteen vuoksi. Työnantajan toiveena on, että hakija kertoo hakemuksessa itsestään, harrastuksistaan, tuleeko toimeen eläinten kanssa ja millainen työkokemus hakijalla on. Edeltävä työkokemus avustajan työstä ei ole välttämätön.

Palkkaus: Heta TES A 13,23 €/h + mahdolliset kokemuslisät

Työsuhteet ovat aina yksityisiä. Työsuhteeseen valittu henkilö on työsuhteessa avustettavaan.

Haastatteluun / työsuhteeseen valitulle tieto ilmoitetaan henkilökohtaisesti.

Työ alkaa sopivan avustajan löydyttyä.

Työnantajalla on oikeus pyytää iäkkäiden ja vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työhön valitulta työntekijältä rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi kerran työsuhteen alkaessa (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

Rikosrekisteriote on salassa pidettävää tietoa ja sitä ei tule lähettää hakemuksen yhteydessä.

Hae työpaikkaa lähettämällä hakemuksesi suoraan työnantajalle katariina.kuusela1@gmail.com.

jobs.title: Huollon työnjohtaja
jobs.description:
Haemme tiimimme uutta vahvistusta johtamaan ja kehittämään Suomen Pelastusarmeijan Säätiön kiinteistöjen ja osakehuoneistojen huolto- ja kunnossapitotoimintaa.

**Toimenkuva**

Huollon työnjohtajana vastaat huoltotoimintojen suunnittelusta, organisoinnista ja päivittäisestä johtamisesta. Johdat huoltotiimiä, varmistat töiden tehokkaan toteutuksen ja huolehdit kiinteistöjen, asuntojen sekä teknisten järjestelmien toimintakunnosta. Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, yhteistyökumppaneiden ja oman organisaation henkilöstön kanssa, etkä pelkää tarttua tarvittaessa ruuvimeisseliin itse. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- Huolto- ja kunnossapitotöiden suunnittelu, koordinointi ja aikataulutus

- Huoltohenkilöstön työnjohto, ohjaus ja perehdyttäminen

- Kiinteistöjen ja asuntojen huolto- sekä korjaustoiminnan seuranta

- Työn laadun, turvallisuuden ja tehokkuuden varmistaminen

- Asiakas- ja sidosryhmäyhteistyö

- Budjetointiin ja kustannusten hallintaan osallistuminen

- Huoltoprosessien ja toimintatapojen kehittäminen


Kyseessä on vakituinen, kokoaikainen päivätyö arvostetussa organisaatiossa. Toimistosi sijaitsee Helsingin Kalliossa Castreninkadulla, mutta työ edellyttää liikkumista pääkaupunkiseudulla.

**Hakemamme henkilö**

Olet käytännönläheinen esihenkilö, jolla on kyky johtaa tiimiä, organisoida useita samanaikaisia työtehtäviä sekä varmistaa laadukas lopputulos. Sinulla on teknistä ymmärrystä kiinteistöjen ylläpidosta, huollosta ja kunnossapidosta sekä halua kehittää toimintaa yhdessä tiimisi kanssa.

**Tehtävässä onnistumiseen tarvitaan:**

- Erinomainen suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen kielen taito

- B-ajokortti

- Kokemusta työnjohdosta tai vastuullisista huollon, kunnossapidon tai kiinteistöalan tehtävistä

- Oma-aloitteisuutta, paineensietokykyä ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

- Hyvät johtamis-, organisointi- ja priorisointitaidot

- Reipas ja positiivinen asiakaspalveluasenne

- Perus IT-taidot (sähköposti, Teams ja O365)


**Arvostamme suuresti ja katsomme eduksi, mikäli sinulla on:**

- Huolto- ja kunnossapitoprosessien tuntemusta ja yleistä teknistä osaamista kiinteistöjen ylläpidosta

- Vianetsintä- ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä

- Erinomaiset tiimi- viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaidot

- Maalaisjärkeä ja huumorintajua

- Kiinteistöalan koulutuksen tai muun soveltuvan teknisen koulutuksen

- Kokemuksen rakennusalasta, remonteista ja huoltoyhtiötoiminnasta

- Tuntemusta kiinteistöjen ylläpitotoiminnasta ja sopimushallinnasta

- Kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä

- Lisäksi englannin ja/tai ruotsin osaamisesta saa papukaijamerkin


**Tarjoamme sinulle**

Mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä työtä historiallisessa, humaanissa organisaatiossa ja nähdä konkreettisesti työsi tulokset. Mukavien työkavereiden ja kannustavan työilmapiirin lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle työterveyshuollon, muutamia henkilöstöetuja sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun (ePassi). Panostamme työntekijöidemme osaamiseen, työhyvinvointiin ja hyvään vuorovaikutukseen sekä johtamiseen.

Tehtävästä maksettava palkka määräytyy Kiinteistöalan toimihenkilöistä koskevan TESin mukaisesti.

Toivomme, että pääset aloittamaan työt jo elokuussa 2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Käymme läpi hakemuksia ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana, joten toimi siis nopeasti! Tehtävä voidaan täyttää heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä jo ennen varsinaisen hakuajan päättymistä. Työsuhteessa noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa. Tervetuloa meille sellaisena kuin olet!

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat kiinteistöpäälliköltämme Petra Lamminkarilta: +358 40 761 8499 toimistoaikoina (klo 08-17) tai petra.lamminkari@pelastusarmeija.fi

jobs.title: Head Chef

jobs.title: Application Specialist, Electrical
jobs.description:
Cadmatic is a leading global developer of digital and intelligent 3D-based design, engineering, and information management solutions for the marine, process, and construction industries. Our journey started in the 1980s. Over the past decade, we have grown by 20 percent annually, and it's all about talent. Over 6000 customers are using our software solutions in 60 countries. In the marine industry, our technology supports around 40 percent of the worlds shipyards. We continue strong growth.

We are looking for an Application Specialist, Electrical to join our global Customer Success team. In this role, you work closely with global customers, helping them succeed with Cadmatic Electrical through support, training, and hands-on collaboration. You report directly to the Technical Manager and play an important role in connecting customer needs with product development and sales.

You can work in Finland, Italy, or Estonia either remotely or with a hybrid model from one of our offices.

In short, your job includes:

- Providing customer support globally and helping users succeed with Cadmatic Electrical in their daily work
- Delivering customer training and supporting software implementation projects

We wish you to bring:

Cadmatic as an employer:

Join our growth journey!
Delight us with your application by 16 August. If you have any questions, feel free to contact our hiring manager, Technical Manager Vesa Moilanen, via email vesa.moilanen@cadmatic.com. Please note that we only accept applications submitted to our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

The salary range for this role: Annual base salary of 26 000 € – 49 000 € plus a variable bonus, with on-target earnings (OTE) of 31 600 € – 56 100 €. Please note that this salary range represents the minimum and maximum compensation for this position in all the possible working countries, and the final offer may vary within the range depending on the work experience, location, and the level of expertise.

We believe in diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are committed to building a company culture where we cherish diversity and promote equity, and where everyone feels valued and respected. jobs.title: Vil du arbeide med barn?
jobs.description:
Vi har ledig 100% fast stilling fra 01.09.26

I Hadsel bygger vi laget rundt barnet. Hadsel skal være oppvekstkommunen som folk ønsker å bosette seg i. Her er det godt å bo og her er det godt å leve. Våre barn og unge skal være rustet for fremtiden, og de skal mestre livene sine. En god oppvekst varer livet ut – og vi ønsker å gi våre barn sterke røtter og vinger. 

Vi søker deg som er nysgjerrig sammen med barn og som stimulerer til barns medvirkende, undring, lek og læring. Vi søker barnehagelærere som ønsker å støtte barn si lærelyst, og kan bidra til et godt grunnlag for livslang læring i nært samarbeid med foreldre. 
Vi jobber med å ivareta og videreutvikle gode utviklings- og læringsmiljø, som sikrer barna en god psykisk og fysisk helse. 

Flere av barnehagene i kommunen er praksisbarnehager, de som blir tilbydd jobb må være forberedt på å ta imot studenter og være veileder for disse.

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  •       Være en del av barnehagens lederteam
  •       Ansvar for å planlegge, iverksette og lede det pedagogisk arbeidet
  •       Sørge for at rammeplanen og barnehageloven oppfylles i tråd med godt faglig skjønn
  •       Sørg for at interne og kommunale rutiner implementeres
  •       Bidra til barnas helhetlige utvikling gjennom trivsel, lek og vennskap

 

Krav til kompetanse

  • Førskolelærer/barnehagelærer, jf. barnehageloven § 18 med forskrift.
  • Likeverdig med barnehagelærerutdanning er annen treårig pedagogisk utdanning på høgskolenivå med videreutdanning i barnehagepedagogikk (60 studiepoeng).


Personlige egenskaper

  • Like å jobbe med barn - engasjert og fleksibel
  • God relasjons kompetanse
  • Tilstedeværende voksen med blikk for barn
  • Gode og tydelige lederegenskaper
  • Evne og vilje til samarbeid for et godt faglig og utviklende miljø
  • Faglig engasjert
  • Vi ønsker mangfold og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uansett alder, kjønn, etnisitet og funksjonsnivå.

Vi tilbyr

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • Utviklende og spennende stilling der få dager er like
  • Et godt fagmiljø
  • Etterutdanning etter avtale
  • Flyttegodtgjørelse etter kommunens reglement

I denne stillingen har du rett på en av Norges sikreste pensjonsordninger: offentlig tjenestepensjon. Der de fleste tjenestepensjoner kun utbetales i 10 år, er offentlig tjenestepensjon en utbetaling som varer fra den dagen du slutter å jobbe og livet ut. Pensjonen inkluderer også uføre- og etterlattepensjon hvis noe uventet skulle skje. Med pensjonsrett i KLP får du medlemspris og gunstige betingelser på en rekke bank, forsikring og spareprodukter.

Les mer her: https://www.klp.no/pensjon/offentlig-tjenestepensjon-kort-fortalt

Hadsel kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile kommunens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder,funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 
Hadsel kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.

Regjeringen har vedtatt nedskriving av studielån med kr 25.000,- pr. år innføres for enkelte kommuner i Norge. Hadsel kommune er omfattet av dette, under forutsetning av at en bor i kommunen.

Les mer mer: https://www.regjeringen.no/no/aktuelt/ny-ordning-for-sletting-av-utdanningsgjeld-slik-vil-det-fungere/id3058902/

Språkkunnskaper
Norsk er arbeidsspråk i Hadsel kommune og som søker må du kunne snakke, lese og skrive så godt norsk at du både kan samarbeide med andre og utføre arbeidsoppgavene dine selvstendig. 


Intervju 
Intervjuer vil bli gjennomført enten digitalt eller fysisk, etter nærmere avtale. Ved intervju må du legge fram vitnemål og attester


Ansettelse

  • Tilsetting i henhold til gjeldende lover, reglement og avtaleverk
  • Lønn i henhold til utdanning og praksis
  • Politiattest uten bemerkning jf. barnehageloven § 19, må gjøres tilgjengelig for arbeidsgiver før signering av arbeidsavtale

 

Offentlighet
Opplysninger om søker kan bli offentlige selv om søkeren har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten, jf. Offentlighetslovens § 25.


Søknaden

  • Søknaden må inneholde søknadsbrev og CV, legg gjerne ved attester og vitnemål. 
  • Referanser kan oppgis i søknaden
  • Søknader sendes elektronisk ved bruk av "Søk her".

 

Velkommen som søker til Hadsel kommune - Et hav av muligheter!

  https://www.hadsel.kommune.no/ny-i-hadsel/


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lille-Børøya barnehage ligger på Stokmarknes i Hadsel kommune. Søndre barnehage og Lille Børøya barnehage drives i samdrift. Inntil videre er barnehagene delt i to ulike lokasjoner. Foreløpig skal barnehagen driftes i lokaler der den alltid har vært. Lokalet er en tidligere høgskole, men bygget er blitt tilpasset en barnehage. Bygget er stort og med mange muligheter; Vi har gymsal med scene, stor-kjøkken, språkrom, sykkelbane, gapahuk og grillhytte. Barnehagen har egen kokk og serverer varmmat 3 ganger i uka. Vi har siden 2012 hatt 4 avdelinger med ca. 60 barn. Vår visjon er «rom og muligheter for alle».

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Finance Manager to ICARS Would you like to be part of an international institution with highly skilled colleagues from more than 20 different countries? Would you like to join a purpose-driven institution contributing to global health and development where you will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen the support functions as we continue to grow and mature as an organisation? Then you may be our new Finance Manager.

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.



About ICARS

ICARS is an autonomous, self-governing, non-profit organization, international in character, established by the Danish Government and overseen by the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. ICARS receives funding from the Danish Government and other institutional donors and foundations and supports low- and middle-income countries in developing solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation.

With an annual budget is around 100m DKK, 50+ FTE’s, more than 70 projects across 30+ countries, a growing global footprint, and increasing organisational complexity, the Finance Team plays a crucial role in the management of all financial aspects of ICARS’ projects and running ICARS as an organization.



We offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team that is developing the scientific and organisational foundation of ICARS. Our team is composed of enthusiastic international pioneers from across the globe that all believe in ICARS’ mission and are highly motivated to ensure its success.

We are based at Statens Serum Institute in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Please visit www.icars-global.org for more information.



About the position

As an experienced Finance Manager, you will have overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial management, budgeting, reporting, annual and project auditing to ensure that ICARS meets all accounting and reporting requirements from funders. Furthermore, you are responsible for maintaining and further developing efficient work processes and promoting the effective use of IT systems and digital tools to support operational excellence.

While the role does not have direct people management responsibilities, it is expected to provide strong professional leadership by acting as a trusted sparring partner and subject matter expert for the team. The Finance team consists of 3.5 FTEs working closely together to ensure the effective delivery of financial services across the organisation.



Your main tasks

  • Take overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial accounting and ensure complete, accurate and timely financial records.
  • Lead preparation of ICARS’ annual organisational budget and consolidated project portfolio budget.
  • Lead the monthly, quarterly and year-end closing processes and the liaison with the auditors.
  • Prepare forecasting, financial analysis and reporting to the management and the board.
  • Coordinate and quality-assure finance activities and provide professional guidance to other finance and operations staff.
  • Advise budget holders and project managers on financial performance, risks and required actions, and ensure quality reporting according to donor requirements.
  • Act as functional owner of ICARS’ financial systems, reporting structures and finance data, including Navision Stat, Business Central.
  • Further develop and continuously improve ICARS financial reporting system, financial management structures, digital tools and automation.


Your background, professional and personal qualifications

We expect that you hold a degree in finances, economics, accounting or equivalent. It will be considered an advantage, if you have worked in an institution administrating funds from multiple donors, including the Danish government.

Professional qualifications

  • At least 3 years of proven success in a similar role.
  • Relevant professional experience in leading financial accounting, financial management and audit, including independent responsibility for financial closing, reporting or audit processes.
  • Understanding of Danish public-sector financial management, preferably gained in a Danish state institution, a self-governing institution or an organisation working closely with Danish government authorities.
  • Assuring compliance with regulations, standards and requirements associated with budgeting, financial reporting, grants and project administration.
  • Experience with international operations, foreign currency management, and partner-managed grants is an advantage.
  • Strong practical experience with Navision Stat, NAV, Business Central and associated state systems (SDI, RejsUd etc) or similar systems. Advanced Excel skills and the ability to develop useful financial analyses and reports.
  • Experience and interest in adopting AI to increase efficiency in finance controlling environment.
Personal qualifications

  • Excellent organisational skills with demonstrated ability to successfully manage competing priorities.
  • Combine strong attention to detail and accuracy with the ability to maintain an overview of the organisation’s overall financial position.
  • Work systematically, meet demanding deadlines and plan effectively around reporting and audit cycles.
  • Can explain complex financial matters clearly to colleagues without a finance background.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and good collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Interested in improving processes, systems and the use of data and automation in finance.
  • Proficiency in English (English is our working language). As you will be collaborating with Danish partners, experience in Danish will also be considered an advantage.


Terms of employment

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.

Salary and appointment terms will be based on the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the recognised negotiating organisations, depending on the candidate’s educational background. We expect the position to be classified at the level of chief consultant (Chefkonsulent) according to the AC Collective Agreement.

For non-Danish citizens living outside Denmark, relocation is a requirement. In this case a monthly relocation supplement and a relocation package consisting of a lumpsum and administrative assistance by settling in Denmark is added to your salary.

Please note that your total income is subject to taxation according to ordinary Danish tax rules and not under special beneficial tax schemes.



Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Executive Director Helle Engslund Krarup, at +45 24852974.



Application and recruitment process

Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV and relevant diplomas along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying no later than August 17th, 2026, at 23.59.

jobs.title: Senior Material Specialist
jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.

And we need people like you to make it happen.

We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.

Job Summary

Do you want to bring your material skills to the next level?



An exciting opportunity opens within Base Materials Polymer Technology. We are looking for a Senior Material Specialist, that will have a key role in the choice of polymers used in Tetra Pak products, to support Tetra Pak ambitions.



Within Supplier Management, we secure supply of sustainable, safe, price-competitive base materials at the required quality level for our factories and customers. We also support and contribute to base material innovation, addressing sustainability challenges.



The position is permanent, based in Lund and will include some travelling. You will be part of the Tetra Pak central Supplier Management organization and report to the Polymer Technology manager.

What you will do

You will be a part of a central competence team for materials, working on polymer grades used in Tetra Pak factories all over the world. In your role you will be responsible for several materials towards suppliers and collaborate with internal (development organisation and converting factories) as well as external stakeholders (e.g. suppliers) across different functional and international borders. Problem solving and supplier visits are a part of the role.



Focus areas:

    Technical supplier management in relation to grade optimisation and streamlining. Develop and maintain specifications; understand impact on specification portfolio from evolving customer demands, ensure supplier compliance to specifications, and push for supplier quality improvement
    Support projects with material characterisation and choices, link material characteristics to product performance to find suitable materials
    Perform concept studies and knowledge building activities to optimise base material portfolio through subsystem testing, enabling modelling and supporting projects.

We believe you have

Your educational background is a relevant university degree. You have expert knowledge in polymer chemistry, physics and/or mechanics areas as well as good understanding of modelling and simulation. Minimum 5 years of work experience from polymer industry, preferably polyethene or polypropene, or food packaging material industry is expected.



You are analytical, structured, a good communicator and have excellent spoken and written English skills. You are an open person who actively shares knowledge with others while enjoying data analysis. You deal with ambiguity as well as continuous change in a good way.

We Offer You

    A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
    A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
    An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
    Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements



Apply Now

If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/.

This job posting expires on 2026-08-10.

To know more about the position contact Karin Strömberg at +46 46 36 3391

Questions about your application contact Sara Johannesson at sara.johannesson@tetrapak.com

For trade union information contact Unionen/Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320 or Sveriges Ingenjörer/Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533

jobs.title: Manager - Materials Specialist Lab - Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
Lead Husqvarna Group's Center of Excellence in Materials

Are you a confident leader who wants to shape how a global engineering company understands, selects, and masters its materials? The Materials Specialists Lab is more than a laboratory, it is our Center of Excellence for materials, a strategic capability that impacts product innovation, sustainability, sourcing, compliance, and quality across all divisions. We are now looking for a manager to lead the department within Shared R&D and play a key role in shaping the future of materials at Husqvarna Group.

Shared R&D is Husqvarna Group’s centralized engineering function with around 100 specialists across multiple disciplines. Within this, the Materials Specialists Lab supports all product categories with advanced analysis, characterization, and investigation across metals, polymers, and material-related technologies. The team is a key contributor to our global Material Management process, ensuring high‑quality data, strong knowledge, and reuse of materials to drive innovation speed, cost efficiency, and sustainable product development.

About the role:

In this role, you will be responsible for driving the department’s strategy and goals within product, technology, and business development, while ensuring an efficient day‑to‑day operation of the lab and its deliveries. A key part of the role is to continuously strengthen how and when the team contributes to product development, increasing early involvement and impact across the organization.

Key responsibilities include:

    Collaborating with the Shared R&D leadership team to define the vision and objectives for the department
    Translating strategy into concrete plans and leading their successful execution
    Leading and developing a team of 12 specialists, including prioritizing and allocating incoming assignments and ensuring high‑quality deliveries
    Building strong relationships across Husqvarna to ensure best involvement of material specialists in product development projects
    Leading selected cross-functional R&D initiatives and external research collaborations, as well as driving investment planning and prioritization for the lab
    Managing team leadership, performance, and budget responsibility

About you:

You are a proactive and motivating leader who builds trust and collaborates effectively. With a strategic mindset and strong customer focus, you drive change and deliver results with structure and persistence. You are self-aware and continuously develop through feedback and reflection.

    5–7 years of proven leadership experience within engineering, with responsibility for leading and developing teams
    Solid experience (8–10 years) from technology‑intensive environments, preferably within R&D, product development, or laboratory operations
    University degree in materials engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or a related field
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

You also bring a background or genuine interest in the following:

    A clear, confident, and grounded leadership style, with knowledge of team and organizational development
    A structured approach, with the ability to balance agile and traditional development methodologies while maintaining a solution-oriented mindset
    A solid understanding of laboratory and development operations
    Strong communication skills and the ability to build effective networks across the organization

Location

This position will be placed in our of our main sites in Huskvarna.

But, with our hybrid working environment, you’ll have the flexibility to work both onsite and remotely, promoting work-life balance for all team members, but as laboratory function the majority of the time is spent onsite. We meet in the office at least 4 days a week (80%).

Your Application:

Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we apply ongoing selection. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations.

For more information about the position please contact Hiring Per Orestig at per.orestig@husqvarnagroup.com.  For questions regarding the recruitment process please contact, Talent Acquisition Partner Gorjana Dubovina at gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Due to the holiday period, we will not be conducting interviews at this time. The recruitment process will resume in mid-August.

Winning Through Culture

At Husqvarna Group, we believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

Learn more about our culture here: Our Culture | Husqvarna Group

jobs.title: Simulation & Analysis Engineer, Automotive - Gothenburg
jobs.description:
About SEGULA Technologies

SEGULA Technologies is part of the SEGULA Technologies Group, a global engineering company with more than 15,000 employees across 30 countries. Together, they are involved in a wide range of important projects, leveraging extensive expertise and experience to develop the technologies of tomorrow.

As a consultant at SEGULA Technologies, you will have the opportunity to gain experience across a variety of industries and technical fields. They offer the chance to build valuable professional experience, expand your network, and work in exciting environments with well-known brands.

SEGULA Technologies is always looking for new, brilliant, and bold talent. What are you passionate about? Take on your next challenge with SEGULA!

For more information, visit them at: https://www.segulatechnologies.com/en/

About the role

SEGULA Technologies is looking for an experienced Simulation & Analysis Engineer to strengthen its engineering team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will work with advanced durability simulations and fatigue evaluations of engine-related components, supporting the development of high-quality engineering solutions through finite element analysis.

You will perform complex simulations, evaluate results, and provide technical recommendations throughout the product development process. Working closely with design engineers and cross-functional teams, you will contribute to method development, continuous improvements, and innovation within simulation and analysis.

This is an excellent opportunity for a specialist who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges while helping shape future simulation methods and technologies.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform advanced durability simulations and fatigue evaluations of engine-related components.

• Develop, execute, and validate finite element models to support product development.

• Analyze simulation results and provide technical recommendations based on design targets.

• Plan, lead, and perform complex simulation and analysis activities.

• Ensure the quality and accuracy of simulation models and analysis results.

• Support project and design engineers throughout all stages of product development.

• Contribute to the continuous development of simulation methods, tools, and engineering processes.

• Drive innovation through collaboration with internal teams, universities, and external partners.

• Support knowledge sharing by coaching and mentoring less experienced simulation engineers.

• Contribute to project planning, technical estimations, and delivery according to project timelines.

Location: Gothenburg

Employment type: Full-time, Permanent

Employment start date: As agreed with Segula

Profile - who are we looking for?

Qualifications:

•    Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering with a focus on simulation or a related discipline.

•    Approximately 8 years or more of relevant experience within simulation and analysis engineering.

•    Experience performing durability simulations and fatigue evaluations using finite element analysis (FEA).

•    Experience working with ANSYS Classic and APDL scripting.

•    Experience using ANSA for meshing.

•    Ability to work within a Linux environment.

•    Experience supporting method and tool development.

•    Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple engineering interfaces.

Desirable:

•    Experience with Python scripting for automation and efficiency improvements.

•    Experience supporting continuous improvements of simulation methods and engineering tools.

•    Experience coaching or mentoring less experienced engineers.

•    Experience leading complex simulation activities or technical projects.

•    Interest in driving innovation through collaboration with internal and external engineering networks.

SEGULA Technologies offers

    

Exciting assignments with Sweden’s leading industrial companies

    

Collective agreement

    

Health insurance

    

Childcare benefit (parental benefit)

    

Pension benefits, including flexible pension options

    

Discounts through our benefits platform on gym memberships, fitness equipment, massage, insurance (supplementary insurance or health protection), pension and savings plans (additional contributions or savings products), transportation and travel, as well as lifestyle benefits (discounts on culture, entertainment, and shopping)

    

Training and professional development opportunities through e-learning

    

Computer glasses

We are committed to a recruitment process free from discrimination and bias. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, gender identity or expression, age, ethnicity, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual orientation, or background.

After this, reference checks will be carried out digitally using Refensa. Following these steps, SEGULA Technologies will take over the recruitment process. jobs.title: Mobile App tester  Husqvarna Group

Join us and create world-class mobile experiences for Husqvarna customers!

We are Residential Robotics Digital, a team of around 40 passionate professionals located mainly in Huskvarna and Mumbai. We develop the app for Husqvarna’s robotic lawnmowers and will bring your future smart garden to a new level.  We truly put our customer in the centre of our development. In this role, you will contribute to the quality of our mobile application, working with both app‑only testing and end‑to‑end scenarios together with our connected mowers. You will be involved in planning, writing, and executing test cases, with support and guidance adapted to your level of experience.

Collaboration is a natural part of the role, and you will work closely with developers and other test teams to ensure a reliable and user‑friendly product. As you grow in the role, you will also have opportunities to work with automated and AI‑driven testing, helping us continuously improve how we test and deliver value.

We are looking for someone who is detail‑oriented and able to think critically, with a strong focus on quality. You are curious by nature and motivated by delivering reliable, well‑tested solutions. You enjoy working together with others and contribute as a collaborative team player. Clear and structured communication comes naturally to you, both within the team and towards stakeholders. Your have:

    Experience or interest in software testing, including working with test strategies, test plans, and test documentation
    Familiarity with tools such as Jira and Confluence (depth of experience can vary)
    Experience of, or willingness to work in, Agile/Scrum teams together with developers, product owners, and stakeholders
    Ability to communicate test results clearly and support defect prioritization together with the development team
    Curiosity and a structured approach to identifying edge cases, investigating issues, and understanding root causes (deeper experience is a plus)

    Experience with, or interest in, test automation and maintaining test scripts
    Background in software development or software testing
    Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement

Why Join Us?

    Work on cutting-edge IoT solutions in a global company with a start-up mindset
    Collaborate with talented colleagues in an agile, supportive environment
    Help shape the digital future of Husqvarna products

Location

Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive. Today we have a requirement of minimum four days a week at the office.

Your application

Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:

Hiring Manager: Jerker Andersson, jerker.andersson@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

jobs.title: Team Lead, Engineering
jobs.description:
**Team Lead, Engineering, FinVector**

**Are you looking for a new challenge where you can combine people leadership with technical and quality expertise in the biopharmaceutical industry?**

Whether you are looking for your next career step, seeking to expand your leadership responsibilities, or broaden your expertise in the biopharmaceutical industry, this role offers an excellent opportunity to gain new perspectives and further your professional development.

We are looking for a**Team Lead, Qualification**to join our**Qualification Team**in the Engineering department.

The Qualification Team plays a critical role in ensuring that our equipment, facilities, utilities, and associated computerized systems are properly tested, documented ,and approved for their intended use. This helps ensure that our operations meet Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements and are ready to support the production of high-quality gene therapy products.

The team is responsible for planning, coordinating and maintaining qualification activities throughout the lifecycle of facilities, equipment and systems, in accordance with regulatory requirements, company procedures and industry best practices.

As Team Lead, you will lead and develop a team of qualification professionals while providing direction, support and expertise in qualification-related activities. You will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams, contributing to both operational excellence and continuous improvement.

**Key responsibilities**

- Lead, coach and develop the Qualification Team, supporting competence development and team performance

- Set priorities and allocate resources to ensure efficient execution of qualification activities and project deliverables

- Provide guidance and decision-making support on qualification-related topics, risks and issues

- Review and approve qualification documentation and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company procedures

- Support audits, inspections, investigations of process or documentation deviations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and change management activities

- Drive continuous improvement and foster effective collaboration across Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality functions


**In order to succeed in this role, you should have:**

- A technical or scientific degree combined with relevant industry experience

- Previous experience in leading people or coordinating technical teams

- Experience in a regulated industry environment, such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, food production or another quality-driven industry

- Understanding of qualification, validation, quality assurance or technical compliance processes

- Knowledge of investigations, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and change management practices

- Strong planning, communication and problem-solving skills

- Fluent English and the ability to collaborate effectively with different stakeholders


Most importantly, you are a supportive leader who enables your team to succeed and is motivated by developing people, improving ways of working and contributing to high-quality GMP operations.

This is a permanent, full-time salaried employee position (37.5 hours per week). Our aim is for the selected candidate to start in the role during September–October, with some flexibility based on availability.

**What FinVector offers you**

Meaningful job in organization where your work truly matters for peoples health and where your work is valued. High competence, quality, teamwork, and transparency are emphasized in everything that is done at Finvector. In international organization you have great opportunities to grow and develop.

In addition to great colleagues and meaningful work, we offer a comprehensive range of employee benefits, including extensive occupational healthcare services, ePassi benefits for sports and cultural activities, a lunch benefit, and participation in our company-wide bonus scheme.

**How to apply**

Please submit your application via the link below by**9 August 2026**and attach your CV and application, including your salary expectation.

**For more information about the position,** please contact **Hiring Manager Lotta Rissanen**(+358 41 317 0975)during office hours in weeks 29-30. **During the Hiring Manager's holiday**weeks 31-32,please contact **Engineering Director Snorri Halldórsson**(+358 44 777 1410).

jobs.title: CRM Advisor
jobs.employer: LEGER UTEN GRENSER NORGE MEDECINS SANS FRONTIERES NORWAY
jobs.description:
Doctors Without Borders Norway (Leger Uten Grenser/MSF) is seeking a CRM Advisor to join our dedicated and collaborative CRM team working at the intersection of tech, data, and fundraising and help ensure sustainable funding for life-saving medical work worldwide.

This is a role for someone who wants to combine technical expertise with meaningful impact.

About the Position

As CRM Advisor, you will play a key role in shaping and advancing our CRM capabilities, driving continuous improvement of workflows, data flows, and system integrations to support effective and scalable fundraising and engagement. The role combines technical tasks with advisory responsibilities. The main focus is to troubleshoot and optimize existing CRM flows and create new processes, while ensuring that donor data is accurate, accessible, and actionable, enabling data-driven insights for the fundraising department.

We are actively working to create an inclusive workplace where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are committed to accessibility and are happy to make reasonable adjustments for candidates who may need them during the recruitment process and throughout employment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Improve and develop workflows in the CRM, including automation and integrations, and document processes.

  • Provide professional advice on process improvement and cost-effective solutions.

  • Collaborate with external suppliers on payment solutions and new integrations (e.g., Vipps and Mastercard).

  • Perform analyses and ensure data quality to support data-driven decisions, act as backup for the CRM Analyst.

  • Contribute to the strategic use of data in collaboration with the CRM Analyst and CRM & Loyalty Manager.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in relevant fields (information technology, informatics and computer science, finance and administration, etc.). Five years of relevant experience may compensate for formal education.

  • At least 2 years of experience with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) at a super user level or higher, including data analysis, and integrations.

  • Proficiency in SQL or a similar data querying/programming language

  • Experience in fundraising, project management, or analytical tools is an advantage.

  • Proficient in English (C1 and higher); Norwegian is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical and technical skills.

  • Structured, strategic, and detail-oriented.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.

  • Quality-focused and goal-oriented.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic, international working environment where you’ll collaborate with an engaged and dedicated team.

  • The opportunity to be part of one of the world’s most recognised humanitarian organisations.

  • Real influence on and responsibility for developing CRM activities at Doctors Without Borders.

  • Flexible working hours with core hours from 09:00–15:00, and one day of home office per week.

  • Two additional days of annual leave.

  • Salary according to Doctors Without Borders’ salary principles, salary grade 15: NOK 622,742 - 687,428 per year (based on relevant experience).

  • Workplace: Oslo. Currently based at Hausmanns gate 6; relocating to Mølleparken 2 in early 2027.

At Doctors Without Borders, we value diversity and seek to have an inclusive and accessible work environment. We encourage all individuals who have the required qualifications to apply, independently of their ethnic, national, or cultural background, age, gender, sexual orientation, religious belief, disabilities, or other aspects of their identity.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Leger Uten Grenser er en nøytral og uavhengig medisinsk nødshjelpeorganisasjon som redder liv og lindrer nød. Vi hjelper de som trenger det mest - uansett hvem, uansett hvor, uansett hvorfor. Leger Uten Grenser har prosjekter i flere enn 75 land og sender feltarbeidere fra Norge på rundt 100 oppdrag hvert år. Leger Uten Grenser gir nødhjelp til mennesker i krig, kriser og katastrofer og andre som ikke har tilgang til grunnleggende helsetjenester. Vi varsler om overgrep og glemte kriser - fordi færre dør når flere vet.

jobs.title: BIM Co-Ordinator
jobs.description:
Winthrop Technologies is a dedicated data centre delivery partner providing turnkey solutions to our clients, headquartered in Dublin and delivering throughout Europe.

Winthrop specialises in providing turnkey data centre solutions, providing services from design, through to construction across the full range of civil, structural, architectural, mechanical and electrical services as well as commissioning.

Winthrop has grown to become the leading and most trusted company in our sector and is the only dedicated Data Centre delivery partner in Europe.

We are currently constructing multiple turnkey data centre projects in 7 different European countries, equating to over 500 MW of IT load in flight.

We are pleased to announce we are currently recruiting a BIM Coordinator to join our expanding team in Swedenm. This is an onsite role.

Reports to: BIM Team Lead

Responsibilities:

•    Production of drawings, specifications, and schedules, according to the project BIM Execution plan.

•    Responsible for delivering all 2D and 3D co-ordination milestones on each project.

•    Liaise with package managers and site engineers to coordinate complex MEP installations.

•    Provide support to junior BIM team members.

Requirements:

•    Previous Revit experience – MEP bias required  

•    AutoCAD experience preferred

•    Navisworks experience desired

•    Excellent organisation, communication, and time management skills

Winthrop Technologies Ltd is an equal opportunities employer
