jobs.title: KOKKI
jobs.description:
PALKATAAN KOKKI MONIPUOLISIIN TEHTÄVIIN, VAKITUISEEN, KOKOAIKAISEEN TYÖSUHTEESEEN

Haemme ammattitaidostaan ylpeää kokkia yksityiseen perheyritykseen hotelli Gustavelundiin. Hotellimme sijaitsee Tuusulanjärven rannalla kauniissa puistomaisemissa, noin 15 min Helsinki-Vantaan lentokentältä ja puolen tunnin ajomatkan päässä Helsingin keskustasta.

Asiakaskuntamme koostuu kokouksissa, koulutuksissa ja erilaisissa yritystapahtumissa kokoontuvista ryhmistä, joille valmistamme kokoustarjoiluja, ryhmäillallisia sekä buffetruokailuja. Toteutamme laadukkaasti ja korkeatasoisesti monipuolisia ja vaihtuvia tuotteita: päivittäin tarjolla on hotelliaamiainen sekä lounas, iltaisin tarjoillaan bankettien lisäksi A la Cartea. Viikonloppuisin tarjoilemme brunsseja, olemme myös suosittu perhejuhlien pitopaikka. Terassillamme kesäkeittiössä valmistetaan grilliruokia ryhmille sekä salaatteja, pizzoja ja hampurilaisia walk-in asiakkaille. Hotellissamme järjestetään festivaalityyppisiä tapahtumia, kuten urheiluautotapaamisia, juhannusjuhla, bändi-iltoja ja varttuneemman väen disco-iltoja. Haluamme tarjota vieraillemme mahdollisimman paljon itse tehtyä ruokaa, leivomme ja valmistamme annoksia tuoreista raaka-aineista.

Työkielenämme on suomi. Toivomme sinulta kausivaihteluiden vuoksi joustavuutta: käytössämme on MaRaTes tasausjärjestelmä. Työskentelemme pääsääntöisesti kahdessa vuorossa, arkisin kello 6.00 - 20.30, viikonloppuisin alkaen kello 7.00 ja päättyen aina kulloisenkin tilaisuuden mukaan. Työ sisältää ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Palkkauksen pohjana on MaRaTes sekä normaalit ilta-, sunnuntai- yms. lisät, Kokemuksen määrän ja laadun mukaan palkka on myös neuvoteltavissa.

Arvostamme asiakaspalvelutaitoja, vastuullisuutta ja vieraanvaraisuutta sekä innostunutta ja innostavaa asennetta. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä ammattikoulutus ovat työssä onnistumisen edellytyksiä. Hakijoilta edellytämme aiempaa kokemusta ravintolan keittiössä työskentelystä sekä hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työpaikan, jatkuvan kehityksen ja uudistuksen alla olevat upeat puitteet, mukavat asiakkaat ja huippuluokan työkaverit. Kanssamme olet mukana kehittämässä toimintaa perheyrityksessä, jossa on helppo tuoda esiin omia näkemyksiä ja ideoita ja osallistua toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Työ alkaa heti.

jobs.title: Performance Director & PMO - Supply Management
jobs.description:
At Sodexo, we believe in creating a better everyday for everyone. We are seeking for a highly driven and analytical Performance Director & PMO to join our Continental Europe Supply Management organization.

This is a key leadership role where you will combine strategic performance management, portfolio governance, and executive support to drive value creation across the region. Reporting directly to the Head of Supply Management Continental Europe, you will act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner, helping to shape priorities, ensure execution excellence, and strengthen performance visibility across multiple countries.

You will work at the center of Supply Management, Finance, and Business Leadership, providing the insights, governance, and structure needed to deliver sustainable business results.

The role can be based in one of the Continental Europe regions: Sweden, Spain, Poland, or Belgium.

About the role

As Performance Director & PMO, you will be responsible for driving transparency, accountability, and performance across the Continental Europe Supply Management organization.

You will lead the performance management agenda while establishing a structured PMO approach that ensures strategic initiatives and transformation programs are prioritized, governed, and successfully delivered. The role offers a unique opportunity to influence senior stakeholders across countries and functions while supporting strategic decision-making at both regional and global levels.

Your main responsibilities

Drive performance and value creation

    Own and further develop regional performance reporting, including savings, spend, KPIs, forecasts, and business reviews
    Provide data-driven insights that support strategic and operational decision-making
    Strengthen performance visibility and transparency across Continental Europe
    Challenge assumptions and results through fact-based analysis
    Support budgeting, forecasting, and quarterly business reviews
    Ensure alignment with global performance standards and methodologies
    Translate complex data into clear and actionable business recommendations

Lead the PMO and project portfolio

    Establish and continuously improve the PMO framework for Supply Management
    Coordinate a portfolio of strategic, operational, and transformation initiatives
    Drive prioritization, planning, governance, and risk management
    Monitor delivery against objectives, timelines, budgets, and expected benefits
    Ensure consistent project management standards and ways of working across the region

Partner with senior leadership

    Act as a trusted advisor and strategic right hand to the Head of Supply Management Continental Europe
    Prepare, structure, and follow up on key leadership meetings and strategic reviews
    Track priorities, commitments, and actions across the organization
    Support business cases, strategic projects, and executive decision-making

Build strong stakeholder relationships

    Partner closely with Supply Management and Finance leaders across Continental Europe
    Collaborate with Global Supply Management Finance to ensure alignment with governance frameworks and financial standards
    Support knowledge-sharing and best-practice development across the international Supply Management community
    Communicate effectively with senior leaders and stakeholders in multiple countries

What you'll bring

To succeed in this role, you combine strong business acumen with exceptional analytical capabilities and a structured approach to execution.

We believe you have:

    Extensive experience within Supply Management, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Consulting, or a related field
    Experience from large international and matrix organizations
    A strong background in performance management, business analytics, PMO, or strategic leadership support roles
    Proven success in leading complex cross-functional and multi-country initiatives
    Strong financial understanding, including savings methodologies, procurement economics, and total cost of ownership concepts
    Advanced Excel capabilities and experience working with complex datasets
    Hands-on experience with Power BI or similar business intelligence tools
    Strong project and portfolio management skills
    Experience creating executive-level presentations and decision material
    Excellent communication skills in English
    Fluency in Swedish, French, German and/or Spanish is considered an asset

Experience from management consulting or consulting-like environments is highly valued.

Who you are

As a person, you are structured, analytical, and proactive. You enjoy working in complex environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity while maintaining focus on results.

You are also:

    A strategic thinker who can connect details with the bigger picture
    A trusted and credible business partner
    Solution-oriented, resilient, and self-driven
    Comfortable challenging perspectives through data and facts
    Skilled at building relationships across cultures and organizational levels
    Passionate about continuous improvement and value creation

Why join Sodexo?

At Sodexo, you'll become part of a global organization where collaboration, development, and innovation are at the core of what we do. You will have the opportunity to work with senior leaders across Continental Europe, influence strategic decisions, and drive initiatives that deliver meaningful business impact.

Join us and help shape the future of Supply Management across Continental Europe.

Additional information:

The position is full-time, with a start date to be agreed upon. We offer a hybrid working model, allowing you to combine work from one of our European offices with remote work.

Questions regarding the position and the recruitment process should be directed to Erik Gund, Talent Acquisition Specialist, at erik.gund@sodexo.com. We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible, but no later than August 16.

Please note that we only accept applications submitted through our recruitment system.

For this position, we will conduct a background check on the final candidate in cooperation with an external provider. The final candidate will be informed and asked to provide consent before the background check is carried out. All employees at Sodexo are also required to complete an identity verification process before employment begins.

jobs.title: Europcar søger en FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
FP&A Manager

Vil du spille en central rolle i at styrke finansiel styring, rapportering med stort forretningsaspekt i en dynamisk biludlejningsvirksomhed med sund vækst? Til at løfte vores finansfunktion til næste niveau søger vi en analytisk stærk FP&A Manager.

Om rollen

 Som FP&A Manager har du en nøglerolle i at udvikle og styrke virksomhedens rapportering, business controlling, FP&A og BI på tværs af den danske forretning. Udover den danske forretning, vil en mindre del af de opgaver, der hører til rollen, også gå med at supportere og drive den finske budget og forecast proces.

Med reference til vores Finance Director har du og dit team ansvaret for at sikre høj kvalitet i den månedlige rapportering samt drive vores forecast- og budgetprocesser i tæt samarbejde med forretningen. Du vil derfor spille en væsentlig rolle i videreudvikling af vores eksisterende, solide fundament.

Samtidig fungerer du som et centralt bindeled til koncernens finansfunktion, hvor du sikrer rettidig, konsistent og veldokumenteret rapportering og bidrager til at skabe transparens og sammenhæng i den finansielle performance.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Sikre høj kvalitet i månedlig rapportering til ledelse og koncern

  • Koordinere og kvalitetssikre rapporteringspakker til Europcar Mobility Group Finance

  • Drive og udvikle budget- og forecastprocesser i Danmark og Finland

  • Udvikle og styrke brugen af forretningsdata, herunder rapporteringsværktøjer, dashboards og datagrundlag

I dag består vores FP&A afdeling af to controllere, der hver dag arbejder målrettet og ambitiøst for at levere til forretningen. Afdelingen er et godt sted i sammenhold og kultur. Og der er ønske om, at du som leder fokuserer på at teamet går fremtiden i møde med den rette støtte og ser løft af kompetencer og udvikling som vejen derhen.

Ansvaret for teamet indebærer også, at:

  • Sikre klare prioriteringer og høj kvalitet i leverancer

  • Udvikle teamets kompetencer og arbejdsprocesser

  • Skabe et motiverende og professionelt arbejdsmiljø

Udover dit fokus på os og teamet, har vi naturligt også et fokus på dig, så dit faglige og professionelle bidrag i virksomheden stemmer overens med det, vi søger.

Derfor forestiller vi os, at du:

  • Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi, finans eller lignende

  • Har dokumenteret solid erfaring med FP&A, controlling eller reporting – gerne fra en større organisation eller koncern

  • Har erfaring med budget- og forecastprocesser

  • Kan demonstrere god forretningsforståelse og evner at omsætte data til indsigt

  • Trives i en rolle med både operationelle og udviklingsorienterede opgaver

  • Har ledelseserfaring eller er klar til dette næste skridt i din karriere

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen og synes vi lyder interessante, kan vi opsummeret tilbyde:

  • En central rolle med stor indflydelse på udvikling af afdelingen

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En attraktiv markedsrelevant lønpakke. Yderligere oplyses forud for eventuel forhandling.

  • Indtræden i en finansafdeling med stærkt sammenhold og høj faglighed

  • En arbejdshverdag i en organisation, hvor der er højt til loftet og plads til mennesket.

Ansøgningsfrist d.17. august 2026. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og holder samtaler undervejs, da vi gerne vil finde den helt rette kandidat til stillingen. Vi opfordrer derfor interesserede til at søge hurtigst muligt.

Vi hører rigtig gerne fra dig via vores karriereportal. Men har du forinden spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Finance Director, Thomas Lyngholm Jacobsen +45 61 99 99 87 | TLJ@europcar.dk

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender reassignment, nationality, sexual orientation, age, disability status, religion, or any other dimension of diversity. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and fostering an environment of equity and inclusion, where respect for one another is essential. If you need any accommodations or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know. Together, through mutual respect, we can create a more equitable and inclusive future.

Europcar Mobility Group is a global mobility player, with 75 years of mobility services expertise and a leading position in Europe.  “We help to change the way you move” is what we stand for and brings us together.

We offer to individuals and businesses a wide range of car and van rental services, be it for a few hours, a few days, a week, a month or more, on-demand or on subscription, relying on a fleet of more than 250.000 vehicles, equipped with the latest engines including an increasing share of electric vehicles.

Our brands address differentiated needs, use cases and expectations: Europcar® - a global leader of car rental and light commercial vehicle rental, with a premium positioning, Goldcar® - a frontrunner at providing low-cost car rental services in Europe, and Fox-Rent-A-Car®, one of the main players in the car rental market in the US, with a "value for money" positioning.

Customers’ satisfaction is at the heart of the Group’s ambition and that of our more than 8,000 employees, everywhere we deliver our mobility solutions, thanks to a strong network in over 130 countries.

More info at: www.europcar-mobility-group.com

jobs.title: Montør til Bruseglas og nicher
jobs.description:
Er du en kvalitetsbevidst tømrer eller håndværker med sans for detaljen? Trives du med selvstændigt arbejde, hvor du får ansvar og frihed i hverdagen? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en dygtig medarbejder med håndværker erfaring til montering af bruseglas og nicher hos primært erhvervskunder på hele Sjælland. Du behøver ikke at være uddannet så længe du har hænderne skruet rigtigt på.

Erfaring med montagearbejde er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du arbejder præcist, leverer høj kvalitet og sætter en ære i godt håndværk. Du vil få en grundig oplæring, hvor du de første 1½ måned følges med en erfaren kollega.

Du starter arbejdsdagen hjemmefra og modtager dagen før en arbejdsplan med dagens opgaver. Materialer hentes på vores lager i Roskilde cirka to gange om ugen.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling med opstart hurtigst muligt.

  • Arbejde mandag til torsdag kl. 07.30–15.30 og fredag kl. 07.30–15.00.

  • Timeløn på 225 kr. Ved fastansættelse vil lønnen være højere.

  • Firmabil, værktøj, arbejdstøj og mobiltelefon stilles til rådighed.

  • Grundig oplæring og sparring med en erfaren kollega.

  • Mulighed for fastansættelse efter 3 måneders fuldtidsansættelse

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er bosat på Sjælland og kommer med noget håndværksmæssig erfaring.

  • Har gerne erfaring med montagearbejde eller fugning.

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har øje for detaljen.

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Taler dansk eller engelsk.

  • Har kørekort B.

Praktisk information

  • Arbejdsområde: Hele Sjælland (lager i Roskilde)

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt – vi ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag til Niso@moment.dk. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Regional Internal Control System (ICS) Manager - Northern Europe
jobs.description:
At TRATON Financial Services (TFS) we have started the journey to become the provider of Financial Services to all TRATON brands. Our service includes financing for customers, dealers, and distributors as well as insurance solutions. With a presence in over 65 markets, we are already one of the most global players in the financial services industry and are rapidly growing. Do you want to be part of this journey?

Role Summary

We are looking for a Regional Internal Control System (ICS) Manager for Northern Europe, who would like to contribute to an effective internal control environment at TRATON Financial Services entities. The Northern Europe Region is covering the Business Units Finans (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Estonia, Lithuania, Latvia), Great Britain and Ireland.

As ICS Manager for the region, you will be part of the Central GRC team and reporting to the Global ICS Manager at the Head office and working closely with the Regional Office. This role manages all ICS related activities for the Business Units in the region and has an active role on the implementation, maintenance and further development of the Internal Control Framework at TFS.

Job Responsibilities

Your primary responsibilities will include:

    Coordinate, facilitate and consolidate yearly risk assessments at Business Units based on the TFS risk profile and support the preparation of the annual control evaluation plan for the Region
    Conduct process walkthroughs, control testing, and self-assessments in line with the annual control evaluation plan
    Support management and process owners in the Business Units in design of new and updated controls
    Full maintenance and update of ICS data in the ICS dedicated Tool: New controls mapping and controls updates, testing documentation, issues creation, remediation actions and closure, access management, and coordination with Head Office and TRATON where needed.
    Monitor control deficiencies and remediation activities, ensuring timely follow-up and closure
    Prepare and deliver ICS reporting at Business Unit, Regional, and Head Office levels
    Assist management, process-control owners and control performers in controls design for risk mitigation as well as review and provide input on governing documents in connection with control requirements
    Provide guidance and training on internal controls and support the implementation of ICS in new or evolving entities
    Ensure compliance with local regulatory requirements related to internal controls
    Contribute to cross-functional ICS projects and initiatives across the TRATON Group

Who You Are

You are a proactive, self-driven professional with high integrity and a collaborative mindset. You enjoy building relationships across functions and organizational levels, communicate effectively, and thrive in an international environment.

With a strong focus on continuous improvement, you challenge existing ways of working and seek efficient, effective solutions that support business objectives. You are analytical by nature, able to assess risks, identify control gaps, and contribute to sound decision-making. Comfortably navigating ambiguity and changing priorities, you take initiative, build trust with stakeholders, and maintain a strong understanding of business processes, risks, and organizational goals.

What You'll Bring

    University degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field
    Experience in external audit, internal audit, internal controls, or a similar assurance function
    Good understanding of the COSO framework and internal control methodologies
    Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken; knowledge of additional languages, particularly Swedish, is an advantage.
    Experience in multinational and/or regulated organizations is beneficial
    Experience within the financial services industry is considered a plus

This Is Us

A great team and mission. You join a company that offers a truly international environment during one of its most interesting moments. You get to contribute to your function and the company at large with your competence and energy. You will interact with a wide range of functions but not least a global network of GRC professionals from all parts of the world. Centrally, you will join a Governance Risk and Compliance function with highly experienced and energetic team bringing in experience from different parts of the world and different sectors.

An international work environment. Our office is located in Södertälje and we also have a hub in Central Stockholm (Östermalm), allowing collaboration where best fits to our employees. The role includes travelling in the Region but you are expected to shape this according to the needs of your role and work.

TRATON Financial Services Offers

We believe great work starts with feeling supported, both professionally and personally. That's why we offer a broad range of employee benefits designed to promote wellbeing, flexibility, and a healthy work-life balance. Employees can enjoy flexible working hours and a workplace that supports both collaboration and flexibility. With office Hubs in Södertälje and Stockholm, as well as coworking spaces at Sergels Torg and Kungens Kurva, you will have the best preconditions to pick the best workplace for your activities.

We provide a yearly wellness contribution and you can train at our health center Gröndal, and you will access to occupational health services with doctors, nurses, and ergonomists. Mental health is important to us, therefore we also offer confidential staff support services for guidance related to personal challenges.

In addition, employees benefit from pension plans, profit sharing programs, and extra time off or additional pension contributions. We also support family life through enhanced parental benefits and offer additional perks such as employee car leasing. Together, these benefits help create a workplace where you can thrive both at work and in everyday life.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-06. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Financial Services.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral position in Plant Evolutionary Genomics and Pangenomics
jobs.description:
Postdoctoral position in Plant Evolutionary Genomics and Pangenomics

Department of Plant Biology

About the position

A postdoctoral position in plant evolutionary genomics is available in the Yant Lab at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Uppsala, Sweden. The Yant Lab develops computational and genomic approaches to understand evolution, adaptation, genome dynamics, and whole-genome duplication across diverse plant systems (see https://www.yantlab.net/).

The project is funded through a Formas grant aimed at restoring European ash (Fraxinus excelsior) populations threatened by ash dieback. The successful candidate will contribute to developing the first Swedish-focused European ash pangenome, integrating long-read genome assemblies with population-scale sequencing to understand disease resistance and local adaptation across Europe.

The project combines large-scale population genomics, graph-based pangenomics, structural variant discovery, genome-wide association studies, and evolutionary genomics using state-of-the-art long-read sequencing and computational genomic approaches. The successful candidate will work closely with collaborators at other SLU campuses, the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, and other European partners, contributing to both methodological developments and biological discovery.

The project offers an opportunity to work at the forefront of plant evolutionary genomics while contributing directly to forest restoration and conservation.

Your profile

We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a PhD in botany, evolutionary biology, genetics, genomics, bioinformatics, plant biology, or a related subject deemed equivalent by the employer. The applicant should have a strong publication record relative to career stage and demonstrated ability to conduct independent research. The ideal candidate will have experience in all of the following areas:

-large scale population genomics, demographic inference, and evolutionary genomics

-graph-based pangenomics and structural variant analysis, ideally in plants

-genotype-environment association (GEA/EAA) or GWAS

-programming in Python, with extensive experience working in Linux and multiple HPC environments.

-population genomics across environmental gradients, including demographic inference and genotype–environment association analyses

Experience with long-read sequencing, structural variant analysis, graph-based genome analysis, and plant genomics is considered an advantage but is not required.

The successful candidate is expected to be a collaborative team member who will drive the project with creativity, independence, and scientific curiosity. Excellent written and spoken English is required.

Since postdoctoral appointments are career-development positions, priority will be given to candidates who received their doctoral degree within the past three years.

About us

The Department of Plant Biology (www.slu.se/en/vbsg) offers a creative and stimulating international environment and is one of several departments that make up the ‘Uppsala BioCenter’. The department undertakes fundamental research on model organisms, agricultural crops, forest trees and bioenergy crops. Our main areas of research comprise the interaction of plants with microorganisms and other environmental stresses, plant growth and development, biotechnology and metabolic engineering, regulation of gene expression, population genetics, genome analysis, and the development of breeding systems. Species in use are model organisms such as the entire Arabidopsis genus, Physcomitrella, Cochlearia, crops such as rapeseed, basket willow (Salix), potato, and cereals, and pathogens such as viruses, bacteria, and fungi/oomycetes. The department is responsible for basic and advanced courses in general and molecular genetics, cell biology, gene technology, plant physiology, plant breeding, plant biochemistry and biotechnology, and molecular interactions between plants and pathogens. In addition, the department contributes to various courses together with other departments. Uppsala, Sweden ́s fourth-biggest city, has two universities and with more than 50 000 students a vibrant student atmosphere. It is located in the Greater Stockholm area and has an excellent connection to the Stockholm-Arlanda international airport.

For more information about the department visit: https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-biology-forest-genetics/

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location: Uppsala.

Form of employment: Temporary employment 24 months, with the possibility of extension.

Scope: 100%.

Start date: 1 November 2026.

Application: Please submit your application before deadline 31 August 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

Union representatives: https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/

The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

In this role, you will contribute directly to the financial success of ABB’s Process Industries business in Sweden.

In this position, you will have end‑to‑end controlling responsibility for local business line Mining & Materials covering project controlling, business controlling, and overall financial performance. You will analyze financial results, assess different business scenarios, and provide clear recommendations to improve profitability and efficiency.

We offer a challenging and rewarding role in an international, dynamic environment, with broad exposure across financial management and close collaboration with the business.

For this role, you are expected to spend approximately 3–4 days per week working from our Västerås office.

Qualifications for the Role

    Several years of experience in Business Controlling or a similar controlling role

    Experience working with SAP is an advantage
    Known for strong collaboration, communication, and business‑partnering skills
    Fluent in English and Swedish; additional languages are a plus
    A proactive and structured professional who enjoys driving improvements and adapting to change

What’s in it for you?

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

jobs.title: HR Site Lead, LER
jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?  

At HemoCue, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

HemoCue is a leading provider of point-of-care diagnostic solutions, enabling healthcare practitioners across clinical settings and geographies to improve patient outcomes and clinical workflows. For more than four decades we’ve been advancing what’s possible at the point of care. HemoCue offers point-of-care testing for hemoglobin, glucose and HbA1c as well as total and differential white blood cell count.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The HR Site Lead, LER, is responsible for driving labor and employee relations at the HemoCue headquarters site in Ängelholm, ensuring a compliant, constructive, and high-performing work environment. This role is central in managing union relations, advising leaders on employment matters, and safeguarding adherence to Swedish labor law and internal policies.

You will act as HR partner to leaders balancing business needs with legal and contractual obligations. As part of a global HR organization, you will collaborate closely with HR colleagues to ensure consistent, high-quality HR delivery while supporting a strong “one HR” approach in a matrix environment.

As HR Site Lead, LER, you will proactively drive initiatives that strengthen employee relations and contribute to sustainable organizational performance.

This role is based onsite in Ängelholm and reports to the Senior Director, Labor and Employee Relations, at Radiometer with a dotted line to Senior Director, HR at HemoCue.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

    Act as a trusted advisor to managers on employee relations cases.
    Lead and manage labor relations, including union negotiations, consultations, and relationship management with both white- and blue-collar unions.
    Maintain high standards of HR data accuracy and reporting, ensuring compliance with our QMS and audit readiness.
    Provide compliance and reporting activities.
    Conduct onboarding and offboarding activities.
    Managing hosted associates.
    Manage and drive HR projects that align with business objectives.

The essential requirements of the job include:

    Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or equivalent discipline.
    Proficiency in Swedish and English, written and verbally.
    5+ years of HR experience with a strong focus on labor and employee relations
    Strong knowledge of Swedish employment law and collective bargaining frameworks
    Proven experience in leading union negotiations and managing relationships with multiple unions
    Excellent IT skills (Office Package, HR Systems, AI)

Application

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to submit yours as soon as possible.

Please note that response time may be longer due to the summer holiday period.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Tarjoilija/kahvilatyöntekijä, Rosso Rovaniemi /Coffee House Rovaniemi
jobs.description:
Primary location:
ROVANIEMI

TARJOILIJA /KAHVILATYÖNTEKIJÄ
Rosso Rovaniemi /Coffee House Rovaniemi

Etsimme useita tarjoilijoita 40–75 h/3vk määräaikaisiin työsuhteisiin talvisesonkiin 2026–2027 Rosso -ravintolaan ja Coffee House -kahvilaan. Määräaikaisuuden kestot ovat noin marraskuusta maaliskuulle, sovittavissa hakijan mukaan.

Tehtävänkuva ja odotukset
Olet ystävällinen, hymyasenteella varustettu tekijätyyppi, joka haluaa hurmata asiakkaamme yhdessä työkavereiden kanssa. Palvelumme on laadukkaan välitöntä ja autamme tiimissä toinen toistamme onnistumaan. Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, ripeää mutta huolellista työskentelytapaa sekä myynnillistä asennetta.

Me Lapinmaan ravintoloissa valloitamme ihmiset hyvän palvelun, ruoan ja juoman avulla. Arvostamme aikaisempaa kokemusta tarjoilu- ja kahvilatehtävistä, mutta välttämätöntä se ei ole - perehdytämme sinut työskentelymenetelmiin ja talon tavoille huolellisesti. Täysi-ikäisyys, vähintään sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito sekä vuorotyömahdollisuus ovat edellytyksiä tarjoilijan tehtäviimme. Toimimme keskellä vilkkainta turistikatua, joten kaikesta kielitaidosta ja kulttuurituntemuksesta on sinulle etua.

Tule töihin poikkeuksellisen hyvään porukkaan. Meillä saat enemmän kuin työpaikan – saat myös kattavat henkilöstöedut

Meillä se tarkoittaa mm:
📌 Osaavaa tiimiä ja saumatonta yhteistyötä, mikä tuntuu ja näkyy asiakkaille asti.
📌 Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista. Tämä tarkoittaa alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta. Eduista voit lukea lisää TÄÄLTÄ
📌 Matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen tuntipalkan (13,70 €/h-15,04 €/h), jonka muodostumiseen vaikuttaa alan kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
📌 Mahdollisuuden tulospalkkioon, jopa 1,30 €/h. Isolla talolla on myös ison talon edut!

Tässä voi olla seuraava työpaikkasi, hae rohkeasti mukaan mahtavaan tiimiimme!
👉 Hakuaikaa on 31.8.2026 saakka. Kutsumme hakemuksien perusteella jatkoon valitut haastatteluun ja täytämme paikat sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Rovaniemen Coffee House on enemmän kuin kahvila – se on pala rakkautta ja kasa ammattitaitoa, aivan Rovaniemen keskustassa Lordin aukiolla – paras paikka viipymiseen ja viihtymiseen.
Rosso Rovaniemi on italialaistyylinen koko perheen ravintola, jossa herkutellaan klassikko grilliherkuilla, suosituilla pizzoilla ja maukkailla pastoilla - intohimona iloinen yhdessäolo ja täydellinen pizzanautinto.
Tsekkaa klassikkomme Rosso Rovaniemi ja Coffee House Rovaniemi

jobs.title: Research Engineer (fixed-term)
jobs.description:
Research Engineer (fixed-term)

We are now looking for a Research Engineer to join our Wood & Pulp Technology Team in the Group Innovation and R&D function. This is a fixed-term parental leave substitution from 1 September 2026 until 30 September 2027.

The location for the role is flexible. Ideally you are based in Sweden or Finland, however other European locations would be possible. The role reports to the Head of Wood & Pulp Technology.  

Be part of a nature positive future

The purpose of the role is to support wood innovation activities in Stora Enso. And to provide customers and colleagues with expert technical knowledge on the application and performance of CLT and LVL.  

Your main responsibilities include

    Providing engineering and wood processing expertise to help develop ideas, accelerate innovation projects, and solve problems  
    Supporting customers and sales by providing technical customer support in the use of CLT and LVL for construction
    Participating in project teams to deliver innovation projects to expected timescales, budgets, and desired deliverables
    Managing mass timber research activities
    Supporting colleagues on certification and building regulation requirements for mass timber products

About you

We are looking for a skilled professional who has the ambition for continuous improvement. You aim to be the best at what you do, share your knowledge and support others to succeed.

The successful candidate will have:

    Tertiary education and experience in wood science, civil / structural engineering or related fields
    Deep knowledge of mass timber products and their use in construction
    Strong communication skills, especially explaining scientific and technical topics in a way that non-experts can understand
    An analytical approach, basing decisions on facts and using data effectively
    Scientific and technical literacy and experience in research projects
    The ability to engage with a wide range of people and job roles and with external stakeholders
    Fluent written and spoken English. Fluency in Swedish is an advantage

What we offer 

You will be part of our diverse working culture which supports you in exploring new perspectives and developing professionally. You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as sustainability and innovation are at the core of our strategy. To keep you going safely, we support your physical and mental well-being. 

General benefits include:

    Career growth opportunities within an international organisation 
    Hybrid work options and flexible working hours 
    Access to modern technologies and digital tools 
    Professional development opportunities 
    Motivating additional benefits package 
    Inspiring, sustainable, and innovation-driven work environment 
    

Location specific benefits are also provided. These vary depending on the location and country of your employment.    

Join the Renewable Materials Company 

Stora Enso is the leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials, and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. Stora Enso has approximately 19,000 employees. 

You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that anything made from fossil-based materials today can be made from a tree tomorrow.

Watch our film: Be part of a nature positive future 

Read more about working at Stora Enso: Who we are - Careers | Stora Enso 

How can you apply for this role?

Please submit your application through our recruitment tool on our web site storaenso.com/careers . We review candidates on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, and no later than 9 August 2026. 

Our recruitment process can include pre-employment actions such as background, reference and health checks as well as a drug test.  

We believe diversity strengthens our competitiveness and contributes to better decision-making. Diverse working teams help us to explore different perspectives and challenge our way of thinking. We work actively to increase diversity in the workplace and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds. Stora Enso is an equal opportunity employer and follows non-discriminatory practices.

jobs.title: Directeur d'hôtel H/F (H/F)
jobs.description:
Notre client est un groupe hôtelier à taille humaine, multi-enseignes, exploitant plusieurs établissements sous franchises Accor et Louvre Hotels Group en France.
Nous recherchons pour un de leur établissement situé en région lyonnaise, leur futur :

Directeur d'hôtel H/F
CDI - Statut Cadre
Basé à Lyon
Plus de 150 chambres - Hôtellerie économique
Encadrement d'une 20aine de personnes

Vos motivations :
Vous souhaitez relever un véritable challenge de direction au sein d'un actif hôtelier à fort potentiel. Vous appréciez les environnements où tout reste à construire, où votre impact est visible et où les résultats dépendent directement de votre capacité à mobiliser les équipes et à mettre en œuvre des actions concrètes.
Vous aimez les postes terrain, avec une forte dimension opérationnelle, commerciale et managériale. Vous recherchez une structure à taille humaine vous laissant une réelle autonomie dans vos décisions tout en bénéficiant du soutien d'un groupe solide.

Vos missions :
Rattaché à la Direction des Exploitations, votre mission principale consiste à redonner une dynamique de performance à cet actif stratégique du groupe en activant l'ensemble des leviers opérationnels, commerciaux et humains.
- Développement commercial : définir et piloter le plan d'action commercial, développer les partenariats locaux, renforcer la visibilité de l'établissement, optimiser le mix clientèle et contribuer à l'amélioration durable du chiffre d'affaires.
- Revenue management et performance : En relation avec le revenue manager du groupe, suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (taux d'occupation, prix moyen, RevPAR, GOP), analyser les résultats, identifier les axes d'amélioration et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires.
- Management : recruter, encadrer, accompagner et fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs. Développer une culture de la performance, de l'engagement et de la satisfaction client.
- Exploitation : garantir le bon fonctionnement quotidien, veiller au respect des standards de marque, assurer la qualité de service et maintenir un haut niveau de satisfaction client.
- Gestion sociale : accompagner les évolutions organisationnelles du site et assurer un dialogue social constructif dans un contexte d'internalisation récente des équipes de ménage.
- Pilotage économique : élaborer et suivre les budgets, optimiser les charges d'exploitation et garantir la rentabilité des établissements.

Votre profil :
Issu d'une formation en hôtellerie, tourisme ou gestion, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative en direction d'hôtel ou en direction adjointe au sein d'établissements à forte capacité.
- Vous êtes reconnu pour votre forte orientation résultats et votre capacité à développer l'activité commerciale d'un établissement. Véritable manager de terrain, vous savez mobiliser les équipes, accompagner le changement et créer une dynamique positive dans des contextes exigeants.
- Doté d'une excellente culture opérationnelle, vous maîtrisez les enjeux de rentabilité, de revenue management et de satisfaction client. Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de leadership et d'une forte capacité d'analyse.

jobs.title: Wärtsilä: Sourcing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Type:** Full-time

**Location:** Vaasa

**Application deadline:** 10.8.2026

Interested in building more resilient supply chains through data and collaboration? Join Wärtsilä as a Sourcing Specialist and help secure reliable deliveries that enable a more sustainable future.

**Key responsibilities**

As a Sourcing Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring supply readiness and delivery performance across Wärtsilä's project portfolio. This is a newly established role where you will act as a key link between suppliers and internal stakeholders, helping ensure that critical supply chain information is visible, actionable, and up to date.

Your focus will be on supplier capacity, delivery performance, and supply risk management. You will analyse large data sets, maintain supplier performance and capacity information, and proactively identify risks that may impact project deliveries. By combining data analysis with close stakeholder collaboration, you will help improve delivery reliability and support informed decision-making across the sourcing organisation.

**Your responsibilities include:**

- Maintaining supplier capacity visibility aligned with project demand and sourcing plans

- Monitoring supplier performance, delivery reliability, and capacity constraints

- Building and maintaining supplier risk data and performance reporting

- Identifying, analysing, and communicating supply risks and mitigation actions

- Following up on late deliveries, shortages, and recovery plans, together with the purchasing teams

- Maintaining accurate supply and delivery information in SAP and other business systems

- Coordinating cross-functional communication and supporting data-driven decision-making

- Developing structured reporting, documentation, and supplier performance processes


**What makes you a great fit?**

We are looking for someone with a few years of experience in supply chain, purchasing, supply chain planning, or another relevant analytical role. You are comfortable working with large amounts of data, translating analysis into actionable insights, and coordinating with multiple stakeholders. You have a structured, proactive approach to work and enjoy improving processes in a fast-paced environment.

**We require you to have:**

- A relevant academic background in engineering, computer science, business administration, economics, or another relevant field

- A few years of experience in supply chain, purchasing, planning, analytics, or a similar role

- Experience with SAP or another ERP system, together with solid Excel skills

- Strong analytical skills and experience working with large data sets

- Full working proficiency in English


**We consider as an asset:**

- Previous experience in a global industrial or manufacturing environment

- Understanding of supplier performance management, capacity planning, or delivery coordination

- Familiarity with AI tools and an interest in applying them to everyday work

- Knowledge of Finnish and/or Swedish


**Wärtsilä offers you:**

- An opportunity to shape a new role with ownership of supplier performance and delivery-related processes

- The freedom to take initiative, improve ways of working, and develop more data-driven supply chain processes

- An international working environment where experienced colleagues support your growth and knowledge sharing is part of everyday work

- A collaborative culture where learning, continuous improvement, and trying new ideas are encouraged

- An opportunity to contribute to Wärtsilä's mission of enabling sustainable societies through innovation and technology


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, where you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. Start time in the role is as soon as possible. The role will be located in Vaasa, and we hope you are able to work at the office at least three days per week as part of a hybrid model.

**Does this sound like the next step in your career?**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format by latest 10th of August via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/372979/create/.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä Energy here: https://www.wartsila.com/energy. For more information about the recruitment process, contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Säde Juntunen (+358 44 901 2283, sade.juntunen(at)atalent.fi) 27.7.-31.7. and Senior Recruitment Consultant Kati Hautakoski (kati.hautakoski(at)atalent.fi, +358 50 552 0419) 3.8.-10.8. If were unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and well get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Rukakeskus Oy, Palvelupäällikkö uuteen elämyspalveluyksikköön
jobs.description:
**Haemme nyt Rukalle elämyspalveluiden palvelupäällikköä**

**Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa uutta elämyspalveluliiketoimintaa Rukatunturilla?**

Etsimme elämyspalveluiden palvelupäällikköä vastaamaan elämyspalveluidemme operatiivisesta toiminnasta, henkilöstöstä, turvallisuudesta sekä palveluiden ympärivuotisesta kehittämisestä. Tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan toimintaa yhdessä elämyspalveluiden ja hiihtokoulutoiminnan tiimin kanssa ja vaikuttamaan merkittävästi siihen, millaiseksi elämyspalvelukokonaisuutemme tulevaisuudessa muodostuu. Palvelupäällikkönä toimit keskeisessä roolissa varmistamassa, että asiakkaamme saavat turvallisia, laadukkaita ja mieleenpainuvia elämyksiä ympäri vuoden. Ensimmäisellä kaudella operoimme sähkökelkkasafareita, lumikenkä- ja pilkkiretkiä, revontuliretkiä ja sähköfatbike retkiä hiihtokoulun elämysten rinnalla. Yhdessä kehitämme elämyksiä, palveluita ja tuotteita asiakkaiden toiveiden ja palautteen pohjalta.

**Tehtäväsi**

Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat elämyspalveluiden päivittäisestä operatiivisesta toiminnasta sekä palveluiden kehittämisestä yhteistyössä muun organisaation kanssa.

**Keskeisiin tehtäviisi kuuluvat**

- Elämyspalveluiden päivittäisen operatiivisen toiminnan johtaminen ja sujuvuuden varmistaminen resurssien, kapasiteetin ja aikataulujen tehokkaalla organisoinnilla.

- Varmistat varaustietojen oikeellisuuden eri järjestelmissä ja ylläpidät varausjärjestelmien tuote-, hinta- ja kapasiteettitietoja.

- Esihenkilötyö ja työvuorosuunnittelu. Rakennat motivoitunutta, sitoutunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä työyhteisöä.

- Asiakaskokemuksen ja laadun varmistaminen myös sesonkien vilkkaimpina hetkinä

- Elämystuotteiden ja -palveluiden kehittäminen

- Elämyspalveluiden turvallisuuden johtaminen

- Yhteistyö muiden yksiköiden ja kumppaneiden kanssa


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Kokemusta matkailu-, ohjelmapalvelu- tai elämyspalveluliiketoiminnasta

- Esihenkilökokemusta, kykyä johtaa ja kannustaa henkilöstöä sesonkiympäristössä.

- Kokemusta palveluiden kehittämisestä ja tuotteistamisesta.

- Hyviä organisointi- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja.

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

- Kykyä toimia muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä sekä kehittää uusia toimintamalleja.

- Taitoja omaksua uusia digitaalisia järjestelmiä, ja sinulla on kokemusta varaus-, työvuorosuunnittelu- tai toiminnanohjausjärjestelmien käytöstä.

- Hyviä yhteistyö- ja suhdetoimintataitoja.

- B-ajokorttia


**Arvostamme lisäksi**

- Kokemusta kansainvälisestä toimintaympäristöstä

- Rukan aluetuntemusta

- Elämyspalveluiden ohjausosaamista tai kiinnostusta kouluttautua uusiin lajeihin ja ohjelmapalveluihin osana ympärivuotista toimintaa

- Halua osallistua myös käytännön ohjaus- ja opastustehtäviin silloin, kun se tukee asiakaskokemusta ja toiminnan sujuvuutta

- Joustavuutta kausiluonteisessa ja vaihtelevassa työympäristössä

- Kaupallista ajattelutapaa ja ymmärrystä kapasiteetin sekä resurssien tehokkaasta hyödyntämisestä


**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän matkailualan ytimessä, jossa voit kehittää myös omaa osaamistasi

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa palveluiden, toimintatapojen ja organisaation kehittämiseen.

- Ammattitaitoisen ja innostuneen työyhteisön ja tuen työssä menestymiseen

- Hyvät harrastusmahdollisuudet ja henkilöstöedut etenkin rinnelajien ja liikkumisen parissa


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi, CV:si ja palkkatoiveesi meille viimeistään 10.8.2026.

Työsuhde on **vakituinen ja kokoaikainen** ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin viimeistään lokakuun alussa 2026. Työ edellyttää paikan päällä työskentelyä Rukalla. Käytössämme on Hiihtokeskus TES ja palkkaus.

Suosittelemme jättämään hakemuksen mahdollisimman pian, sillä haastattelemme hakijoita myös ennen hakuajan päättymistä.

Lisätietoja antaa Hanna Tauriainen, hanna.tauriainen@ruka.fi

jobs.title: Rukakeskus Oy, Palvelupäällikkö Rukan Hiihtokoulu
jobs.description:
Etsimme Rukalle hiihtokoulun palvelupäällikköä, johtamaan ja kehittämään hiihtokoulutoimintaamme osana kasvavaa rinne- ja elämyspalvelukokonaisuutta.

Hiihtokoulullamme on vahvat perinteet, ja nyt rakennamme sen seuraavaa vaihetta osana ympärivuotista rinne- ja elämyspalvelukokonaisuutta. Haluamme kehittää toimintaamme vastaamaan kasvavan liiketoiminnan tarpeita, sujuvoittaa arkea ja rakentaa hiihtokoulusta entistä elämyksellisemmän palvelukokonaisuuden niin kansainvälisille kuin kotimaisille vieraillemme. Samalla vahvistamme ympärivuotista toimintaa kehittämällä uusia kesäelämyksiä, jotka tuovat esiin alueemme ainutlaatuisen luonnon, tunturiympäristön ja bike parkin monipuoliset mahdollisuudet.

Palvelupäällikkönä johdat hiihtokoulun päivittäistä toimintaa ja kehität sitä pitkäjänteisesti yhdessä henkilöstön, rinnetoiminnan ja elämyspalveluiden kanssa. Rakennat ja ylläpidät toimintamalleja, jotka tukevat sujuvaa arkea, selkeitä vastuita sekä laadukasta asiakas- ja henkilöstökokemusta osana koko hiihtokeskuksen palvelukokonaisuutta.

Palvelupäällikön tehtävässä:

- Toimit hiihtokoulun esihenkilönä ja johdat hiihtokoulun päivittäistä toimintaa ja varmistat sen sujuvuuden. Suunnittelet myös työvuoroja.

- Hiihtokoulun päivittäisen operatiivisen toiminnan johtaminen ja sujuvuuden varmistaminen resurssien, kapasiteetin ja aikataulujen tehokkaalla organisoinnilla.

- Huolehdit toiminnan laadusta myös sesonkien vilkkaimpina hetkinä.

- Tunnistat kehityskohteita ja viet muutokset käytäntöön.

- Rakennat motivoitunutta, sitoutunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä työyhteisöä.

- Osallistat henkilöstöä aktiivisesti toiminnan kehittämiseen.

- Varmistat laadukkaan, tasalaatuisen ja elämyksellisen hiihdonopetuksen.

- Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä ja kehität palveluita yhdessä rinne-, myynti- ja elämyspalvelutiimien kanssa.

- Rakennat hiihtokoulusta vahvan osan koko hiihtokeskuksen palvelukokonaisuutta.


Etsimme sinua, joka

- olet hankkinut kokemusta operatiivisesta esihenkilötyöstä tai palveluliiketoiminnan johtamisesta. Kokemus hiihtokoulutoiminnasta ja hiihdonopetuksesta katsotaan eduksi.

- kehität toimintaa käytännönläheisesti ja viet muutokset onnistuneesti osaksi arkea.

- johdat ihmisiä valmentavalla, osallistavalla ja tavoitteellisella otteella.

- osaat organisoida toimintaa, priorisoida tekemistä ja pitää kokonaisuuden hallinnassa myös kiireisimpinä sesonkeina.

- ymmärrät asiakaskokemuksen merkityksen palveluliiketoiminnassa

- toimit luontevasti yhteistyössä eri tiimien ja sidosryhmien kanssa.

- omaa kokemusta työvuorosuunnittelusta ja palvelualojen työehtosopimus on sinulle tuttu (hiihtokeskus TES tuntemus katsotaan eduksi).

- omaksut nopeasti uusia digitaalisia järjestelmiä, ja sinulla on kokemusta varaus-, työvuorosuunnittelu- tai toiminnanohjausjärjestelmien käytöstä.

- kommunikoit sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.


Arvostamme lisäksi:

- hiihdonopettajan koulutusta tai muuta lumilajien ohjausosaamista ja kiinnostusta kouluttautua uusiin lajeihin ja ohjelmapalveluihin osana ympärivuotista toimintaa.

- halua osallistua myös käytännön ohjaustehtäviin silloin, kun se tukee asiakaskokemusta ja toiminnan sujuvuutta.

- kiinnostusta ympärivuotisten palveluiden ja uusien elämysten kehittämiseen

- kaupallista ajattelutapaa ja ymmärrystä kapasiteetin sekä resurssien tehokkaasta hyödyntämisestä


Tarjoamme sinulle

- mahdollisuuden kehittää hiihtokoulua osana kasvavaa ympärivuotista rinne- ja elämyspalvelukokonaisuutta sekä olla rakentamassa uudenlaisia palveluita kotimaisille ja kansainvälisille vieraille.

- monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän Rukan matkailualueen ytimessä, jossa voit kehittää myös omaa osaamistasi

- ammattitaitoisen ja innostuneen työyhteisön ja tuen työssä menestymiseen

- upeat harrastusmahdollisuudet ja henkilöstöedut etenkin rinnelajien ja liikkumisen parissa


Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi, CV:si ja palkkatoiveesi meille viimeistään 10.8.2026.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin viimeistään syyskuussa 2026. Työ edellyttää paikan päällä työskentelyä Rukalla. Käytössämme on Hiihtokeskus TES ja palkkaus.

Suosittelemme jättämään hakemuksen mahdollisimman pian, sillä haastattelemme hakijoita myös ennen hakuajan päättymistä ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja antaa Hanna Tauriainen, hanna.tauriainen@ruka.fi

jobs.title: People & Culture Manager
jobs.description:
Join us to deliver a smoke- free future as People & Culture Manager!

We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future with one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

About Swedish Match

Swedish Match develops, manufactures and sells high-quality smoke-free products. In the Nordic region, we are 1,800 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics.

In 2023, the company became part of Philip Morris International, and our products are now the cornerstone of the newly formed global category for oral smoke-free products. Please read more about us at www.swedishmatch.com and www.pmi.com.

Our two Swedish factories are located in the Gothenburg area, and we are now looking for a dynamic People & Culture Manager for our factory in Kungälv. In this pivotal role, you will support our ongoing transformation by driving people initiatives, strengthening organizational effectiveness, and enabling business success in a rapidly evolving environment.

Your role

As People & Culture Manager, you will be a trusted partner to the factory management team and will provide both strategic and operational People & Culture support, partnering closely with leaders across the factory.

You will be part of a collaborative and engaged People & Culture team of four, supporting Operations across the Nordics. Reporting to the Sr Manager People & Culture Nordics, you will be based at our factory in Kungälv and work closely with People & Culture colleagues in Gothenburg, Stockholm, and Silkeborg, Denmark.



Your Main Responsibilities

    Partner with factory leadership team to translate business needs into clear people priorities and plans
    Build managerial capabilities and coach managers on change, organizational design, performance, employee relations and rewards
    Lead and support labor relations, union negotiations and compliance with Swedish employment practices
    Drive workforce planning, competence development, succession planning and talent initiatives
    Work with managers to build a positive work environment by planning and implementing initiatives that improve collaboration, employee well-being, and inclusion
    In collaborations with subject matter experts, contribute to the development and roll-out of P&C policies and programs (e.g., talent, L&D, compensation, etc.)
    Analyze and interpret key people data to identify trends and talent needs; communicate findings and recommendations to the business



Who you are:

    You are an experienced HR professional with a bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Organization Development or equivalent
    You bring at least five years of HR Business Partner experience from a multinational organization, preferably in a production environment
    You build trusted relationships, influence stakeholders and coach leaders with confidence
    You have a broad HR toolbox, including talent and performance management, organizational development, change management, labor relations, learning and employee engagement
    You combine strong execution with an analytical mindset, using people data to identify trends and recommend actions
    You have sound knowledge of Swedish labor law and experience in union negotiations
    You communicate clearly and confidently in both English and Swedish
    

Please note that relocation support is not available for this role.

What We Offer

Our success depends on the dedicated people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join us at Swedish Match and you too can:

    Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to experiment, explore and learn.
    Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.
    Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke-free future.
    Join an inclusive and diverse culture where every contribution is valued, collaboration is encouraged, and everyone can feel they belong.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description:
ETSIMME LAHDEN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON OSA-AIKAISEEN TYÖHÖN

MITÄ KOTIHOIDON TYÖ SISÄLTÄÄ?

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Perushoito ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn ja hyvinvoinnin tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa. Työ sopii myös opiskelijalle.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE?

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää laajasti omaa osaamistasi

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

jobs.title: Åpen søknad:  2 Selgere søkes til [50%]
jobs.description:
Vi søker to selgere som trives i kontakten med kundene, bak kassa, elsker å selge mat og drikke til travle kunder, og som ønsker å bidra til et entusiastisk og godt arbeidsmiljø.

Som selger i Narvesen vil du få varierte arbeidsoppgaver, en hektisk hverdag og gode kolleger som fort kan bli venner for livet. Hvis du har et lite konkurranseinnstinkt, tipper vi at du vil ha det gøy med alle salgskonkurransene vi kjører!

Hvem er du?
Kanskje du har butikkerfaring, eller du er klar for din første jobb i butikk? Uansett kan du være den riktige for jobben, så lenge du er

  • effektiv. Du takler stress godt, og liker høyt tempo
  • selvstendig. Du trives med å ha ansvar, og finner lett egne løsninger
  • glad i mennesker. Du får påfyll i møte med kundene, og bryr deg om hver eneste en
  • et ordensmenneske. Du liker å ha det rent og ryddig rundt deg
  • positiv. Du er en humørspreder – blant kolleger så vel som kunder

Hvorfor Narvesen?
Som en del av REITAN CONVENIENCE, har vi alltid vært opptatt av å bygge en vennlig kultur. Ditt gode humør smitter over på kundene, og vi vet at når de er glade og fornøyde vender de også tilbake. Ja, Narvesen stiller krav til deg som selger, men vi vil også at du skal ha høye forventninger til oss.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!


Narvesen er den originale kiosken i Norge. Vi har vært en del av hverdagen til det norske folk siden 1894. I dag er vi en fleksibel, smidig og fremoverlent convenience-kjede som leder utviklingen fremover med stadig nye tanker, ideer og løsninger. Vi er der for dem som raskt og enkelt ønsker å forenkle hverdagen på en måte som gir god samvittighet. Våre kunder er på farten, og vi skal hjelpe dem med påfyll i en ellers så travel hverdag. Narvesen er en del av Reitan Convenience Norway.

jobs.title: Kombinert Utleierepresentant (deltid)
jobs.description:
Arbeidssted: Sola lufthavn

Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (dag, kveld og helg)

Oppstart: Så snart som mulig - intervjuer kjøres forløpende

Stillingsprosent: 40 - 60 prosent

Stillingsprosent kan tilpasses den rette kandidaten.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du ansvarlig for å levere våre tjenester på en best mulig måte til våre kunder. Hverdagen består av utstrakt kundekontakt både ansikt til ansikt og pr. telefon og mail. Vi leverer en service hvor kundens behov alltid er i fokus. Videre er du også ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til vår standard. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg. Logistikk, klargjøring, salg og kundeservice er kjernen i hverdagen. 

  • Klargjøring av utleiebiler (vask mm)

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Presentasjon og innsalg av våre produkter til kunde på en best mulig måte

  • Håndtere telefon og epost henvendelser 

  • Organisere daglige reservasjoner i forhold til tilgjengelig flåte

  • Rapportering og annet forefallende kontorarbeid

Kvalifikasjoner

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du den våre kunder møter hver dag. Du representerer Sixt Bilutleie og er genuint opptatt av service og trives med kundekontakt. Vi stiller høye krav til våre produkter og hvordan vi presenterer disse, med ett ønske om å overgå kundens forventinger. Du har også ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer. Hverdagen styres av kundens behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. Ved å levere en premium opplevelse, er du med å bygger Norges beste bilutleiekjede.    

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (Politiattest)

  • Genuin serviceinnstilling og gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter

  • Gode salgs ferdigheter

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor arbeidskapasitet (også ved fysisk arbeid)

  • Strukturert og evne til å styre logistikk i en stadig skiftende/hektisk hverdag

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Chef, seasons 2026-2027, Northern Finland, Lapland Hotels
jobs.description:
Are you ready for a winter youll never forget? Imagine working above the Arctic Circle, surrounded by pure nature, snow-covered forests, and the calm of Lapland. Your days are spent creating high-quality food, and your free-time could mean chasing the Northern Lights, visit Santa Claus, skiing, or relaxing in a traditional sauna.

StaffPoint is currently seeking passionate CHEFS to well-known Lapland Hotels-chains hotels and ski centers around Lapland. The role involves supporting the Chef de Partie, Sous-Chef or Chef de Cuisine with daily food preparation to meet the set standards and quality levels of our client, the Lapland Hotels-chain in northern Finland.

Choose your season in Lapland:

- Join us for a short, intensive Christmas season

- Or commit to the full winter season 2026–2027 (approximately November–April)

You can work with us in the following locations in Lapland: Kilpisjärvi, Luosto, Rovaniemi, Pallas, Ylläs, Levi, Hetta, Saariselkä or Olos.

What we offer:

- The possibility of accommodation through Lapland Hotels

- Staffpoint and Lapland Hotels personnel benefits

- A lively and international work environment

- Many winter leisure opportunities in beautiful Lapland

- A memorable season that stands out on your CV

What we require:

- EU citizenship/passport or a valid working permit for Finland

- Minimum of two years' experience of working in a restaurant as chef

- Finnish Hygiene certificate (We can provide assistance with applying for a certificate)

- Strong understanding of food safety and kitchen procedures

- Ability to work efficiently in a fastpaced role


How to apply:

Add your CV to your application to speed up the recruitment process! Please note that if you are applying with a friend, both applicants must submit their own application. If you meet our standards, you will first receive an invitation to a video interview and a Refapp request for recommendations.

Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland!

Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

Lapland Hotels includes 20 hotels, over 2,600 rooms and apartments, and more than 11,000 restaurant seats throughout Finland: in Ylläs, Levi, Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Olos, Luosto, Kilpisjärvi, Pallas, and Hetta, as well as in Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, and Kartano & Spa Hotel Haikko in Porvoo.

Lapland Safaris offers unique nature activities in Lapland's five locations: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Levi, and Luosto. An essential part of the safari selection is dog sledding experiences, which are provided by Lapland Husky Safaris, a member of the same tourism group. The company is the largest operator in its field in Finland and has four kennels in Rovaniemi, Luosto, Saariselkä, and Muonio. Lapland Ski Resorts consists of five ski resorts located in Ylläs, Luosto, Olos, Pallas, and Rovaniemi

Email: pohjoinen@staffpoint.fi

More information and details: pohjoinen@staffpoint.fi

Please fill the online application, attach your CV, certifications and recommendation letters.

More info of the Lapland Hotels-company:https://www.laplandhotels.com/EN/

jobs.title: Project Planner, Granlund
jobs.description:
**We are now looking for a Project Planner to join Granlunds industrial and data center projects!**

**_Granlund_** _is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland._

**Would you be our new Project Planner?**

As a Project Planner at Granlund, you will take responsibility for project schedules and project controls in complex construction, data center, and industrial projects. Acting as the Project Managers right hand, you will play a central role in supporting project leadership, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring that projects progress according to plan throughout their lifecycle.

You will work closely with Project Managers, Project Engineers, clients, designers, contractors, and other key stakeholders. Your responsibilities include developing and maintaining project schedules, supporting decision-making through project data and reporting, and ensuring that information flows effectively between different parties. Within projects, you will also guide the work of project engineers and help keep project teams aligned around common goals and timelines.

The role combines project planning, coordination, and leadership. Depending on the project portfolio, you may be responsible for one major project or several smaller projects simultaneously. Projects range from commercial developments to large-scale data center projects, with durations varying from a few months to several years.

The position is a full-time and permanent role, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The role offers a highly flexible working model with the possibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland. You may also work from any Granlund office according to your own preference. Occasional travel to project sites, typically around once per month, is expected as part of the role.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for a construction professional with a strong understanding of how projects move from planning to execution. You have experience in project management, project planning, site management or another project-oriented role within the construction industry. Most importantly, you understand how construction projects are delivered and how different stakeholders, phases, and dependencies come together throughout the project lifecycle.

A relevant educational background in construction or engineering is preferred. You may hold a degree as a Construction Engineer, Bachelor of Engineering or Master of Science in Engineering. You communicate fluently in Finnish and have a good working knowledge of English.

As a person, you are honest, collaborative, and proactive. You are able to communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels and are comfortable taking ownership of your work. You combine a humble attitude with a structured and solution-oriented approach and enjoy working as part of a professional team where knowledge is shared and success is achieved together.

**Why join us?**

At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and industrial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.

**Are you interested?**

Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 16.8.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period.

**Would you be our new Site Supervisor?**

As a Site Supervisor, you will represent the client on site and take responsibility for supervising construction activities within your own technical discipline. Your role is to ensure that work is carried out according to design specifications, quality standards, project schedules and safety requirements while acting as the client's eyes and ears throughout the construction phase. Just as importantly, you will serve as the link between the construction site and the wider project organisation. You will communicate real-time information from site helping stakeholders make informed decisions and ensuring issues are identified and resolved early. You will monitor progress, verify completed work, document inspections and testing, escalate deviations and support the successful delivery of large-scale projects.

This is a highly site-based role, with nearly all working time spent on construction sites across Finland, primarily in large data centre and infrastructure projects. The role requires willingness to work away from home for extended periods, either through fly-in/fly-out arrangements or by relocating closer to the project site. Accommodation is provided by the employer based on project needs. You understand construction practices within your own technical discipline and are confident monitoring quality, safety and compliance on site. As the role is based on active site supervision, you enjoy working in the field and are willing to travel and stay at project locations across Finland when required. As the role requires daily collaboration with both site personnel and the wider project organisation, fluency in both Finnish and English is essential.

As a person, you are proactive, well organised and confident communicating with people from different backgrounds. You take ownership of your work, are not afraid to raise concerns related to quality or safety and understand the importance of accurate documentation and timely communication in complex construction projects.
