jobs.title: Ohjaaja Taitola Itäkeskus, Helsinki
jobs.description:
**Taitola hoivapalvelut Oy** järjestää päiväaikaista toimintaa kehitysvammaisille ja vammaisille. Toimimme tällä hetkellä Jyväskylässä, Äänekoskella, Tampereella, Helsingissä ja Joutsenossa.

Toiminnan tavoitteena on aitojen arjen taitojen tukeminen. Päiväaikaisessa toiminnassa harjoitellaan säännöllistä työn ja vapaa-ajan rytmittämistä ja käynnistetään yksilöllinen matka kohti tavoitteita ja unelmia. Toimintaamme ohjaa yksilöllinen suunnitelma, jossa huomioidaan yksilön vahvuudet, innostuksen kohteet ja kehittämistarpeet.

Tehtävänämme on tuottaa laadukasta sisältöä arkeen mm. liikunnan, taiteen, kädentaitojen sekä ilmaisutaitojen avulla. Palvelujen järjestämisessä noudatamme osallisuutta ja työllistymistä edistävän toiminnan laatukriteerejä. Asiakkaamme ohjautuvat meille hyvinvointialueen vammaispalvelun kautta.

**Etsimme Taitola Itäkeskukseen päiväaikaisen toiminnan yksikköön ohjaajia.**

Työtä on tarjolla joustavasti **osa- ja kokoaikaisesti** elämäntilanteesi sekä asiakkaidemme tarpeiden mukaan. Mahdollisuus myös keikkaluontoiseen työhön tai lyhyempiin määräaikaisuuksiin.

Työssäsi vahvistat asiakkaan omien valintojen tekemistä ja arjen taitoja. Asiakkaillamme ontuen tarpeita sosiaalisissa tilanteissa, kommunikaatiossa sekä itsetuntemuksessa ja tunnetaidoissa.Toimintamme on yksilöllistä ja samaan aikaan yhteisöllistä, huomioiden asiakkaiden voimavarat, vireystilan ja vahvuudet. Työnkuvaasi kuuluu toiminnan suunnittelu ja kehittäminen yhdessä työryhmän ja asiakkaiden kanssa.

**Edellytämme sinulta:**

- vähintään sosiaali- ja/tai terveysalan perustutkintoa (esim. lähihoitaja)

- kokemusta työskentelystä paljon tukea tarvitsevien kehitysvammaisten ja autismikirjon henkilöiden kanssa

- valmiutta osallistua myös perushoitoon

- kokemusta ja kykyä toimia haastavissa ja yllättävissä tilanteissa

- erinomaisia tiimityötaitoja

- hyvää suomen kielen taitoa


Sinulla tulee olla tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukainen rokotussuoja ja ennen työn aloitusta tehty tuberkuloosiselvitys (55 §).

Tehtävässä edellytetään myös rikostaustaotteen esittämistä (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

**Palkkaus:** Ohjaajan palkkaluokka G23D, 2762,58 € – 3011,25 € /kk tai 16,95€/h - 18,47€/h

**Näiden lisäksi arvostamme:**

\- monipuolista kokemusta vammaistyöstä

\- kehittämismyönteisyyttä ja positiivista työotetta

\- monipuolista osaamista mm. taiteen ja liikunnan alalta

\- monipuolista kielitaitoa

\- voimassa olevan lääkehoidon koulutuksen (LOP + PKV + Laskut) suorittaminen katsotaan eduksi

\-MAPA tai AVEKKI-koulutusta

Taitolassa työtä tehdään iloisella otteella, ja arvomme näkyvät käytännön työssä. Ne ovat: **Aito asiakaslähtöisyys – Yksilöllisesti arvokas arki – Osallistava yhteisöllisyys – Ekologisuus**. **Miksi juuri meille töihin?**

Taitolassa saat:

\- monipuolista ohjaustyön kokemusta

\- toiminnallisen ja uusia toimintatapoja etsivän työympäristön

\- tilaisuuden kehittää päiväaikaista toimintaa ja omaa työskentelyä yhdessä työryhmän kanssa.

\- koulutusmyönteisen ilmapiirin

\- säännöllisen päivätyön

\- Muita vaihtuvia henkilöstöetuja

Jos haluat päästä toteuttamaan nykyaikaista päiväaikaista toimintaa ja osaamistasi aidosti arvostavassa työpaikassa, niin lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus ansioluettelon (cv) kanssa: sami.niemi-ruuth@taitola.fi. Ilmoita hakemuksen **otsikossa "Hakemus, Ohjaaja, Taitola Itäkeskus"**.

Tehtävässä aloitussopimuksen mukaan. Toivomme nopeaa työaloitusta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja kutsumme sopivat henkilöt haastatteluun mahdollisesti jo hakuajan puitteissa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa 3.8. alkaen yksikön johtaja Sami Niemi-Ruuth arkisin klo 13.00–14.30 välillä, p. 044902 4468 ja 27.7.-31.7. palvelujohtaja Aija Iljinen arkisin 8-14.30 välillä p. 0445101269.

jobs.title: Vývojári a analytici softvéru a aplikácií inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
As an end to end info logistics provider, we pride ourselves on offering a comprehensive portfolio of air, sea, land transport, and warehousing services. With a unique focus on information technology and supply chain optimization, we empower businesses to thrive in today's fast-paced world.

For over 40 years, cargo-partner has flourished in the logistics industry, delivering unparalleled service to our clients worldwide. We have now embarked on another journey and to continue our commitment for excellence, we have now joined the Nippon Express Group which will now underpin all the values we constantly aspire to achieve, now becoming a top 5 global player.



Join us as a Junior EDI & AI Support Engineer and help shape how our systems connect, communicate, and get smarter. You’ll support real integration projects, help onboard customers into our IT landscape, and explore how AI can streamline the way data flows across the company.

Working alongside experienced engineers, you’ll learn how to turn requirements into working solutions and get hands-on with modern integration and AI‑driven tools.



This position is ideal if you’re a final‑year student or a recent graduate ready to start full‑time work. A background in EDI, system integration, or AI‑related technologies is beneficial but not required.


What you’ll do:

Support integration development - Assist in building and maintaining EDI/API integrations under guidance from senior engineers.
Participate in customer onboarding - Help prepare and execute smooth onboarding of clients into our IT systems.
Analyze integration requirements - Contribute to gathering and understanding technical and business needs for integration tasks.
Work with middleware tools - Learn to configure and monitor integration platforms and mapping tools.
Support workflow optimization - Assist in improving data flows and ensuring reliable, efficient exchange of information.
Explore AI-enhanced processes - Collaborate with the AI team to test and integrate basic ML-driven features into workflows.
Troubleshoot integration issues - Help investigate and resolve operational issues in data exchange and integrations.

•    Assist internal customers with achieving corporate objectives, including key aim of zero lost time accidents

•    Develop and implement Lock out, tag out system in the plant

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Máš rád pohyb, silový tréning a chceš pomáhať ľuďom zbaviť sa bolesti a zlepšiť kvalitu života? Nezáleží na tom, či už si skúsený tréner alebo len stojíš na začiatku svojej cesty. Ak máš správny prístup, chuť učiť sa a pracovať na sebe, radi ti pomôžeme vyrásť. V Bratislave – Rači otvárame nové prémiové tréningové centrum ATG Slovakia s rozlohou 562 m2, postavené na princípoch funkčného silového tréningu, dlhovekosti kĺbov a pohybu bez bolesti. Naším cieľom je vytvoriť miesto, ktoré spája výhody -vedenie a usmerňovanie klientov počas semi-privátnych tréningov, -dohľad nad správnou technikou cvičenia, -vedenie individuálnych (1-on-1) tréningov, -pomoc pri každodennom fungovaní centra, -podieľanie sa na rozvoji ATG Slovakia podľa svojich silných stránok. Neočakávame desiatky certifikátov ani dlhoročnú prax. Omnoho viac si ceníme charakter, pracovnú morálku a ochotu napredovať. Ideálny kandidát: má úprimný záujem pomáhať ľuďom zlepšovať ich zdravie, pohyb a výkon, šport je prirodzenou súčasťou jeho života a má vlastné tréningové skúsenosti, chce sa neustále vzdelávať a profesijne rásť, je spoľahlivý, disciplinovaný a vie fungovať v tíme, nebojí sa prevziať zodpovednosť a prispieť k budovaniu výnimočného projektu.
Výhody:Školenie prácu v úplne novom prémiovom centre s viac ako 400 m2 tréningovej plochy, špeciálne ATG vybavenie, centrálnu trávnatú zónu a moderné silové stanovištia, priame mentorstvo od ATG Level 3 trénera, systematické vzdelávanie a možnosť získať jedinečné know-how, účasť na odborných seminároch doma aj v zahraničí, spoluprácu s európskym centrom ATG Europe možnosť dlhodobého kariérneho rastu,

Súčasťou tejto práce je taktiež:

Pravidelná technická údržba, čistenie a nastavovanie strojnotechnologických zariadení ČOV, odstraňovanie bežných prevádzkových porúch a spolupráca s externými servisnými technikmi.

Sledovanie a hodnotenie environmentálnych aspektov a rizík vyplývajúcich z výroby a návrh opatrení na ich minimalizáciu.

Navrhovanie optimalizačných a technických riešení, spolupráca pri príprave a posudzovaní projektovej dokumentácie.

Poskytovanie odbornej súčinnosti interným oddeleniam, školenie zamestnancov v oblasti environmentálnych požiadaviek a kontrola dodržiavania predpisov na pracovisku.

Zabezpečenie súladu činností spoločnosti s platnou legislatívou.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti sociálnej práce a poradenstva
jobs.description:
Sme tím ľudí, ktorí sa na ulicu pozerajú inými očami a veria, že aj malé kroky môžu prinášať veľké zmeny. Do nášho nízkoprahového denného centra pre ľudí bez domova hľadáme inštruktora/ku sociálnej rehabilitácie, ktorý/á bude mať na starosti: - Individuálnu a skupinovú sociálnu rehabilitácia, so zameraním na rozvoj praktických, sociálnych a pracovných zručností, ktoré podporia klientov k samostatnosti, nezávislosti a sebestačnosti - Poskytovanie podpory a motivácie v procese minimalizácie rizík v životnej situácii klienta, posilňovanie zodpovednosti, sebavedomia a dôvery vo vlastné schopnosti. - Prípravu a realizáciu voľnočasových aktivít a praktických tréningov pre klientov. - Vedenie a vyhodnocovanie personalizovaných rehabilitačných plánov klientov sociálnej služby. - Úzku spoluprácu so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, odbornými zamestnancami a ďalšími členmi tímu. Rozvrh pracovného času: Práca je rozvrhnutá na 40h týždenne od pondelka do piatka s pružným pracovným časom. Kto sme? Naša sociálna práca stojí na princípoch nízkoprahového prístupu a harm reduction – snažíme sa byť čo najbližšie k človeku, jeho možnostiam a realite života na ulici. Služba je dostupná pre každého bez rozdielov – aj pre ľudí bez dokladov, bez finančných prostriedkov či pod vplyvom návykových látok. Každého prijímame bez hodnotenia, vytvárame bezpečný priestor a budujeme dôveru, ktorá umožňuje postupné sprevádzanie k zmene v tempe, ktoré je pre človeka v danej situácii zvládnuteľné.
Výhody:1200 - 1350 EUR mesiac V prípade dosiahnutého VŠ vzdelania v určených odboroch mzda 1250 EUR brutto a s min. ročnou skúsenosťou 1350 EUR brutto . V prípade absolvovaného akreditovaného kurzu mzda 1200 EUR brutto a s min. ročnou skúsenosťou 1300 EUR brutto . V našej organizácii Ti ponúkame: - Sickdays zdravotné platené voľno nad rámec dovolenky - dovolenka navyše za odpracované roky - MultiSport karta s príspevkom zamestnávateľa - pravidelné skupinové aj individuálne supervízie, praktické školenia počas roka - 20percent zľava na vybrané predstavenia SND v Bratislave - zvýhodnená celoročná registrácia v Staromestskej knižnici v Bratislave - odmena pri uzatvorení manželstva, narodení dieťaťa, za odpracované roky - zamestnaneckú pôžičku - rekreačný a športový príspevok po 2 rokoch - krátkodobé vypožičania služobného auta na súkromné účely Predovšetkým Ti však ponúkame: - individuálnu a cielenú podporu v rámci procesu zaúčania nového zamestnanca tzv. buddy systém - priestor na vzdelávanie a rozvoj - prácu v podporujúcom a ľudskom kolektíve, ktorá má ZMYSEL - možnosť NAHLIADNUŤ HLBŠIE do života ľudí so skúsenosťou so životom na ulici

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti stratégie a rozvoja
jobs.description:
Obchod nie je len o predaji. Je o dôvere, vzťahoch a príležitostiach. Do nášho tímu hľadáme človeka, ktorý vie nadväzovať nové kontakty, budovať dlhodobé partnerstvá a hľadá riešenia, ktoré prinášajú spokojnosť klientom aj výsledky spoločnosti. Ak máš obchodného ducha, baví ťa komunikácia a chceš pracovať v prostredí hotelierstva, kongresov a eventov, radi ťa spoznáme. Čo bude tvojou úlohou? - aktívne vyhľadávať nové obchodné príležitosti a získavať nových klientov, - budovať a rozvíjať dlhodobé vzťahy s obchodnými partnermi, - prezentovať hotel a naše služby firemným klientom, agentúram a organizátorom podujatí, - pripravovať obchodné ponuky na mieru a viesť obchodné rokovania, - spolupracovať s jednotlivými oddeleniami hotela pri realizácii podujatí, - sledovať trendy na trhu a prichádzať s novými obchodnými príležitosťami, - podieľať sa na plnení obchodných cieľov a ďalšom rozvoji hotela, - organizovať konferencie, firemné stretnutia, oslavy aj výnimočné eventy.
Výhody:ubytovanie, Prémie 25 percent zo základného platu 1400 €, t.j. do 350 € podľa prémiového poriadku spoločnosti. Štvrťročné odmeny na základe dosiahnutého hospodárskeho výsledku. Čo ponúkame? ✨ Prácu, pri ktorej budeš stretávať zaujímavých ľudí a podieľať sa na realizácii výnimočných podujatí. Okrem toho môžeš očakávať: - stabilné zázemie úspešnej spoločnosti, - motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie vrátane bonusovej zložky, - priestor na vlastnú iniciatívu a realizáciu nápadov, - profesionálny tím, ktorý si navzájom pomáha, - možnosti odborného a kariérneho rastu, - zamestnanecké benefity a zvýhodnené využívanie hotelových služieb, - príjemné pracovné prostredie Prečo práve Kubínska Resorts? Sme Kubínska Resorts – spoločnosť, ktorá zastrešuje tri jedinečné hotely. Každý z nich má svoj charakter, klientelu aj príbehy. Práve preto u nás nezažiješ stereotyp. Jeden deň pripravuješ obchodné stretnutie pre firemnú konferenciu, kongres, ďalší teambuilding či firemnú lyžovačku. Hľadáme človeka, na ktorého sa môžeme spoľahnúť. Obchodný manažér je partnerom nielen našich klientov, ale aj celého tímu. Oceníme zodpovednosť, spoľahlivosť, schopnosť dotiahnuť veci do konca a prirodzený cit pre budovanie dlhodobých vzťahov. Ak si energický, rád komunikuješ, nebojíš sa výziev a baví ťa rozmanitá práca, u nás dostaneš priestor realizovať vlastné nápady, ovplyvňovať obchodné výsledky a byť súčasťou spoločnosti, ktorá sa neustále rozvíja. Nehľadáme len kolegu. Hľadáme človeka, ktorý chce rásť spolu s nami. Ak si sa v tomto opise našiel našla, pošli svoj životopis. Tešíme sa, že sa spoznáme.

Ak v sebe cítiš túto schopnosť, u nás nájdeš miesto, kde ju môžeš naplno využiť.

Zamestnanecké výhody, benefity
•    Stabilná práca v renomovanom slovenskom vinárstve s istotou dlhodobého zamestnania.
•    Gastrokarta, ktorá ponúka stravné vo výške 9,30 €/deň (s príspevkom zamestnanca 1,50 €).

Vašou každodennou úlohou bude:
•    Nastavovanie a kalibrácia: Príprava a prestavovanie plniacej linky pre rôzne formáty fliaš a typy etikiet.

jobs.title: Pracovníci zabezpečujúci starostlivosť o zvieratá
jobs.description:
Pracovná pozícia je zameraná na každodennú starostlivosť o kone a chod stajňového hospodárstva. Zamestnanec zabezpečuje základné potreby zvierat a podieľa sa na udržiavaní ich zdravia a kondície.

Hlavné pracovné činnosti:

kŕmenie koní podľa stanovených dávok a režimu,
zabezpečenie pitného režimu (dopĺňanie vody),
čistenie boxov, stajní a výbehov,
ošetrovanie koní (čistenie srsti, kopýt, sedlanie),
vyvádzanie koní do výbehov alebo na pastvu,
dohľad nad zdravotným stavom koní a hlásenie zmien,
asistencia pri veterinárnych zákrokoch a podkúvaní,
príprava koní na jazdu alebo tréning,
údržba jazdeckého vybavenia (sedlá, uzdy a pod.),
udržiavanie poriadku v areáli stajne.

Práca je fyzicky náročná, vykonáva sa prevažne vonku a vyžaduje si zodpovedný prístup, spoľahlivosť a pozitívny vzťah k zvieratám. Často zahŕňa aj prácu cez víkendy a sviatky.

jobs.title: DesiMixTape
jobs.description:
AI-powered Indian music discovery

Indian music, made easier to discover and mix.

DesiMixTape explored an AI-powered home for discovering Indian music across genres and eras, creating personal mixes, and sharing playlists with a community.

Explore the product thesis See how it works

Indian music discovery AI-assisted mixes Community playlists

Discover Genres, eras, and artists

Create Personal mixes

Listen Track previews

Share Playlists and community

Built around discovery Explore Indian music across genres, languages, artists, and musical eras.

Designed for making Move from finding tracks to arranging and saving a personal mix.

Community-aware Share playlists and discover what other listeners are putting together.

The product thesis

A cultural discovery layer, not another generic music catalogue.

DesiMixTape began with a simple question: how might discovery feel if Indian musicânot a global catalogue with an India filterâwere the centre of the experience?

The product brought discovery, previews, playlists, mix creation, and sharing into one music journey. Its AI layer was intended to help listeners cross familiar boundaries between genres and eras while keeping people in control of what they assembled and shared.

Discover music

Explore a broad collection of Indian music through artists, genres, moods, and eras.

Create mixes

Collect, order, and save tracks as a personal playlist with AI assistance.

Preview and refine

Listen as you browse and adjust a mix before deciding what belongs.

Share and connect

Publish a mix for friends and discover playlists assembled by other listeners.

Product approach

From discovery to a mix worth sharing.

DesiMixTape brings the core music journey into one focused experience: discover across Indian music, collect tracks, shape a personal mix, and share it with other listeners.

01

Discover

Explore Indian music through genres, eras, artists, and moods.

02

Collect

Bring promising tracks into one personal listening space.

03

Create

Arrange tracks into a mix with AI assistance and listener control.

04

Share

Publish playlists for friends and the wider listening community.

Future conversations

Interested in what DesiMixTape could become?

Gander is open to conversations with music, culture, catalogue, and community partners who see a useful next chapter for the product.

Talk to Gander Explore other ventures

Product access and partnership conversations are coordinated through Gander.

jobs.title: Expertise Path and Manager Path
jobs.description:
30+ Engineering Career Ladders

Before jumping into the list, let's quickly discuss software engineering career ladders. We can extract common traits from those career ladders; understanding those characteristics allows us to connect the dots more easily and compare different career ladders efficiently.

What Is a Career Ladder?

A career ladder, or career path, is a progression framework. It allows an organization to describe the different job levels and the expectations for a given position.

It enables the assessment of a software engineer's skills and to work on her career progression. It provides a shared framework to identify the different aspects to improve to reach the next job level.

The ladder can also be mapped with employee's compensation, increasing salaries transparency, and fairness.

Expertise Path and Manager Path (Dual-Track)

Most of the software engineering career ladders are dual tracks ladders.

They have a joint base for the first positions, and at some point, two paths are possible the expertise path and the people management path. The expertise path is often named the individual contributor track, the people management path is often called the manager track.

The career path depends on the stage of the company and the size of the team. New positions will usually appear while the engineering group is growing.

Example for a tiny team (up to 10 engineers)

You'll rarely find ladders at that scale; it's still very early stage, the team is a handful of engineers working with a CTO or a Tech Lead. In startups, the engineering lead is often the technical Co-founder and CTO.

Single Track Notes Engineer Creating solutions to business problems Senior Engineer Handling most complex parts and mentoring Engineering Lead She may handle people management aspects

At this stage, it's pretty common to have one lead developer or engineering lead who owns technical guidance and organizes the team's delivery. She is often more focused on delivery and does not handle people management which a founder still handles.

Example for a small team (~20 engineers)

At that point, the company will introduce middle management positions, usually an Engineering Manager (EM) position. The EM supports a group of 5 to 10 engineers, especially on human resources and project management aspects (ex: hiring, onboarding, organizing, coaching, delivery plan, reporting).

In some companies, EM can be very hands-on on the system part and provide technical and architecture guidance, playing both technical leader and people/team leader. Usually, the company starts to split tech guidance and people management; both require significant and specific expertise.

Individual Contributor (IC) Track People Manager Track Engineer - Senior Engineer - Tech Lead Engineering Manager

Example for a medium team (50+ engineers)

You'll start to have more levels and more expert positions at that stage. The company has usually introduced the role of Head of Engineering, Engineering Director, or VP Engineering. This role is about leading the whole engineering department; the engineering managers will report the person having this role.

Leadership has usually introduced another new role to support the technical guidance at a broader scale, for the whole system or a large part of the system. This role can be named Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, etc.

Individual Contributor (IC) Track People Manager Track Engineer - Senior Engineer - Tech Lead Engineering Manager Staff Engineer VP Engineering

Example for a large team (100 to 1000+ engineers)

At this stage, the engineering department will create a lot of new intermediary positions to capture the level of expertise and area of ownership and impact. Welcome to Senior Engineer I and II, Engineering Director, etc.

Individual Contributor (IC) Track People Manager Track Engineer I - Engineer II - Senior Engineer I - Senior Engineer II - Tech Lead Engineering Manager Senior Tech Lead Senior Engineering Manager Staff Engineer Engineering Director Senior Staff Engineer Senior Engineering Director Principal Engineer VP Engineering Senior Principal Engineer Senior VP Engineering

Here is a curated list of 30+ public software engineering career ladders; in those resources, you can also find some explanations about why and how those ladders have been introduced.

jobs.title: Rent the Runway
jobs.description:
Mar 26

Mar 26 Sharing Our Engineering Ladder

Camille

I gave a talk last year at the NYC CTO summit on how and why to introduce structure into an engineering organization (slides available here). I am a fan of structure and the clarity that it can provide an organization, despite its potential downsides. I'm not going to talk about the WHY very much in this post, but I thought it was about time that I helped with the HOW.

Creating an engineering ladder (that is, the job descriptions and levels of an engineering organization) is a daunting task. If you do a half-hearted job, you're likely to cause more problems than you solve. The very first ladder I presented to my team was based on the ladder at Foursquare*. It was very simple, with one or two descriptive elements per "attribute" of engineering (technical skill, communication skill, etc), and by all accounts worked very well for their team. I hoped that this style of providing fewer details would result in people being less obsessed with the ladder, less likely to try to negotiate their level on "technicalities". Boy was I wrong. Almost immediately I had engineers debating me over whether they were at the right level, and there was a great deal of anxiety and confusion throughout the organization. I left room for generous interpretation, and it made it difficult for me to explain what I really wanted and expected.

In addition to the ladder causing problems inside of my team, we were having a hard time evaluating candidates during interviews and determining what level to hire them into. Particularly at the more senior levels, it wasn't clear what the criteria for success really looked like. So, together with my tech leads and engineering managers, we rewrote the ladder to be more specific. It has been very helpful both for the process of reviews and promotion committees as well as for the process of hiring.

I have since shared my ladder privately with several engineering managers around the country who were looking for inspiration, and today we're making it public for the benefit of all. I'm sharing this ladder not to suggest that it is the be-all end-all of engineering ladders, but to give you what I hope is a more thorough starting point than you might have seen elsewhere. After all, no one is really writing these ladders from scratch, whether we pull directly from other companies (as this one does at points), or indirectly from our past experience, so the more data points the merrier.

Without further ado, I present our engineering ladder, in both spreadsheet, and long-winded text, warts and all. Please feel free to clone this ladder and update it for use in your own organizations.

  • A special thanks to Harry Heymann, Jason Liszka and Andrew Hogue, authors of the original Foursquare eng ladder!

Camille

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

Your role

• Act as a key contact / interface between the libraries and University stakeholders, including faculty, researchers, students and administrative departments, in particular within the Faculty of Law, Economics & Finance (FDEF)
• Take ownership of collection plans and budgets for the relevant subject areas,  ensuring expertise and added value to faculty

• Provide expert advice, research support and information literacy training tailored to the needs of students, researchers and teaching staff, and act as a sparring partner for academic users
• Reply to enquiries and support users in identifying, accessing and using relevant documentary resources, databases and information tools, providing added value guidance and expert advice where needed

• Monitor trends in teaching, learning and research in the relevant disciplines in order to keep collections and services up to date, analyse needs and propose improvements and adapted approaches
• Maintain regular interaction with academic stakeholders to identify evolving curriculum needs, new programmes, research priorities and resource requirements, and translate these into concrete collection and service developments
• Promote the libraries' collections, resources and services through targeted communication, outreach, training and advocacy activities that emphasise added value to faculty and researchers
• Analyse usage data and user feedback to support evidence based decisions, prioritise activities based on needs and timeframe, and drive continuous improvement of collections and services
• Contribute to shaping and improving practices for cataloguing, classification, signage, collection maintenance and the organisation of documentary resources according to applicable standards

Your profile
• Master's degree or equivalent by work experience in Library, Information or Documentation Science; or a Master's degree in a relevant discipline complemented by training or experience in information management
• At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in an academic or research library

Language Requirements: Excellent command of English and French (C1); very good command of German and/or Luxembourgish (B2) would be considered an asset.

Your team

Cyber Security Analyst – Audit

Luxembourg OR Amsterdam, Netherlands
Monday – Friday 8:00 am – 5:00 pm OR 9:00 am – 6:00 pm
Hybrid

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst – Audit to support and enhance the organization's security posture across multiple jurisdictions. This role is responsible for executing audit activities, strengthening compliance frameworks, and aligning security strategies across both legacy and modern technology environments. The candidate will work closely with audit partners and internal stakeholders to ensure adherence to audit and regulatory requirements and continuous improvement of security assurance practices.

The ideal candidate has at least four years of experience in cybersecurity, IT audit, risk management, or compliance. This role ensures adherence to global regulatory standards (e.g., SOX, GDPR, ISO), evaluates control effectiveness, and serves as a primary liaison for auditors. The role requires strong risk assessment capabilities, proactive issue resolution, and a balanced focus on compliance and enterprise resilience in tandem with security leadership.

Some of the things that you will be doing:

• Partner with global teams across business operations, compliance, IT, and legal to manage technology risk and regulatory compliance.
• Plan and execute internal, external, and jurisdictional audits in line with the audit roadmap.
• Develop and enhance security policies, standards, procedures, and compliance frameworks.
• Improve IT compliance processes and identify automation opportunities for control activities.
• Design and execute control testing strategies and ensure proper evidence documentation.
• Maintain and enhance control frameworks aligned with regulatory and industry standards.
• Conduct IT risk assessments and track remediation of identified gaps.
• Coordinate with auditors, regulators, and stakeholders during audit cycles.
• Track and report compliance metrics and program effectiveness indicators.
• Leverage GRC tools for audit management, evidence tracking, and reporting.
• Identify risks and vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies.
• Manage third-party/vendor risk assessments and escalations.
• Respond to regulatory and jurisdictional audit requests.
• Provide actionable insights and reporting to security leadership.

What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, or related field (or equivalent experience).
• 4+ years of experience in IT audit, risk management, or cybersecurity.
• Strong knowledge of Global regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GDPR, ISO, DORA PCI, PSD2 and NIST.
• Familiarity with audit standards and frameworks (SOC 1 & 2, ISO 27001, NIST, COSO, COBIT).
• Understanding of cybersecurity threat landscape and control environments.
• Knowledge of modern technologies including cloud, DevOps, application security, and AI.
• Experience working with/ customizing GRC tools (e.g., Archer, OneTrust, AuditBoard, Diligent).
• Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive approach towards available work requests and timely response.
• Ability to translate technical risks into business insights.
• Hands-on experience in IT disciplines and audit execution.
• Experience in global and multi-regulatory environments.
• Ability to manage complex compliance requirements across jurisdictions.
• Strong organizational and proactive risk management skills.
• High integrity, accountability, and professional excellence.
• CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CIA, or other relevant cybersecurity, audit, or risk certifications.

Description:

Job Description

At DuPont, we are redefining what operational excellence looks like in advanced manufacturing. We are seeking an experienced Operational Excellence (OpEx)
Leader to help accelerate the performance, digital transformation, and long-term competitiveness of our Luxembourg Site, supporting world-class businesses including Tyvek®, Typar®, Power & Utilities, and Shared Services.
This is a highly visible leadership role where you will partner with site leaders, engineers, operators, and functional teams to turn strategy into execution, build continuous improvement capability, and deliver measurable business results. You will champion the DuPont Business System, coach teams in structured problem solving, and drive a culture where performance is transparent, problems are solved at the source, and improvement is part of everyday work.
If you are passionate about Lean transformation, digital innovation, operational performance, and developing people, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact at one of DuPont's key manufacturing sites.

What You'll Do

Lead the Operational Excellence Journey

• Drive the deployment and sustainability of DuPont's OpEx Management System across the Luxembourg Site.
• Coach leaders and teams on Daily Visual Management, Operating Reviews, tiered accountability, performance management, and continuous improvement best practices.
• Establish meaningful SQDIP performance metrics that enable teams to identify gaps quickly and focus on what matters most.
• Shape and manage the site's OpEx roadmap, ensuring improvement efforts are aligned with business priorities and strategic objectives.
• Develop OpEx capabilities through coaching, mentoring, practical training, and hands-on leadership.

Champion Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving

• Lead structured problem-solving initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, A3 Thinking, PDCA, 5 Whys, Pareto analysis, and root-cause methodologies.
• Facilitate Kaizen events and improvement workshops that deliver sustainable operational results.
• Help drive key site priorities, including productivity, reliability, manufacturing efficiency, quality performance, waste reduction, yield improvement, and cost competitiveness.
• Coach teams to solve problems at the process level and create lasting solutions, not temporary fixes.

Accelerate Digital Transformation

• Partner with Operations, Engineering, IT, and functional teams to implement digital solutions that simplify work, improve decision-making, and enhance operational visibility.
• Support the adoption of technologies and systems including Power BI, PowerApps, SAP, IP21, digital dashboards, and automation tools.
• Ensure digital capabilities become an integral part of daily management and business performance reviews.

Deliver Measurable Business Results

• Provide governance and oversight for the site's continuous improvement portfolio.
• Track project execution, financial benefits, risk management, and value realization.
• Drive improvements that positively impact safety, quality, delivery, inventory, productivity, cost efficiency, energy usage, compliance, and overall site competitiveness.
• Establish robust sustainment mechanisms that ensure improvements continue long after implementation.

Foster Innovation & Collaboration

• Promote innovative thinking, automation, AI-enabled problem solving, and modern manufacturing practices.
• Connect Luxembourg teams with global DuPont networks, communities of practice, and best-in-class operational excellence resources.
• Help build a culture where every employee is empowered to identify opportunities, solve problems, and contribute to continuous improvement.

What You'll Bring

Education & Technical Expertise

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Operations Management, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
• Fluency in English and German.
• Strong understanding of operational performance management and continuous improvement systems.
• Practical experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, A3 Problem Solving, Kaizen, Visual Management, and process optimization methodologies.
• Proficiency with digital and analytics tools such as Power BI, PowerApps, SAP, Excel, SharePoint, and manufacturing data systems.
• Knowledge of manufacturing operations, maintenance, automation, utilities, industrial data systems, or PLC environments is an advantage.

Experience

• Experience in manufacturing, operations, engineering, maintenance, operational excellence, digital transformation, or continuous improvement environments.
• Demonstrated success leading improvement initiatives from opportunity identification through implementation and sustainment.
• Experience working within complex manufacturing organizations with cross-functional stakeholders is highly valued.

Leadership Capabilities

• Proven ability to influence, coach, and engage stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

In this role, you will own the product vision and roadmap for technology solutions that support Amazon's risk and compliance operations across transportation, global trade, food safety, and supply chain. You will work closely with GSARC business teams to translate strategic risk and compliance needs into scalable product experiences — building tools and systems that safeguard Amazon's commercial motor carrier authorities, support business growth, and ensure a safe, compliant, and trustworthy experience for our partner business units, carrier partners, employees, and customers. You will be expected to apply product thinking to risk and control concepts across new and existing business models, define product requirements grounded in customer understanding, and partner with engineering, design, and cross-functional teams to deliver measurable outcomes. You will work collaboratively with compliance/business stakeholders, legal, and finance teams to build world-class, customer-centric technology products that enable compliance and risk management at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned GRAM-T technology products, working backwards from customer needs to define what to build, why it matters, and how to measure success.

- Define product requirements (PR/FAQs, product specs) by deeply understanding the workflows of risk managers and auditors who use our tools daily, as well as the downstream impact our audit outputs have on carrier partners.

- Manage the full product lifecycle, from discovery through execution, launch, and adoption, partnering with engineering to evaluate technical proposals, assess feasibility, and ensure appropriate trade-offs between speed, scalability, and system health.

- Use data and metrics to drive product decisions, define success criteria, prioritize the roadmap, and quantify the impact of risk programs enabled by your products.

- Build cross-functional partnerships with internal stakeholders (risk managers, legal, and finance) to translate risk and compliance initiatives into product capabilities.

- Drive product adoption by engaging directly with end users, gathering feedback, and iterating to optimize the customer experience.

- Leverage AI capabilities to accelerate development cycles, enable faster learning, and unlock new forms of innovation within GRAM-T technology products.

A day in the life

As a Product Manager II - Tech on the GRAM-T Tech team, you will start your day reviewing product metrics and user feedback from risk managers and auditors using your tools across multiple regions. You might spend your morning in a sprint planning session with your engineering team, discussing technical trade-offs for a new feature that automates inspection workflow tracking or enhances carrier partner corrective action plan management. Mid-day, you'll join a working session with risk manager stakeholders to understand an emerging compliance gap, whether related to transportation regulations, global trade requirements, or food safety standards, translating their operational pain points into product requirements. In the afternoon, you'll draft a product specification for a new capability, diving deep into the technical architecture with your engineers to ensure the solution scales across Amazon's global network. You'll close the day by analyzing adoption data for a recently launched feature, identifying opportunities to improve the user experience, and updating your roadmap priorities based on what you've learned. Throughout, you'll balance the needs of multiple customer personas; risk managers conducting oversight activities, carrier partners remediating findings, and leadership teams needing visibility into compliance posture, while maintaining a clear product vision that reduces risk and enables business growth.

About the team

Global Risk Audit Management – Transportation (GRAM-T) Tech builds the tools and features that bring Global Solutions for Analytics, Risk, & Compliance (GSARC)'s mission to life at scale. GSARC spans transportation, global trade, food safety, and supply chain — and our product team supports this breadth by automating monitoring, audit, and risk management activities that allow the organization to scale with risk rather than headcount. We build technology solutions, leveraging AI where it accelerates outcomes and purpose-built tooling where it best serves our customers, to transform manual compliance workflows into scalable, data-driven experiences that enable risk and compliance teams to protect Amazon's brand and support business growth across our global network.

  • People who can carefully review written information, images, documents, or other digital content
  • Strong readers and writers with good judgment
  • People who can follow detailed instructions consistently
  • Individuals who are comfortable using web-based tools and online platforms
  • People who take quality seriously and can spot mistakes or inconsistencies
  • Those who enjoy focused, independent work while contributing to a larger project
  • Strong character matters — we value integrity, reliability, curiosity, and a commitment to high-quality work



Qualifications

  • Comfortable using a computer for extended periods
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to follow written guidelines and project instructions
  • Clear written communication skills
  • Basic familiarity with spreadsheets, online forms, or web-based work tools
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
  • Prior experience in data labeling, annotation, quality review, research, writing, customer support, operations, or administrative work is helpful but not required



Compensation

Compensation is $18- $22 an hour and a max of 40 hours a week.

A Place to Do Meaningful Work

Data labeling may sound simple, but it plays an important role in improving the technology people use every day. At Workada, your work helps create the examples and feedback that make advanced systems more accurate, consistent, and useful.

We're looking for people who care about accuracy, consistency, and careful judgment. Whether you're reviewing text, categorizing information, evaluating responses, or checking data quality, your work helps improve the way technology performs.

We are looking for a Employee Services Coordinator to join our Reception, Relocation and Corporate Housing Team at our headquarters in Baar. For motivated candidates, we offer the chance to join one of the world’s largest producers and marketers of commodities and to become part of a multicultural team.  
The main tasks and responsibilities include  
Welcoming and supporting our international guests and visitors as the company's first point of contact  
Focal point for employees for general questions about services offered by the company  
Operation of the telephone exchange (internal and external)  
Booking taxis and other transfers  
Management of our meeting rooms  
Support the Relocation and Corporate Flat Management Team by providing dedicated assistance to relocating employees and delivering an exceptional service experience, including support with home search, school placement, and settling\-in matters. Ensure a smooth and comfortable start to their new life abroad by offering personalized hospitality services within our company apartments.  
Various administrative tasks  
The ideal candidate  
Communicates confidently with international guests and employees in both German and English, demonstrating strong interpersonal and team communication skills  
Thrives in a multicultural environment and contributes to a welcoming, inclusive atmosphere through a professional and courteous manner  
Delivers high\-quality hospitality services and creates positive service experiences for employees and international guests  
Works independently with enthusiasm, reliability, and a strong service mindset, while maintaining a high standard of quality  
Effectively prioritizes tasks and remains calm, structured, and professional in fast\-paced or demanding situations  
Proactively contributes ideas and suggestions to improve services, processes, and the overall guest experience  
Actively contributes to a positive team spirit and collaborative working environment  
Qualifications and requirements  
Reception experience \- preferably from a hotel reception environment  
Very good knowledge of German and English (oral/written)  
High level of service awareness and team\-oriented working style  
Discreet and loyal personality  
Well\-groomed appearance and pleasant manners  
Holding a Swiss work permit or passport holder of CH / EU / EFTA  
Benefits  
We are committed to providing benefits, which promote mental, physical, and financial well\-being. From healthy meal options in our restaurants and bistros to free use of the in\-house gym including sport classes with professional trainers.  
We reimburse public transport for commuting to work; alternatively, we offer free parking space.  
We provide tuition assistance for further education and training courses.  
We have a competitive parental leave policy. Our childcare benefits also include emergency childcare services and financial assistance towards daycare costs.  
Employees’ Swiss Pension 2nd pillar is fully paid by Glencore.  
Who we are  
Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life.  
With over 140,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices.  
Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

jobs.title: Test Engineer for unit testing HS/SW
jobs.description:
Test Engineer for unit testing HS/SW  
Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are based here. For our long\-standing client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for an  
Test Engineer for unit testing HS/SW  
Background:  
We are looking for a Senior Test Engineer with a strong focus on Hardware Unit and Subsystem Testing to strengthen the cross\-functional engineering team. In this role, you will be the driving force ensuring the quality, robustness, and reliability of hardware units to ensure their seamless integration into the system level.  
We are seeking experienced Test Engineers (5\+ years) with a strong background in HW/SW testing within highly regulated medical or IVD environments. You possess a deep understanding of the V\-model and are proficient in ALM/Agile tools (Codebeamer/Jira).  
We are hiring across four specialized profiles corresponding to the functional units: Measurement Chamber, Fluidics Component, Oximetry, and HW Unit \& Subsystem.  
You will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of Blood Gas \& Electrolytes (BG/E) Analyzers, ensuring the medical diagnostic devices meet the highest standards of safety and efficacy. This collaborative, high\-impact position is located at the site in Rotkreuz, Switzerland, and offers the flexibility to tailor responsibilities to your unique strengths.  
Tasks \& Responsibilities:  
Test Development \& Execution: You will design, prepare, and execute automated test suites, test cases, and test protocols for Verification and Validation (V\&V) in strict compliance with medical device regulations (FDA/MDR)  
Endurance \& Reliability Testing: You will develop and run accelerated life testing (ALT), durability, and wear\-and\-tear tests to ensure the long\-term performance and reliability of hardware components under real\-world conditions  
Fixture Design \& Automation: You will build and assemble custom test setups, fluidic rigs, and test fixtures (utilizing CAD tools like SolidWorks) and integrate sensors, pumps, and actuators into these setups  
Scripting \& Data Analysis: You will write automation scripts in to control test rigs and gather data, while also analyzing complex test metrics using statistical tools  
Cross\-Functional Collaboration: You will conduct root cause analysis (such as 5 Whys and Fishbone diagrams) for defects, provide design feedback for manufacturability (DFM/DFA), and collaborate closely with software, firmware, and systems engineering teams on continuous improvements  
Individual Tasks \& Responsibilities per profile:  
Measurement Chamber Focus: Deep involvement in evaluating electro\-mechanical hardware (currents, voltages, clamping forces) and configuring lab instrumentation like encoders and oscilloscopes. You will act as the primary point of contact for unit defects in Operations or the BSL\-2 lab.  
Fluidics Component Focus: Centers around fundamental fluid mechanics, requiring expertise with fluidic components (valves, connectors) and measurement equipment. You will heavily execute tightness, stress, and endurance testing on fluidic consumables.  
Oximetry Focus: Demands physical testing on precision hardware, specifically mechanical oscillators and optics. You will evaluate microfluidic chips and perform biological sample preparation (such as handling whole blood and adjusting hematocrit levels) safely inside a BSL\-2 laboratory.  
HW Unit \& Subsystem Testing Focus: Revolves around the ownership of Unit Specifications (USP) and extensive Configuration \& Item Management (tracking CIs and revision statuses). You will serve as the technical bridge during the integration phase, managing hardware\-software dependencies.  
Must Haves (across all four profiles):  
A degree (BSc, MSc, PhD, or equivalent HF Apprenticeship) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline  
Between 3 to 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in hardware testing, mechatronic unit verification, or product development  
Proven expertise working in a highly regulated medical device, In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD), or life sciences environment (FDA/MDR)  
Strong hands\-on experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) systems (such as Codebeamer or PLM) for requirement traceability, and agile tools like Jira  
Professional proficiency in English is a strict requirement as it is the project language. Fluency or a strong understanding of German is a distinct advantage or required for daily operations, depending on the focus  
What you will be offered:

Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting areas  
Central location in Rotkreuz not far from the train station  
Varied job profile  
Further training opportunities through temptraining

jobs.title: Arctic Experience Guide (Entrepreneur/toiminimi)
jobs.description:
Arctic Experience Guide (Entrepreneur/toiminimi)

**Winter Season 2026–2027 Approx. 1 December 2026 – 27 March 2027**

Do you have your own company and a passion for creating unforgettable experiences in Finnish Lapland?

We're looking for a reliable entrepreneur to join our team for the upcoming winter season in Levi.

**Your role**

You'll be guiding small groups of international guests on premium Arctic experiences, including:

- Driving a snowmobile while towing our heated sleigh for up to 8 guests

- Hosting Northern Lights experiences at our private lakeside Aurora Base Camp for groups of up to 8 guests

- Picking up and dropping off guests

- Ensuring every guest enjoys a safe, comfortable, and unforgettable experience


**We're looking for someone who**

- Has their own company (or is willing to establish one)

- Speaks fluent English (additional languages are an advantage)

- Holds a valid driving licence

- Holds a valid First Aid 1 certificate

- Holds a valid Hygiene Passport

- Is comfortable driving a snowmobile

- Enjoys working outdoors in Arctic conditions

- Is reliable, professional, and able to work independently

- Applicants must have the legal right to work in Finland for the duration of the employment.


**What we offer**

- Cooperation as an independent entrepreneur

- Approximate working period from **1 December 2026 until 27 March 2027**

- Flexible working schedule

- Competitive compensation

- Small groups of up to 8 guests

- High-quality equipment and full operational support

- The opportunity to grow together with an ambitious tourism company focused on premium Arctic experiences


If you enjoy meeting people from around the world and want to create unforgettable memories beneath the Northern Lights, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Monipuolinen liikunta- ja hyvinvointialan osaaja MTC:lle, Tampere (Lielahti)
jobs.description:
**Monipuolinen liikunta- ja hyvinvointialan osaaja MTC:lle, Tampere (Lielahti)**

Etsimme MTC:lle osaajaa, joka yhdistää **hierojan koulutuksen** ja **ryhmäliikuntatuntien ohjaamisen** (esim. pump, RPV, kehonhuolto, toiminnalliset tunnit). Tämän kombon lisäksi arvostamme, jos sinulla on myös valmiuksia yksilövalmennuksiin (PT) ja halua osallistua salin asiakaspalvelun työtehtäviin.

Valmennuskeskus MTC on matalan kynnyksen liikuntakeskus Lielahdessa, Tampereella. Meillä on lämminhenkinen ja yhteisöllinen meininki – asiakkaamme viihtyvät luonamme ja moni tulee paikalle myös jutustelemaan, ei vain treenaamaan. Suurin osa asiakkaistamme on keski-ikäisiä ja eläkeikää lähestyviä naisia, joille tärkeintä on arjen toimintakyky ja hyvä olo – meillä ei siis lasketa kaloreita eikä juosta maratoneja, vaan keskitytään kokonaisvaltaiseen hyvinvointiin ja mukavaan fiilikseen.

Työpäivä voi koostua esimerkiksi hieronta-asiakkaista, parista tunnista asiakaspalvelua ja ryhmäliikuntatunnin ohjaamisesta, etsitään juuri se yhdistelmä, joka sopii sinulle parhaiten. Saat itse vaikuttaa vahvasti omaan aikatauluusi. Ryhmätuntien ohjaus on painottunut iltapäiviin ja iltoihin , mutta tarjolla on myös aamupäivä tunteja.

**Työn alkaminen:** Työ alkaa joustavasti syksyn aikana, sopimuksen mukaan

**Työn muoto:** Alkuvaiheessa työtä tehdään yrittäjänä tai kevytyrittäjänä laskuttaen. Myöhemmin katsotaan tilanteen ja yhteistyön sujumisen mukaan, löytyisikö muita sopivia tapoja järjestää työsuhde.

Jos olet koulutettu hieroja, joka osaa myös innostaa ryhmää liikkumaan, ja haluat olla osa lämminhenkistä ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä – ota yhteyttä ja kerro itsestäsi!

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter 2026 New Graduate
jobs.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the worldâs first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The companyâs first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiantâs unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

About the Role

Radiant is seeking a driven recent grad to join our talent team and help build the engineering teams behind Kaleidos, our portable, mass-producible nuclear microreactor targeting commercial deployment in 2028. This is a role for someone who wants to start a career in recruitment, work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with real ownership and influence, build a deep tech career, and learn about several technical domains like nuclear, hardware, electrical, software, and more. You'll get close mentorship from recruiters and sourcers who've built teams before, regular visibility with executives, own requisitions, and find top talent for engineering leaders and their teams.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Run your own reqs from open to close, building the pipeline, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and getting offers signed.

  • Find niche talent markets for specialized engineering roles in places like GitHub repos, arXiv papers, technical mailing lists, tech foundation communities, conference speaker rosters, and academic programs.

  • Create talent market reports based on research you drive to help make better-informed recruiting strategies.

  • Coordinate interviews and help facilitate hiring team debriefs to keep decisions moving quickly.

  • Sit in on offer conversations with senior recruiters and learn how strategy and closing work in practice.

  • Help shape how Radiant recruits; the processes, tools, and 3rd party platforms you help build and adopt now become the foundation the team scales on.

  • Get hands-on exposure to hiring across multiple technical functions: electrical, mechanical, software, and more.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.

  • 0â2 years of experience in recruiting, sales, sourcing, or coordination, or you've picked it up on your own and can point to something that proves it.

  • Something outside the classroom that shows real team influence, a club you led, student government, a project you built, a sport you competed in, or work you volunteered for.

  • A genuine pull toward hardware, nuclear, physics, or AI/ML; you don't need an engineering background, just real curiosity.

  • A bias toward action: you move quickly, problem-solve on the fly, and know when to raise your hand for help.

  • You're able to hold a genuine conversation with technical candidates, curious enough to ask good questions, and honest enough to admit when something's outside your depth.

Desired Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM-related major is a plus.

  • Any prior exposure to hardware, software, engineering, or tech recruiting, even informally.

  • Comfort picking up new tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS, sourcing, LLM platforms, even without direct prior experience.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission.

  • Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

Benefits and Perks

  • Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

  • Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

  • One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

  • Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

  • Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

  • Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

  • 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

  • Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

  • Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

  • Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

  • Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.

Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiantâs new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

The best of todayâs advanced reactor builders donât wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If thatâs you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com.

Et vous Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac+5 obligatoire issu d'une grande école d'ingénieurs ou d'un Master spécialisé en IA avec un profil quantitatif fort.***Vous disposez d'au moins 1 an d'expérience minimum (hors stages et alternances) en tant que AI Engineer ou ML Engineer.***Vous avez un track record prouvé de mise en production de modèles ML (pas uniquement de la R&D) dans des environnements où le taux de service est critique.***Vous possédez une excellente culture ML générale (Transformers, modèles de fondation, mécanismes d'attention) et maîtrisez parfaitement Python.***Vous maîtrisez au moins un cloud provider (GCP, AWS ou autre).Vous parlez un anglais courant et un français courant.***Vous êtes doté d'une culture de 'builder' : créatif, autonome, axé sur l'ownership total et prêt à faire tout ce qu'il faut pour délivrer.

L'objectif est de garantir, par une présence visible et attentionnée, une expérience client irréprochable, à la hauteur des standards internationaux d'un établissement de prestige.Ce poste, en contrat à durée indéterminée, s'adresse à un(e) leader opérationnel(le), naturellement charismatique, capable de fédérer une équipe engagée autour de l'excellence et de la passion du service. * veiller à l'alignement continu des équipes avec les plus hauts standards de qualité,
* développer au quotidien la vitalité et le raffinement de la maison.
* Être garant(e) d'un accueil personnalisé et d'une atmosphère unique pour chaque visiteur,
* maîtriser la connaissance de chaque chambre, chaque client, chaque table, et chaque membre du personnel.Ce rôle implique un défi stimulant dans un environnement haut de gamme, au sein d'une équipe à taille humaine où la quête permanente d'excellence, le sens du détail et l'esprit d'initiative font toute la différence.

L'enjeu ? Créer un lieu de vie d'exception reconnu, où chaque instant compte et où la promesse d'un séjour mémorable est tenue à chaque visite.

Le profil idéal possède une expérience significative en direction ou direction adjointe d'un établissement de restauration haut de gamme, 4 ou 5 étoiles, et affiche une présence terrain constante, chaleureuse et élégante.Qualités humaines et comportementales recherchées :- Présence naturelle et proximité de chaque instant avec les équipes et les clients - Sens aigu du détail, amour de l'esthétique et de la cohérence - Relationnel haut de gamme, capacité à instaurer une connexion immédiate - Leadership incarné, porteur d'une exigence positive et bienveillante - Savoir-faire démontré dans l'accompagnement et la motivation des équipes par l'exemple - Humilité, élégance naturelle, sens profond du service Compétences techniques attendues :- Maîtrise avancée des standards d'accueil et de service 5 étoiles - Parfaite connaissance des opérations en hébergement et restauration - Expérience dans le suivi budgétaire et le contrôle de gestion (interaction avec un siège) - Familiarité solide avec les outils PMS/CRM - Gestion fine des priorités et grande réactivité face aux imprévus Le profil recherché se distingue par sa capacité à incarner un art de vivre, à faire rayonner une maison de caractère, et à transformer chaque interaction en expérience mémorable. Plus que des diplômes, la priorité est donnée à la personnalité, à l'excellence opérationnelle et à la passion du terrain.

jobs.title: Butikschef
jobs.description:
Få nye udfordringer i en nystartet virksomhed med et stærkt fællesskab.

Vil du være en del af et nyt brand i Danmark – så søg ind til os i Hus og Hjem.

Vi har fællesskab og samarbejde som kerneværdier, da vi tror på, at godt arbejdsmiljø og glade kollegaer er med til at skabe en god kundeoplevelse.

Lyder det som noget for dig:

Du bliver en del af et stærkt team, hvor du vil komme til at spille en afgørende rolle i teamet. For at blive vores nye kollega skal du være god til at samarbejde, men også kunne tænke og arbejde selvstændigt samt tage ansvar. Du er resultatorienteret, serviceminded, har situationsfornemmelse og sans for god kundebetjening. Du formår at engagere dig og gå foran som det gode eksempel, er fleksibel og har en positiv indstilling til nye udfordringer, til kunderne og til kollegerne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. bestå i sikre en altid indbydende og salgsklar butik med en høj standard.

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling, og der vil være aften- og weekendarbejde.

Få en spændende og afvekslende hverdag med fuld fart på samt mulighed for gode og fleksible arbejdsforhold og løn efter kvalifikationer.

Kan du se dig selv i:

Du er medansvarlig for butikkens udvikling. Du sikrer, at der altid er den rette bemanding, og butikken løbende udvikles til at nå dens fulde potientiale.

Du er en yderst fleksibel og stabil medarbejder. Du ved, at du i en butik kan blive afbrudt, og arbejdsopgaverne kan ændre sig i løbet af dagen, samt at vi alle er afhængige af hinanden for at få butikken til at spille.

Du er ambitiøs. Du har lyst til at dygtiggøre dig, og lyst til at gøre dit bedste for at skabe et godt resultat. Derudover går du foran som det gode eksempel.

Du er imødekommende. Du ønsker at få andre til at føle sig godt tilpas i dit selskab, da du ved, at det er starten på god kollegaservice og en god kundeservice.

Du er en god kollega. Du ved, hvor vigtigt det er at være omgivet af gode kollegaer. Både socialt og fagligt. Du ønsker at hjælpe og støtte dine kollegaer, samt skabe god energi.

Du nyder at have direkte kundekontakt. Du formår at skabe tillid og forstå kunden. Du brænder for at give kunden en troværdig og god oplevelse. Sammen med dine dygtige kollegaer sørger du for, at kunden kommer igen.

Da vores koncept stammer fra Italien er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med import fra EU og udenfor EU.

Hvis jobbet som noget for dig, så skynd dig at sende din ansøgning, da vi holder samtaler løbende. Stillingen forventes besat 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt.

Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til os i Hus og Hjem på vores mail.

jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionThe Software Platform Senior Engineer / Lead Engineer, will be responsible for supporting a strong team of engineers working on hi-tech embedded applicative software in a provided project perimeter.



You will be part of Software Engineering Department which has multidisciplinary teams across multiple Safran sites working together to provide innovative, future products of high technological value in aeronautical, land and maritime industries.



You will work in close collaboration with the Reseach&Development headquarters of Safran Electronics and Defense in France. In the short term, you will join a task force dedicated to Low Level Testing.



You will have the responsibility of the Low Level Testing activities, by supporting your team directly. In this context you will be reporting directly to the Technical Manager and operationally to the Tech Lead.

Working with others, you shall responsible for:

- ensuring the highest level of quality for Team deliverables in compliance with DO-178C;

- providing help to the Team software engineers when stuck;

- handling the more complex pieces of software via Architecture/Integration/Development;

- challenge choices from the Management from a Technical standpoint by raising awareness on technical risks on challenging topics;

- train upcoming new engineers with knowledge learned from the Technical Management.



About Safran Electronics & Defence

Safran Electronics & Defence is an international company with over 14,000 employees mobilizing their expertise and team spirit to design high-tech solutions in aerospace, defence and space industries. By combining human and technological intelligence, the company develops products and services to help civilian and military players observe, decide and guide on land, at sea, in the sky and space thus contributing to safer world.

Safran Electronics & Defence's centre in Bengaluru is an upcoming centre of excellence to established to provide R&D and Engineering solutions to local (Make-in-India) as well as global requirements of the company.



Welcome to Safran, powering the aeronautical industry with trust.

Reference of excellence, open to the world, and part of the main characters of innovation, we share a common vision of a future for aviation.

Joining us is becoming part of the most challenging projects carried out in the field: propelling from the most pioneering Air Taxis startups to the legacy flagships counting HAL.

At Safran, we value long-term commitment from our collaborators, and promote an environment of trust at all levels, by empowerment.

Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air !

Analyser l'impact des non-conformités (NC) sur la navigabilité et fournir des justifications de contrainte.

Identifier les zones d'inefficacité et contribuer à l'amélioration des processus.
Agir comme point de contact pour faciliter la coordination entre les différentes parties prenantes (manufacturing, qualité, bureaux d'études, etc.).

Expertise technique en analyse de structures métalliques et/ou composites, avec des outils manuels et informatiques (ISAMI, FEM, etc.).
Expérience sur des programmes d'avions gros porteurs ( widebody ).
Délégations DOA Stress déjà accordées ou capacité à les développer.
Langues: Niveau de négociation en anglais (à l'oral et à l'écrit). Le français est un plus.

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Communication (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of Corporate Communication (M/F)

Luxembourg | req1127

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

The Head of Corporate Communication is responsible for  the implementation and day-to-day management of  internal and external communications, CSR and sponsorship  initiatives, external relations, and stakeholder engagement,under the supervision and direction of  the Chief Communications Officer.

The role focuses on delivering impactful communication activities that enhance visibility, strengthen stakeholder engagement, and support the achievement of corporate goals. Working in close alignment with the Head of Branding and Marketing to ensure consistency of messaging, positioning and brand expression,  the Head of Corporate Communication interfaces with diverse internal and external stakeholders and proactively contributes to the successful implementation of the Bank's communications agenda. Strong relationship-building, communication, project management and leadership capabilities are essential to supporting and reinforcing BIL's reputation as an innovative and entrepreneurial Bank.

He/she reports to the Chief Communications Officer (CCO)..

Your next challenge:

External Communications:

Under the direction of the Chief Communications Officer, the Head of Corporate Communications:

• Coordinates communication support for corporate events, sponsorships, partnerships, and community initiatives.
• Coordinates the development and dissemination of press releases, media communications, corporate announcements, and external content.
• In alignment with the Head of Branding and Marketing, oversees the publication of corporate content across external communication channels, including the corporate website and social media platforms.
• Supports media engagement activities, including interview coordination, briefing preparation, and spokesperson support.
• Monitors media coverage and communication performance, providing recommendations to the Chief Communications Officer for continuous improvement.Contributes to reputation management activities and supports communication responses during issues or crisis situations.

Internal Communications

Under the direction of the Chief Communications Officer, the Head of Corporate Communications:

• Executes internal communication plans that support business priorities and organizational objectives.
• Oversees the delivery of timely, clear, and consistent communications to employees.
• Manages internal communication channels, including the intranet and employee communication platforms.
• Coordinates communications related to organizational developments, transformation projects, and change initiatives.
• Lead Townhall preparation and execution (logistics and content)

In alignment with HR, promotes the Bank's culture, values, purpose, and strategic priorities through effective internal storytelling.

• Coordinates communications relating to CSR, employee engagement, and corporate culture initiatives.
• Monitors employee feedback and communication effectiveness, proposing enhancements where appropriate.
Team and Functional Management

Under the direction of the Chief Communications Officer, the Head of Corporate Communications:

• Manages the day-to-day activities and performance of the Corporate Communications team.
• Ensures the efficient delivery of communication projects, campaigns, and initiatives.
• Provides guidance, coaching, and support to team members, fostering collaboration and professional development.
• Establishes effective processes and quality standards to ensure consistency across communication activities.
• Acts as a trusted communication partner for internal stakeholders, providing advice on communication planning and execution.
• Identifies opportunities to enhance communication impact through innovation, best practices, and new communication tools.
• Supports the Chief Communications Officer in achieving the objectives of the Communications function and the broader corporate agenda.
  
Your skills:

• 10+ years' professional experience at management level in Corporate Communications, Internal and External Communications, CSR, Media Relations and Corporate Events, including several years in a management position. Proven experience in developing and implementing communications plans, stakeholder engagement initiatives, sponsorship and high-profile events.
• Demonstrated ability to lead, develop and inspire communications professionals, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration and innovation.
• Sound understanding of the regional, international and multicultural environments in which BIL operates.
• Excellent command of French and English, both written and spoken. Luxemburgish would be an asset.
• Highly collaborative, with the ability to build trusted relationships across all levels of the organization.
• Strong team leader who inspires, coaches and develops others while fostering a positive and high-performance culture.
• Proactive and solutions-oriented, anticipating communication needs and responding effectively to emerging challenges.
• Excellent communicator with strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
• Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior management and external stakeholders.
• Organized and disciplined, capable of managing multiple priorities and delivering under tight deadlines.
• Resilient and composed under pressure, particularly in sensitive or fast-moving situations.
• Pragmatic and business-oriented, balancing creativity with operational effectiveness.
• Curious and innovative, continuously seeking new ways to enhance communication impact and engagement.
• High level of professional integrity, discretion and sound judgment.
• Results-driven, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.
