jobs.title: Embedded Software & Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
Work tasks: Key responsibilities
Firmware and embedded software development: - Develop and maintain embedded software and firmware primarily in Rust. - Use C where relevant for embedded and low-level development. - Develop for bare-metal RISC-V and embedded Linux on ARM environments. - Implement reliable software for resource-constrained embedded systems. - Investigate and resolve software, firmware and system-level issues. Hardware integration and verification: - Integrate firmware with electronics, hardware and communication interfaces. - Test, debug and validate software on target hardware. - Support hardware–software integration and system-level testing. - Contribute to verification activities and resolve integration issues. Engineering collaboration and documentation: - Work closely with electronics, optics and systems engineers. - Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. - Create and maintain clear technical documentation. - Help improve software development, testing and documentation practices. - Take increasing ownership of technical tasks as your understanding of our systems develops.

We offer: What we offer:
- A hands-on engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication technologies. - Meaningful technical ownership and the opportunity to see your work move from implementation to hardware integration and validation. - Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team. - The opportunity to develop your expertise across embedded software, electronics, optics and aerospace systems. - The ability to contribute to technical decisions and engineering practices as the company grows. - A gross annual base salary of €35,000–€57,000, depending on experience, skills and the expected level of responsibility. - Relocation support to Estonia if required. - Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs. Working arrangement: This is a primarily onsite position in Tallinn, Estonia, as the role involves close collaboration with hardware, integration and testing. Limited hybrid work may be agreed depending on the employee’s responsibilities and the stage of the work. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager. Other important information: This position may require the selected candidate to be eligible to obtain government security clearance. At Golbriak Space, we use our passion for purposeful innovation to help keep people safe and solve complex engineering challenges. We foster an inclusive environment built on integrity, responsibility and employee empowerment.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: RESPONSABLE DE SITE ITINERANT (H/F)
jobs.description:
Responsable de Site Itinérant (H/F)

Un poste de terrain, au cœur de nos résidences
Vous aimez les environnements variés, les nouveaux défis et les missions qui ont du sens ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service de plusieurs établissements plutôt que d'un seul ?
Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que Responsable de Site Itinérant (H/F) et devenez un véritable référent opérationnel au sein de notre réseau de 16 résidences Appart'Hôtels implantées dans la partie Est de France.

Qui sommes-nous ?
KOSY Appart'Hôtels, exploité par Habitat Gestion, c'est :
- Un réseau de 16 résidences,
- Présents dans 9 villes,
- Exploitant près de 1 400 logements en France,
- Avec plus de 25 ans d'expertise.
Implantés à Forbach, Saint-Avold, Reims, Nancy, Troyes, Mâcon, Grenoble, Aix-Les-Bains et Avignon.
Nous accueillons étudiants, professionnels et voyageurs en leur proposant des solutions d'hébergement tout confort, de la nuitée au séjour longue durée. Nos appartements, du studio au T2, sont entièrement meublés et équipés, avec Wi-Fi et de nombreux services à la carte.
Vous recherchez un poste où autonomie, diversité des missions et proximité avec la direction sont une réalité ? Rejoignez Kosy et participez au développement de notre réseau de résidences.
Pour en savoir plus : www.kosy-apparthotels.com

Votre mission :
Rattaché(e) à notre directeur opérationnel, votre mission s'articule autour de deux axes principaux :
- Renforcer les équipes lors des pics d'activité, des rentrées universitaires, des périodes touristiques ou tout autre besoin opérationnel.
- Remplacer les responsables de résidence pendant leurs absences (congés, formations, maladie, etc.) afin de garantir le bon fonctionnement de chaque établissement.

Dans ce cadre, vous serez amené(e) à :
- (Co)-piloter l'exploitation quotidienne d'une résidence ;
- Garantir un accueil client de qualité et veiller à la satisfaction de nos résidents et clients ;
- Accompagner, coordonner et soutenir les équipes présentes sur site (interne ou externe) ;
- Suivre l'activité commerciale et respecter les objectifs de taux d'occupation ;
- Assurer le suivi administratif et opérationnel de l'établissement ;
- Veiller au respect des procédures, des standards qualité et des règles de sécurité ;
- Accompagner les équipes lors des périodes de forte activité et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de leurs process.

Profil souhaité :
Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans la gestion d'un établissement d'hébergement (résidence de services, résidence étudiante, appart'hôtel).
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
- votre autonomie ;
- votre capacité d'adaptation ;
- votre sens de l'organisation ;

Head of Treasury
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategically minded Head of Treasury to join our global Energy Storage Business organisation in a rapidly growing renewable energy market.


This is a unique opportunity to establish and lead the treasury function of a newly carved-out business, taking full ownership of building treasury operations from the ground up. As the ideal candidate you will have direct experience of this process.

You will set up banking structures, develop treasury processes, manage liquidity routines and ensure a seamless transition into an independently operating group of companies. Success in this role requires solid expertise in cash and liquidity management, financial risk management, hedging and bank relationship management.

You should also be comfortable navigating compliance, internal controls and treasury-related reporting requirements within a global corporate environment. This role will be a hands-on position where a self-driven person will thrive. Your work will be essential in safeguarding financial integrity, supporting the business with reliable treasury insights and enabling future growth.

As a key member of the global finance team, you will manage both local and international treasury needs, collaborate closely with banks, auditors, and internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements across all treasury processes.

The ideal location for this position is Helsinki, Finland, however we would consider suitably qualified individuals based in Vaasa or Turku.

Key Responsibilities

Cash & Liquidity Management


* Ensure the company maintains adequate liquidity to support global operations and strategic initiatives.
* Manage global cash pooling structures, daily cash positioning, and short- to long-term cash flow forecasts.
* Optimise cash deployment and internal funding between group entities, enhancing working capital efficiency.
* Provide management with timely insights and recommendations on cash movements, trends and requirements.


Hedging & Financial Risk Management


* Develop, execute, and monitor hedging strategies for foreign exchange in alignment with corporate risk policies.
* Assess financial risks and propose mitigation strategies based on market developments and business needs.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and treasury governance frameworks.


Guarantees


* Manage the full portfolio of bank guarantees, letters of credit, parent company guarantees and other trade finance instruments.
* Oversee the issuance, amendment, extension, and cancellation of guarantees in a timely and compliant manner.
* Partner with commercial, legal, and project teams to structure trade finance solutions that support contract execution.


Bank Relationship Management


* Establish and maintain strong, strategic relationships with global banks and financial partners.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, facility structures, and service agreements to ensure optimal banking support for the business.
* Monitor banking performance, market conditions, competitive offerings to drive continuous improvement and cost efficiency.


Additional Contributions


* Liaison closely with the businesses' trade finance team on different trade finance topics
* Manage treasury reporting and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations.
* Drive continuous improvement, automation, and digitalization within treasury processes.
* Provide guidance and support to finance team on treasury-related matters.
* Manage corporate financing activities, including credit facilities and capital structure development, as needed.

jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

 

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 75 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

 

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

 

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 1+ year in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

 

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

 

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

 
Your Role

We are looking for a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor who is deeply embedded in generative video workflows and can independently craft high-quality, narrative-driven content from concept to final output.

You are a sharp-eyed video editor comfortable operating at the intersection of creativity and emerging technology, building visually compelling long-form videos using AI-first pipelines. You take ownership of the entire production stack — from prompting and generation to editing, compositing, graphic design work and final delivery. You thrive in a high-performance environment where your quick wits and passion for story-telling shine.

 

Reporting to your Content Lead, this is what you'll be doing:

Key Responsibilities

  • Conceptualise scripts based on current production needs and centred around existing AI characters (our own IPs)

  • Create narrative-driven, longform video content, including stylized and explicit NSFW visuals, with a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and visual coherence throughout

  • Own and manage end-to-end AI video production workflows, from ideation and prompting to generation, editing, and post-production

  • Utilise tools such as Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse and other AI video models/platforms to produce high-quality visual sequences

  • Develop and maintain consistent character appearance, style, and scene continuity across longer narratives using advanced techniques

  • Integrate motion graphic design and colour correction to deliver cohesive final outputs

  • Experiment rapidly with new AI models, tools, and techniques, incorporating them into production workflows and sharing skills with the rest of the team

  • Align with your Content Lead’s creative direction while maintaining a high degree of autonomy in execution and technical decision-making

  • Continuously refine workflows for efficiency, scalability, and output quality

 
Your Qualifications
 
Hard Skills

  • 4–6+ years of experience in video production, VFX, or digital art, with a strong portfolio (AI-driven video work is a must)

  • Hands-on experience with the latest AI video tools and models (e.g., Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse, and similar emerging options)

  • Solid understanding of AI image/video generation pipelines, including prompting, batching, consistency techniques, and post-processing

  • Experience with traditional tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar for final assembly and polish

  • Strong grasp of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, and cinematic language

  • Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across sequences in AI-generated content

 
Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaboration skills (fluent in English)

🎯 High ownership — able to take ideas from concept to completion independently

⚡️ Experimental mindset — comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving tools

⏱️ Fast iteration cycles — able to test, fail, refine, and improve quickly

🧠 Curious and self-driven — constantly exploring new AI capabilities and workflows

🧢 Open to feedback and continuous improvement

🍭 #NSFW — Comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit adult content

 
Bonus Points

  • Experience in AI-native storytelling or filmmaking

  • Background in 3D, VFX, technical art or as a colourist

  • Familiarity with training/customizing models (LoRAs, embeddings, fine-tuning)

  • Prior experience in adult, dating, or adjacent creative industries a huge bonus

  • Experience with ComfyUI

  • Experience with Stable Diffusion / AUTOMATIC1111 and related tooling (Advanced prompting, working with trained LoRAs, refining, upscaling, inpainting etc.)

 
Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

 
What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Equipment: Company laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD for your workspace setup
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Cursor, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

* 💸 Compensation: Our salary ranges are set based on role level, scope, location, and market data, and applied consistently regardless of candidate background or negotiation history. The final offer within the published range reflects assessed experience and scope

 
🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

jobs.title: PhD Stipend in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes
jobs.description:
Aalborg University, Department of Energy, Campus Esbjerg, invites applications for a three-year PhD Stipend from October 1st or soon hereafter in dynamic modelling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production. The project is primarily rooted in process engineering while also addressing the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid. You will contribute to interdisciplinary research spanning process engineering, power engineering and sustainable energy systems and help develop future large-scale Power-to-X solutions.

Your work tasks
In this PhD fellowship at AAU Energy, you will work with dynamic modeling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production, such as green methanol and sustainable aviation fuel produced through Fischer–Tropsch and methanol-to-jet pathways. The project primarily focuses on the process-engineering aspects of renewable fuel production, with particular emphasis on the interactions among the electrical grid, electrolysers, fuel-synthesis processes, energy storage and heat integration in integrated Power-to-X systems.

You will develop and apply physics-based process models that describe the behavior of Power-to-X plants under varying operating conditions. This includes modelling electrolysers, fuel-synthesis units and supporting energy-system components and analyzing how these systems can operate efficiently and flexibly in response to fluctuations in renewable electricity generation, energy prices and wider energy-system conditions. The work will combine process simulation with operational optimization, techno-economic assessment and model validation.

The research will also examine the coordinated operation and control of Power-to-X processes, electrolysers and energy-storage systems in interaction with the electrical grid. You will contribute to research on grid-supporting operation and control strategies for integrated Power-to-X plants.

You will carry out your research in close collaboration with academic and industrialpartners in Denmark and across Europe. The position includes, among others, preparing scientific publications, presenting results at conferences and workshops, and participating in project meetings and activities. You will also make a limited contribution to teaching or supervision at Aalborg University, for example by supervising bachelor’s and master’s students working on relevant topics.

Your competencies 
You have, or are about to obtain, a master’s degree in chemical engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering, energy engineering, sustainable energy engineering or a closely related field. You bring a solid foundation in areas such as process modelling, thermodynamics, heat and mass transfer, process dynamics and control, optimization or energy-system analysis, and you are interested in applying these disciplines to Power-to-X and renewable fuel production.

You have experience with process-modelling tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS or other related software and are motivated to develop and apply dynamic models of energy and chemical processes. You are familiar with programming languages and computational tools. Expertise in a particular software package is not required, but experience with one or more computational environments, such as MATLAB, Python or similar tools, will support your work in the project. Knowledge of Power-to-X, electrolysis, renewable fuels, process integration or energy storage will be advantageous.

Knowledge of electrical power systems, electricity markets, grid integration or the control of grid-connected energy systems would strengthen your profile but is not a requirement for the position. The core academic profile sought is within process engineering or a related discipline. You should have an interest in and motivation to learn about the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid, including how process-level operation and control affect plant flexibility and system-level performance.

You are able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research environment. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues and external partners and are comfortable discussing technical ideas across disciplinary boundaries.
You have good analytical abilities, scientific curiosity, and the ability to document and communicate your work clearly in writing and presentations. You have strong written and spoken English skills suitable for scientific collaboration and publication. We value your motivation and potential to develop across disciplines, and you are not expected to have prior expertise in every aspect of the project from the outset.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
You will join the Fluid & Process research group at AAU Energy, Campus Esbjerg, where you will become part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment combining process, chemical, energy, and electrical engineering. The group works with modeling, simulation, control, optimization, and experimental validation of fluid and energy systems, with applications including Power-to-X, carbon capture and utilization, green fuels, and sector coupling. The working culture is collaborative and informal, with close interaction among academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, PhD fellows, and students. We share an ambition to contribute to the green transition through research with practical relevance.

At Campus Esbjerg, you will work alongside academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, and PhD fellows across a range of energy-related disciplines. The campus setting supports close day-to-day collaboration across disciplines and research projects.

Collaboration with industry is an important part of the research environment, and many research and student projects are developed with external partners to address real-world engineering challenges. We aim to provide a supportive working environment with a healthy balance between professional commitments and life outside work.

The fellowship offers strong opportunities for professional and academic development.
As part of the three-year PhD program, you will conduct independent research under supervision and complete PhD courses corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS.
Courses may be taken at Aalborg University or other relevant institutions in Denmark and abroad. You will have opportunities to participate in specialized courses, summer schools, international conferences, and project workshops. The position will also provide experience in scientific publishing, research dissemination, teaching or student supervision, interdisciplinary project work, and collaboration with industrial partners.

AAU Energy offers access to modern experimental and computational facilities supporting research in sustainable energy systems. At Campus Esbjerg, these include facilities for thermal and fluid processes, electrical engineering, power electronics, renewable-energy control, offshore energy systems, and Power-to-X.

The research environment is being further strengthened through the C-TECH initiative, which is establishing a modular test site for carbon capture, electrolysis, and methanol synthesis at Campus Esbjerg. The facility is intended to support research, education, and industrial collaboration in Power-to-X and carbon capture, utilization, and storage. This creates an attractive setting for a PhD project connecting process modeling with industrial validation and integrated sustainable-energy systems.

Campus Esbjerg is located in one of Denmark’s major energy and offshore hubs, providing favorable conditions for collaboration with companies involved in renewable energy, Power-to-X, offshore technologies, and the wider energy transition. The relatively compact campus supports close professional relationships, close interaction with supervisors and colleagues, and collaboration across research and educational activities.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that:
    describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Cleanroom & GMP Cleaning Specialist Pharma and Datacenter
jobs.description:
Cleanroom & Critical Environment Cleaning Specialist

Demonstrated experience working in both pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities and hyperscale data centre environments is required.

About Vantage Support Group

Vantage Support Group provides specialist workforce and compliance services for pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities and hyperscale data centres throughout Denmark.

We are seeking an experienced Cleanroom & Critical Environment Cleaning Specialist to join our team on high-security projects where precision, contamination control and strict compliance with quality standards are essential.

About the Position

The successful candidate will perform specialist cleaning in highly controlled environments, including:

  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities

  • GMP production areas

  • ISO 14644 classified cleanrooms

  • Critical environments within hyperscale data centres

  • Technical installations and commissioning areas

The role requires exceptional attention to detail and strict compliance with contamination control procedures, client requirements and health & safety regulations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform specialist cleaning of cleanrooms and controlled environments.

  • Clean technical installations and critical infrastructure.

  • Carry out GMP-compliant cleaning within pharmaceutical production areas.

  • Perform post-construction and commissioning cleaning within hyperscale data centres.

  • Follow ISO 14644 cleanroom standards.

  • Work in contamination-controlled environments.

  • Operate industrial cleaning equipment.

  • Operate heavy machinery including telehandlers, forklifts and MEWPs where required.

  • Maintain cleaning records and quality documentation.

  • Comply with all HSE and client procedures.

Essential Qualifications

Applicants must have:

  • Minimum 3 years of documented experience in specialist industrial cleaning.

  • Proven experience within pharmaceutical facilities and/or hyperscale data centres.

  • Experience with GMP cleaning procedures.

  • Experience working in ISO 14644 classified cleanrooms.

  • Knowledge of contamination control procedures.

  • Experience with cleaning of technical installations and sensitive equipment.

  • Experience working in live construction or commissioning environments.

  • Experience operating industrial cleaning machinery.

  • Experience operating telehandlers, forklifts or similar heavy equipment.

  • Valid Category B driving licence.

  • Ability to obtain security clearance.

Language Requirements

Communication

Daily communication on site is conducted primarily in English. Applicants must therefore be able to understand work instructions, safety procedures and site documentation in English.

Additional language skills are considered an advantage when working in international teams.

Personal Profile

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • Excellent attention to detail.

  • Strong quality awareness.

  • Ability to work independently.

  • Professional attitude towards safety and compliance.

  • Flexibility regarding working hours.

  • Ability to work within multinational teams.

We Offer

  • Permanent employment in Denmark.

  • Competitive salary based on experience.

  • Long-term projects within the pharmaceutical and hyperscale data centre sectors.

  • Continuous training and professional development.

  • Opportunity to work on some of Europe's most advanced technical facilities.

jobs.title: Tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttava Myyjä/Lajittelija
jobs.description:
Tule mukaan merkitykselliseen myyntityöhön iCare hyväntekeväisyysmyymälään!

Pelastusarmeijan iCare hyväntekeväisyysmyymälät sijaitsevat Tampereella Koskikeskuksessa (\*Hatanpään Valtatie 1) Aukioloajat: ma-pe 10-20, la 10-18, su 12-18 sekä Epilässä (\*Pispalan Valtatie 133) Aukioloajat: ma-pe 10-18, la 10-16. Avarissa myymälöissä myydään second hand-aarteita laidasta laitaan. Lisäksi Pelastusarmeijalla on iCare myymälöitä valtakunnallisesti. Haemme tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavaa Myyjä/Lajittelijaa molempiin myymälöihin.

Tutustu myymälöihin linkistä: https://www.pelastusarmeija.fi/icare-myymalat

Työtehtäviin kuuluu

Asiakaspalvelua ja kassatyöskentelyä. Tuotteiden esille laittoa. Myytävän materiaalin lajittelua, varastohallintaa ja hinnoittelua. Myymälätilan viihtyisyydestä ja positiivisesta asiakaskokemuksesta huolehtimista. Myymälän sosiaalisen median teko yhdessä tiimin kanssa.

Toivoisimme sinulta

Kokemusta vaatemyymälän ylläpidosta sekä kiinnostusta vaatealaa ja kiertotaloutta kohtaan. Tietämystä materiaaleista, tuotemerkeistä ja hintatasosta. Olethan myynnin ammattilainen, eli sinulla on kokemusta kaupallisesta työskentelystä. Olet positiivinen ja sinulla on aito halu työskennellä asiakaspalvelussa. Olet yhteistyökykyinen ja sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot. Sitoudut työn tavoitteisiin ja olet kykenevä fyysiseen työskentelyyn. Arvostamme Second Hand osaamista tai kiinnostusta alaa kohtaan.

Tutustuthan Pelastusarmeijan arvoihin ja toivomme sinulta samantyyppistä arvopohjaa.

Työsuhteessa noudatetaan kaupan alan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaus kaupan alan TES mukaan.

Jos kiinnostus paikkaa kohtaan heräsi niin lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, viimeistään pe 7.8.2026.

Tietoa PELASTUSARMEIJASTA

Pelastusarmeijan työn päämäärä on auttaa ihmistä kokonaisvaltaisesti. Työhön kuuluu mm. sosiaalinen apu, ruoka-apu, aikuisten harrastustoiminta, lasten ja nuorten kerhot, leirit, pyhäkoulu sekä hengelliset tilaisuudet. Pelastusarmeijalla on lasten päiväkoteja ja leiritoimintaa, sosiaalipalvelukeskus, vanhusten hoitokoti, asumispalvelua sekä iCare- ja kirpputorimyymälöitä.

Hyväntekeväisyystyömme painopisteessä ovat kotimaan vähävaraiset lapsiperheet, yksinäiset vanhukset ja syrjäytymisvaarassa olevat nuoret. Kotimaan avuntarvitsijoiden tukemiseksi järjestämme vuosittain Joulupata- ja Auta ihmistä -keräykset. Tuemme kansainvälisen Pelastusarmeijan työtä mm. kummilapsitoiminnan ja katastrofikeräysten avulla.

jobs.title: Director Sales and Key accounts
jobs.description:
You already know the maritime industry. You know who makes the decisions, why change takes time and why a trusted relationship matters more than a polished sales pitch.

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We are looking for a Global Key Account Director to join our Commercial team. Our people are our greatest assets and the driving force behind our mission, which is to enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’.

We don't just digitalize procurement. We make it smarter. By combining marketplace reach with procurement intelligence, we help shipping companies, ship managers, caterers and suppliers make better purchasing decisions through data-driven insights, recommendations and intelligent procurement tools. We create value beyond the individual transaction, enabling buyers to gain greater visibility and control over spend while helping suppliers grow through digital collaboration.

Source2Sea is part of Wrist Group, the world leader in the field of procuring and delivering supplies to the maritime industry with a turnover in 2024 of more than DKK 5.7 billion.

Reporting to our CEO, you will become part of a strong and exciting commercial team. The position is based in Copenhagen.

Summary

The successful candidate will have excellent door opening skills at highest level in the industry - either through own network, via contacts or by creating an appealing proposition which begins a meaningful communication.

You are motivated by building B2B relationships – challenging customers to rethink how maritime procurement can create greater value through digitalization and data. Through active listening and strong problem solving skills, you are able toprobe and understand the customers pain points and opportunities, and can unlock these in a tangible way.

We expect you to have a “digital-first” mindset and to be the driving force within your area of responsibility; to build long-term partnership while managing day to day relationships.

Your primary responsibilities in this role will be:

Since Source2Sea is in high growth mode the tasks will be broad and varied and a high level of adaption to customer needs is expected. In other words you will be required to roll up your sleeves.

  • The predominant part of the role will be opening doors to shipping companies, listen and understand their business challenges and demonstrate how Source2Sea creates value through our marketplace and procurement platform.

  • Tactical planning and pipeline management to ensure a prioritized approach towards the right customers, based on their individual position, needs and likelihood to embark on the digital journey.

  • Drive customer dialog until commitment to trade on Source2Sea, while gradually looping in the Customer Success team, who will handle the onboarding process and experience.

  • Bring strategic customer insights back into Product, Customer Success and Leadership to help shape the continued development of the Source2Sea platform.

  • Create and maintain sales/account plans for target clients (forecasting, planning, budget management, follow-ups, etc.).

  • Together with the commercial team you will be planning and aligning buyer pipeline category and geographical needs with matching supplier pipeline.

We are looking for these Qualifications & Requirements:

  • A “digital-first” mindset, with the ability to see and sell the benefits of being digital.

  • Door opener and relationship builder, with a documented network with the ability to engage senior executives through a consultative, value-driven sales approach.

  • Minimum 7 years of sales experience at management level.

  • Experience in the maritime industry - from either Shipowner, Ship Manager, Supplier or Service Provider.

  • Active listener with strong problem solving skills.

  • Curiosity – it is not enough to ask "What?”. You want to know “Why?”

  • Ability to travel min. 7 days / month is expected.

In return we offer:

  • A combination of a financially robust enterprise that also offers a scale-up approach.

  • The opportunity to shape the future of maritime procurement.

  • Cutting edge use of technology incl. AI, driving efficiency and a unique customer experience – with a documented strong Net Promotor Score.

  • A modern, agile and forward-looking scale-up without legacy constraints.

  • An international team – currently 7 locations and +10 nationalities.

  • Highly digital and maritime-skilled colleagues to learn from.

  • A combination of working from home and at the office.

  • A professional and challenging job in a global company with an ambitious growth strategy.

  • High impact on own role with great personal development and growth opportunities.

  • The salary and benefits will correspond to your qualifications and results.

Visit www.source2sea.com or our LinkedIn profile to learn more about our great digital scale-up.

About Source2Sea

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’ across provisions, stores, spare parts and other vessel supplies through structured digital catalogues, intelligent procurement tools, actionable insights and recommendations.

By connecting shipping companies, ship managers and caterers with a global network of maritime suppliers, Source2Sea creates value beyond the individual transaction. The marketplace provides global supplier reach, greater choice and structured digital catalogues, while the platform transforms the maritime industry's strongest data foundation into greater spend visibility, smarter purchasing decisions, increased automation and more efficient supplier collaboration and growth.

Developed in close collaboration with leading shipping companies and suppliers, Source2Sea already supports global customers at scale and continues to expand its international supplier network and platform capabilities.

Source2Sea is an independent company founded and funded by Wrist Group, the global leader in marine supply and logistics. The venture was established in collaboration with BCG X in 2021 and is headquartered at Woods Augusthus in Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Ingénieur-e logistic support analysis (lsa) (h/f)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



SLS est le leader mondial des trains d'atterrissage, roues & freins, et systèmes associés, pour avions civils, militaires, hélicoptères. Nous maîtrisons l'ensemble du cycle de vie de nos produits, de la conception et la fabrication jusqu'à la maintenance.



Envie d'évoluer dans un environnement international, stimulant et bienveillant, au sein d'une entreprise à taille humaine ? Rejoignez-nous !



Vous ne remplissez pas 100 % des critères ? Ce n'est pas un frein pour nous. Ce que l'on recherche avant tout, ce sont des personnes créatives et engagées !



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionThe Supportability & Maintenance Engineer plays a key role in the life and profitability of a programme. He/she works across many different areas and gains insight into numerous sectors within Safran Landing Systems. He/she operates in an international environment: internally (Toronto, Gloucester), externally (AIRBUS, BOEING, DASSAULT, ATR for instance) as well as with our potential customers in the civil and military markets.

Reporting to the Integrated Product Support (IPS) manager, the LSA/Product Support Engineer is responsible for Logistic Support Analysis (LSA) supportability plan and its update through both the development and operational phases of the product life cycle. To produce, maintain and update the LSA Records for supportability, maintainability, reliability and cost of ownership performance data. To provide the necessary information and justification data to enable LSA engineering performance requirements to be integrated into the design and support of the product. In addition, the LSA supports internal and external customers, with associated activities to improve the flexibility of Safran landing Systems' offerings.

o Undertake LSA engineering studies and produce predictions reports during the design and development phase for reliability, Life Cycle Cost (LCC), Direct Maintenance Cost (DMC), reliability and logistics in preparation for Entry into Service (EIS) according to the Integrated Logistic Support (ILS) plan.

o Interface between Design Engineering, Procurement and Customer Support during the product development phase to ensure the integration of LSA Engineering supportability, maintainability, reliability and LCC performance requirements.

o Produce a supportability and maintainability evaluation report together with a Level of Repair Analysis (LORA) for the purpose of logistics management and DMC prediction evaluation.

o Specify, produce and update the product support deliverables (including but not limited to MSG-3 analysis, Maintenance Task Analysis (MTA) and validation of the MTA, Human Factors, Initial Provisioning (IP), Ground Support and shop tooling list, Training material).

o Interface with partners, suppliers and subcontractors in respect of LSA activities and requirements.

o To develop and enhance LSA Engineering analysis methodologies and techniques in support of product Research & Technology (R&T) studies and business improvement needs.

Activities focused on Landing Gear products: Airbus Single Aisle Family, A400M, ATR, Dassault Aviation Falcon

jobs.title: Sanitør til skadeservice | bliv en del af Ocab Sjælland
jobs.description:
Hos Ocab hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder videre efter brand-, vand- og skimmelskader. Vi søger nu en sanitør, der har lyst til en hverdag med ansvar, faglige udfordringer og et stærkt fællesskab.
 
Som en del af vores team bliver du en vigtig brik i arbejdet med at begrænse skader og hjælpe kunderne godt videre. Vi ved, at en hurtig og professionel indsats kan gøre en stor forskel – både for bygninger og for de mennesker, der bliver berørt.


Om jobbet

Som sanitør hos Ocab får du en alsidig hverdag med opgaver hos både private kunder, virksomheder og forsikringsselskaber. Du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger, men får også et stort selvstændigt ansvar i de enkelte opgaver.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok – uanset om opgaven er stor eller lille.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Blotlægning og nedrivning i forbindelse med vandskader

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Opsætning og tilsyn med affugtningsudstyr

  • Dokumentation af opgaver fra start til slut

  • Deltagelse i vores døgnvagtsordning

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere om den bedste løsning for kunden

Derudover kan du også komme til at arbejde med

  • Asbestsanering

  • Sanering efter skadedyr

  • Rengøring og sanering efter brandskader

  • Oprydning og rengøring i forbindelse med socialsager

Vi forestiller os, at du

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager ansvar og møder dine kolleger og kunder med en positiv indstilling.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra skadeservice eller lignende branche – erfaring med skadeservice er en fordel

  • Har asbestbevis eller erfaring med asbestsanering (en fordel, men ikke et krav)

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og sætter en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde

  • Er fleksibel og trives i en hverdag, hvor planerne kan ændre sig

  • Er en god holdspiller, som bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • Bor på Sjælland, så du har en rimelig afstand til de opgaver, du bliver tilknyttet

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en straffeattest.

Vi lægger stor vægt på både dine faglige kompetencer og dine menneskelige kvaliteter. Derfor opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen – uanset baggrund, køn eller erfaring.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Hver dag hjælper vi private, virksomheder og offentlige kunder med at begrænse skader og genetablere bygninger efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader.

Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed, moderne udstyr og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag

  • Dygtige kolleger og et stærkt sammenhold

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Normal arbejdstid mandag-fredag kl. 07.00-15.00

  • Deltagelse i døgnvagtsordning

Arbejdssted: Sjælland

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette
kandidat.


Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakt driftsleder Stefan Nissen på + tlf. +45 25 10 16 42.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ocab.dk


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Hälytyskeskuspäivystäjä (ensihoitaja), Espoon tilannekeskus, Espoo
jobs.description:
Haluatko työlläsi vaikuttaa asiakkaidemme itsenäiseen ja turvalliseen asumiseen omassa kodissaan mahdollisimman pitkään? Nyt on mahdollisuus hyödyntää osaamistasi laajasti sairaanhoitajan hälytys- ja turva-auttamistehtävien parissa!

Etsimme yhtä hälytyskeskuspäivystäjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Espoon tilannekeskukseen. Tehtävässäsi pääset rakentamaan täysin uutta toimintaa yhdessä hyvinvointialueen muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Tehtävässäsi varmistat, että asiakkaamme saavat laadukasta ja viiveetöntä apua vuorokauden ympäri.

Sinulla on työvuorokohtainen tiimin sairaanhoidollinen vastuu ja ohjaat, neuvot ja tuet muita hälytyskeskuspäivystäjiä sekä olet turva-auttajien konsultoitavissa. Toimit konsultoijana turva-auttamistehtäviä hoitavalle henkilöstölle ja olet tiimin koordinaatiovastuussa häiriö- ja kriisitilanteissa sekä suunnittelet ja järjestät koulutuksia turva-auttamistehtävien osalta. Asiakkaitamme ovat turva-auttamispalvelun asiakkaat kaikissa hyvinvointialueen kunnissa. Suurin osa asiakkaista on iäkkäitä.

Muita keskeisiä vastuualueitasi ovat hälytysten vastaanottaminen hälytyskeskusjärjestelmän kautta, yhteydenottaminen asiakkaisiin, hälytysten syiden selvittäminen ja asiakkaiden hoidon tarpeen arviointi sekä ohjaaminen etänä. Ohjaat tarvittaessa turva-auttamistehtävät eteenpäin kotikäyntejä tekevälle henkilöstölle, liikkuvalle sairaalalle tai ensihoidolle ja koordinoit asiakkaille vietäviä palveluja. Hallinnoit turvahälytysten tilannekuvaa hälytyskeskusjärjestelmän kautta ja seuraat hälytystehtävien etenemistä. Vastuullesi kuuluu hoidon tarpeen arvioinnin ja jatkotoimenpiteiden kirjaaminen potilastietojärjestelmään, raportointi tilanteesta eteenpäin toiselle ammattilaiselle tarvittaessa sekä turvalaitteiden testisoittojen vastaanottaminen.

Seuraat lisäksi laitehallinnasta asiakkaiden laitteiden tilaa ja ilmoitat poikkeamista, kuten pariston virran vähenemisestä kentälle. Osallistut turva-auttamispalvelun jatkuvaan kehittämiseen ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä eri yhteistyökumppaneiden, kuten kotihoidon ja pelastusviranomaisten kanssa.

Opit uusien järjestelmien käytön ketterästi ja käytät työssä tarvittavia järjestelmiä (potilastietojärjestelmä, hälytyskeskusjärjestelmä, turvalaitteiden hallintajärjestelmä ja sensoridatan analysointialusta) sujuvasti. Tunnet sote-sektorin päivystys- ja hätäkeskustoimintaa ja keskeisen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon lainsäädännön. Ymmärrät kotona asumisen tuen palvelukokonaisuutta ja asiakastarpeita.

Haastattelut järjestetään 12.8.2026 paikan päällä Espoossa, joten varaa tämä päivä kalenteriisi jo nyt!

Haethan mahdollisimman pian, sillä käymme hakemukset läpi jo hakuaikana!

Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Espoon tilannekeskus, tarkka osoite selviää myöhemmin
Työaika: 38,25 h/vko, pääosin päivätyötä
Tehtävä on vakinainen.

Kelpoisuusehto: Ensihoitaja (AMK), eli sairaanhoitaja AMK + ensihoidon täydennyskoulutus.

Tehtävässä edellytetään:
- erinomaisia suullisia ja kirjallisia viestintätaitoja suomeksi ja ruotsiksi
- hyviä yhteistyö- ja koordinointitaitoja, kohtaat ihmisiä rauhallisesti ja empaattisesti
- nopeaa ja tarkkaa asiakkaan tilanteen ja avun tarpeen arviointia hälytystiedon ja keskustelun perusteella
- itsenäistä päätöksentekokykyä yhteisten toimintamallien ja ohjeiden pohjalta
- tuntemusta sote-sektorin päivystys- ja hätäkeskustoiminnasta sekä keskeisestä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon lainsäädännöstä
- uusien järjestelmien ketterää käyttämistä tai niiden oppimista (potilastietojärjestelmä, hälytyskeskusjärjestelmä, turvalaitteiden hallintajärjestelmä ja sensoridatan analysointialusta)
- kotona asumisen tuen palvelukokonaisuuden ja asiakastarpeiden kokonaisvaltaista ymmärrystä.

Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä itseään koskeva lain 741/2023 28 §:n mukainen iäkkäiden henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevän rikostaustan selvittämiseksi tarpeellinen rikosrekisteriote.

Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48§:n mukaista rokotussuojaa ja tartuntatautilain §55 mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Työsuhteeseen valituilta pyydetään satunnaisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen päihdeohjelman mukaista huumausainetodistusta.


Olemme muutoksen tekijöitä. Uudistamme rohkeasti sen, mikä kaipaa parannusta, ja säilytämme sen, mikä toimii. Panostamme jokaisen työntekijämme hyvinvointiin ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. Tarjoamme lounasedun ja saat käyttöösi vuodessa 300 €, jonka voit käyttää toiveidesi mukaan kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi-, liikunta- tai matkalippuetuuksiin. Lisäksi pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi Eduhousen ja Oppiportin laajojen verkkokoulutusten avulla.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Consultant, Central Jutland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Six months in Delhi. A career without borders.
Are you ready to take your next career move? This opportunity will take you into the international world of fashion and textile business.Our client is a well-established Scandinavian private label and sourcing company with more than fifteen years of experience serving leading European fashion brands. From its headquarters in Denmark, supported by international sourcing and production teams across Asia and Europe, the business has built a reputation for reliability, long-term partnerships and responsible growth. Today, the company is financially strong, highly respected within the industry and entering an ambitious new phase of international expansion.Having successfully developed a mature sourcing platform in China, the next strategic step is India.

To support that journey, we are looking for an internationally minded Supply Chain Consultant who wants far more than another supply chain position.

A role that starts with an adventure... and becomes a career.
For the first six months, you will be based in Delhi. Not simply visiting suppliers. Not attending occasional meetings. But becoming part of the local organisation, working alongside experienced colleagues and helping establish the processes, collaboration and operational excellence that will support the company's future growth in India.You will experience the business from the inside, build relationships across cultures and gain an understanding of international sourcing that few professionals acquire this early in their careers.When first step og your assignment is complete, you will return to Denmark, continuing in an international position with regular travel between Europe and India, helping connect people, ideas and operations across continents. This is not a temporary assignment. It is the beginning of a long-term international career.

More than supply chain.
You will work with sourcing, production, governance, quality and operational processes. But your real contribution will be something much bigger. You will help transfer proven ways of working into a growing international organisation. You will build relationships between colleagues from different cultures. You will support local teams, develop new ways of working and help ensure that ambitious growth is matched by consistent execution. Success in this role will depend just as much on your ability to earn trust as your ability to optimise processes.

Who are you?
Perhaps you are already working as a Buyer, Merchandiser, Production Coordinator, Supply Chain Specialist or Sourcing Consultant within fashion, textiles or consumer goods.You have developed a solid commercial understanding of production and supply chain and now find yourself looking for something larger than the next promotion. You enjoy responsibility. You are naturally curious. You communicate confidently with people from different cultures. You don't mind leaving your comfort zone if it means accelerating your professional development.And while many people talk about wanting an international career, you are genuinely prepared to live it.Previous experience working with suppliers in India would be highly valued, although your attitude, curiosity and ability to build relationships will be equally important.

Why this opportunity stands out
Few organisations can offer the combination of stability and adventure that this role provides.You will join a profitable, well-established international company with an experienced leadership team, an ambitious growth strategy and a genuine commitment to developing its people.During your assignment in Delhi, accommodation and practical support will be provided, allowing you to focus on the experience itself rather than the logistics. This also means that you will have a driver available, as well as help in the household.More importantly, you will gain something that cannot easily be taught in a classroom or acquired through occasional business travel; international credibility, cross-cultural leadership experience, and the confidence that comes from helping build an organisation across borders.

Interested?
If you are looking for a career that combines international experience, meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to influence how an ambitious organisation grows, we would very much like to hear from you.We make it easy for you, so no written application is necessary. We simply ask you to register with your CV. Your interest will be handled with utmost discretion.

jobs.title: Product Support Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Product Support Manager will be responsible for leading a team of Product Support Specialists in Hyderabad. You will collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive product support operations across the global team. This role will surface customer and product usage trends, drive resolution for executive-level product escalations, and continuously improve global support and escalation processes. The successful candidate should bring deep expertise in product support and escalation management, including experience driving process improvements and collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.

They will also have strong experience managing a high-performing team of product support specialists across multiple levels, ensuring timely issue resolution, operational excellence, and a seamless customer experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive Product Support operations across the global organization.

 - This role will support the growth and maturity of product support programs by identifying areas of improvement, partnering with Product and Engineering teams to refine support processes, policies, and tooling, and serving as one of the drivers of product support excellence within Customer Experience (CX).

 - Manage executive-level product escalations end-to-end, including stakeholder communication, customer updates, and coordination with global product and engineering teams to drive timely and effective resolution.

 - The successful candidate should have deep product support expertise, strong experience driving process improvements, and a proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally, along with experience managing and developing high-performing teams of product support specialists across multiple levels.

 - Analyze data regularly and drive continuous improvement.

 - Maintain and report on KPIs and provide ad hoc reporting as necessary.

 - Proactively identify areas for improvement and own the implementation of necessary changes to CX support processes. Own, coordinate and ship process improvements in collaboration with the User Ops, and influence on behalf of CX for cross-functionally owned processes and tools.

 - Participate in the global on-call rotation to cover incidents.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 8+ years of work experience in Product support team of a software company.

 - 3+ years of work experience in leading and managing a Product support team.

 - You have deep understanding of the nuance of managing product support and executive escalations, and can apply that to improve the customer experience.

 - You are extremely user-focused, with a passion for solving problems that increase the user quality of life for customers.

 - You are deeply passionate about developing others, finding energy and purpose in mentoring team members to reach their full potential, and taking pride in seeing them thrive under your leadership.

 - Strong technical support foundations, including log reading and basic debugging, core API concepts, webhook fundamentals, and SSO basics (OAuth and SAML).

 - Proficiency in incorporating AI into day-to-day work (e.g., drafting and refining customer responses, summarizing context, analyzing trends, and accelerating troubleshooting) while applying strong judgment, privacy, and quality standards.

 - Proven ability to triage, troubleshoot, and handle support tickets end-to-end, including prioritization/severity judgment, clear written communication, and timely stakeholder updates.

 - You have strong data reporting and data analytics skills.

 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

 - Experience handling business intelligence tools and systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Hex, Looker.

 - Experience building robust and scalable processes spanning across go-to-market and technical teams.

 - Ability to deep dive and own projects individually while also delegating and empowering team members to deliver.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience working in a fast-paced start-up environment

 - You are familiar with and/or a user of Notion

Hotelportier for Boutique Hotel Herman K
jobs.description:
Portier

We are looking for a professional, courteous, and service-oriented Portier who is passionate about hospitality and creating exceptional guest experiences for our Boutique Hotel in the heart of Copenhagen. As one of the first and last team members our guests encounter, you play a vital role in ensuring every arrival and departure leaves a lasting impression.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys being active throughout the day, and takes pride in delivering service with attention to detail. You are approachable, proactive, and professional, with the ability to remain calm and organized even during busy periods.

As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the daily operation of a luxury 5-star boutique hotel while working alongside dedicated colleagues who share a passion for excellence, teamwork, and genuine hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome guests warmly upon arrival and wish them a memorable farewell upon departure.

  • Assist guests with luggage to and from their rooms.

  • Support the Front Office team with arrivals, departures, and ensuring a seamless check-in experience.

  • Open doors and escort guests throughout the hotel when needed.

  • Provide information about the hotel, its facilities, and local attractions.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming entrance, lobby, and surrounding guest areas.

  • Coordinate with Hosts, Housekeeping, and other departments to deliver a seamless guest experience.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to guest requests with discretion and attention to detail.

  • Assist with luggage storage, deliveries, and other operational tasks as required.

  • Help create a warm, welcoming atmosphere that reflects the hotel's high service standards.

What We Offer

  • A key role in creating memorable first and last impressions for our guests.

  • The opportunity to work in a prestigious luxury 5-star boutique hotel.

  • A varied and dynamic working day with guests from around the world.

  • A supportive and professional team environment where collaboration, hospitality, and respect are at the heart of everything we do.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional development through training, coaching, and continuous learning.

  • A workplace with high ambitions, short decision-making processes, and the freedom to take responsibility.

  • Competitive salary and attractive employee benefits.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in hospitality, customer service, or a guest-facing role is an advantage, but not essential.

  • You are friendly, approachable, and genuinely enjoy creating great guest experiences.

  • You work in a structured and reliable manner while taking responsibility for your tasks.

  • You communicate confidently and professionally in English; additional languages are an advantage.

  • You remain calm under pressure and can maintain a positive attitude during busy periods.

  • You are proactive, solution-oriented, and enjoy working as part of a team.

  • You have excellent attention to detail and take pride in maintaining high standards.

  • You are flexible and comfortable working evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required.

  • If the role includes valet parking, a valid driver's license is an advantage but not required for all candidates.

If you are passionate about luxury hospitality and take pride in creating unforgettable guest experiences, we would love to hear from you.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application no later than 15 August 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Zeljka Stefanic Urbina at teamlead@hermank.dk. Please include "Portier" in the subject line of your email.

Part of Bühlmann Hotels

Bühlmann Hotels is home to a collection of unique hotels across Denmark, ranging from vibrant city hotels to iconic boutique properties. While each hotel has its own distinctive character, we are united by a shared commitment to exceptional hospitality and the values that define our culture: care, flexibility, presence, passion, and respect for people and the environment.

Learn more about our hotels at www.buhlmann.dk.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Singapore
Myyntipäällikkö
jobs.description:
Etsimme Nostopalvelu Simolalle myynnistä vastaavaa henkilöä, joka ottaa omistajuuden menestyvän yhtiön tulevaisuuden kasvusta. Tehtävässä pääset kohtaamaan nostopalveluja käyttävän monimuotoisen asiakaskunnan ja auttamaan asiakkaita toteuttamaan nostamiseen liittyvät tarpeet tehokkaasti ja turvallisesti.

Nostopalvelu Simola Oy on nostopalveluihin erikoistunut yritys, joka perustettiin vuonna 1990. Toimimme vastuullisesti ja pidämme huolta työntekijöiden sekä työympäristön turvallisuudesta. Lisätietoja yrityksestä pääset lukemaan osoitteesta https://nostopalvelusimola.fi/

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä alan edelläkävijäyrityksessä osaavien huippuammattilaisten kanssa

- Tehtävän vakavaraisessa ja hyvin hoidetussa perheyrityksessä

- Modernit työtilat Liedon Avantissa

- Perehdytyksen nostamisen maailmaan

- Markkinoiden parhaat nostokalustoratkaisut

- Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen, joka koostuu kuukausipalkasta ja kannustavasta tulospalkkiosta


**Tehtäväsi**

Myyt nostamiseen liittyviä palveluratkaisuja Varsinais-Suomen alueella. Vastaat nykyisten asiakassuhteiden kehittämisestä ja lujittamisesta. Lisäksi etsit aktiivisesti uusia asiakkuuksia rakentamisen, teollisuuden ja julkisyhteisötoimijoiden piiristä.

**Millaista osaajaa etsimme**

Olet aloitteellinen, utelias ja pitkäjänteinen. Et odottele tarjouspyyntöjä, vaan seuraat kohdealueellamme tapahtuvien hankkeiden edistymistä ja autat nostopalveluja tarvitsevia asiakkaita jo hankkeiden suunnitteluvaiheessa. Viihdyt erilaisten ihmisten parissa niin työmaaolosuhteissa kuin neuvottelupöydänkin ääressä. Käytät MS-Office -työkaluja sujuvasti.

**Toivomme sinulta**

- Teknistä ja/tai kaupallista koulutusta

- 6+ vuoden kokemusta itsenäisestä myyntityöstä yrityksille

- Näyttöjä saavutuksista myyntityössä

- Käytännön englannin kielen taitoa

- Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta


Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen palvelumyynnistä tai koneiden ja laitteiden vuokraustoiminnasta. Työkokemus rakennusalalta tai teollisuudesta auttaa sinua ymmärtämään asiakkaidemme toimintaympäristöä ja hankkeissa tarvittavaa nostamiseen liittyvää kapasiteettia.

**Hakeminen**

Jos kiinnostuit tästä mahdollisuudesta tulla mukaan tekemään tulosta erinomaisessa yhteisössä ja huippukalustolla, kuulisimme sinusta mielellämme. Lähetä hakemuksesi, ansioluettelosi sekä palkkatoiveesi (vuosiansio) viimeistään 1.8.2026 osoitteeseen jari@nostopalvelusimola.fi

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa toimitusjohtaja Jari Simola, puh. 0500524536.

jobs.title: Business development manager m/f (h/f)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.



Descriptif mission
As a 'Business Development Manager' at Safran Trusted 4D, you'll lead growth initiatives and strategic customer engagement for our precision Timing & Synchronization portfolio across defense, commercial, and critical infrastructure markets. You'll drive partner relationships, identify new market opportunities, and work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver mission-critical timing solutions in GNSS-contested environments.



The Day to Day looks like:

o Gather market data and generate Market Surveys and approaches to market

for assigned territories.

o Lead customer and end-user relationships across ST4D Timing portfolio.

o Ensure a long-term strategic partnership is maintained with all the BP's and

end-users.

o Provide product and Sales training to approved BP's.

o Provide technical input to BP's and End-users for requests.

o Review pipelines with BP's and open opportunities with End-users including.

o Contribute to S1 and S2 bid reviews.

o Initiate and assist BP due diligence.

o Support post-sales support queries that are complex and require onsite

customer engagement.

o Business development of ST4D Timing portfolio in new and after-sales

market.

o Maintain on-going customer relationships, ensure customer satisfaction.

o Participation and follow-up of meetings, report writing.

o Interact and co-ordinate closely with all levels within the company (sales,

support, program, finance).

o Ensure a constant awareness of market tenders, budgets, geopolitical context

and regulation as they impact the Defense and Commercial Timing and

Simulation markets within your territory.

o Contribute to internal road maps, issuing marketing analysis and propose

action plans to develop the business in your territory.

jobs.title: Responsable commercial aéronautique (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste Job Description:***Un poste de *Responsable Commercial et Contrats (h/f)* est à pourvoir au sein de l'organisation Ventes et Marketing d'Airbus Defence and Space. Le poste sera basé à Elancourt (78 Le Responsable Commercial et Contrats (h/f) sera chargé/e d'apporter son expertise commerciale et juridique au cours de la phase de BID, pendant l'exécution du contrat et jusqu'à sa clôture.


En tant que Responsable Commercial et Contrats (h/f), vous serez le point focal commercial et contractuel pour les autres départements et fonctions impliqués dans la préparation de l'offre puis, dans l'exécution du projet. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe Core Team avec le Campaign Manager, le Bid Manager, le Program manager, l'acheteur ou l'engineering, et la Finance.


Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l'IGI 1300 du 30/11/2011 (article 65 Tâches et responsabilités***Vos principales tâches et responsabilités seront les suivantes Négociation offres et propositions***Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes (juridique, conformité, finance, centre de compétence, export control, etc.) et fournir des solutions commerciales rentables***Évaluer les risques commerciaux, financiers, contractuels, de conformité et de contrôle des exportations et trouver des alternatives pour les minimiser***Proposer et négocier des modifications contractuelles toujours dans le but d'améliorer la performance de nos projets et de limiter les risques***Préparation de la documentation relative aux aspects commerciaux et juridiques de l'offre***Assurer la cohérence avec les directives d'Airbus Defence and Space***Responsable de la négociation sur les aspects commerciaux de la proposition avec les clients***Soutenir le développement de nouvelles opportunités et de nouveaux services.***Gestion des contrats***Gérer les contrats existants conformément aux procédures de l'entreprise et aux exigences contractuelles, afin d'assurer une exécution efficace et performante des activités commerciales (telles que le paiement rapide des factures, la résolution des réclamations)***Rédiger et négocier les avenants au contrat***Être le point focal pour tout sujet contractuel pendant l'exécution du projet en soutien au gestionnaire de projet/programme et avec le support du service juridique***Développer le rapport/relation avec les clients pour assurer le bon déroulement des contrats existants.


Des déplacements professionnels sont à prévoir en Europe. e ce fait, vous devez être disposé(e) à vous déplacer en conséquence.***Compétences requises***De formation ingénieur, juridique ou commercial, vous avez ensuite développé une connaissance et expérience en appel d'offre et en négociation commerciale et contractuelle.


Vous avez les compétences et l'expérience suivantes Au moins* 5 ans* d'expérience dans le montage de propositions commerciales et contractuelles (la connaissance des règles des marchés publics/gouvernementaux - DGA française est un plus)***Connaissance accrue d'Excel, Word et PowerPoint***Autonomie et capacité de synthèse et d'analyse***Esprit d'équipe, communication et capacité de convaincre Vous avez l'habitude des négociations (tant au sein d'Airbus qu'avec les clients), en français mais également en *anglais***Un CV en anglais et un CV en français est demandé.***A Commercial and Contracts Manager (m/f) position is available within the Sales and Marketing organization of Airbus Defence and Space. The position will be based in Elancourt.


The Commercial and Contracts Manager (m/f) will be responsible for providing commercial and legal expertise during the BID phase, contract execution, and until contract closure.


As a Commercial and Contracts Manager (m/f), you will be the commercial and contractual focal point for other departments and functions involved in the preparation of the offer and then in the project execution. You will be part of the Core Team with the Campaign Manager, the Bid Manager, the Program Manager, the buyer or engineering, and Finance.


This position will require a French security clearance or will require eligibility for clearance by recognized authorities.***Tasks and Responsibilities***Your main tasks and responsibilities will be as follows:***Offer and Proposal Negotiation***Work closely with internal stakeholders (legal, compliance, finance, center of expertise, export control, etc provide profitable commercial solutions Evaluate commercial, financial, contractual, compliance, and export control risk***find alternatives to minimize them***Propose and negotiate contractual amendments always with the aim of improving the performance of our projects and limiting risks***Prepare documentation related to the commercial and legal aspects of the offer Ensure consistency with Airbus Defence and Space directives***Responsible for negotiating the commercial aspects of the proposal with customers Support the development of new opportunities and new services.
