jobs.title: Strategic Finance, Business Partnership & Workflow Automation
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Finance Business Partner to join Notion’s Strategic Finance team. In this role, you’ll partner closely with leaders across Finance, People, Legal, and other business functions to drive financial insights, improve planning processes, and provide strategic analyses to enable the company to scale thoughtfully. The ideal candidate brings deep FP&A expertise and a passion for automation and continuous improvement.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with executive leaders and functional leaders to drive critical business decisions. Build trusted relationships and proactively surface insights, risks, and opportunities.

 - Build and own financial models, including capacity and benefits modeling. Prepare strategic trade-off analyses that help leadership prioritize investments so Notion scales responsibly.

 - Partner with Corporate Finance, Accounting, and cross-functional teams to deliver monthly and quarterly reporting and forecasting. Ensure accurate, timely reporting, providing clear variance explanations, and translating results into actionable recommendations for executives and functional leaders.

 - Identify and implement AI and automation-driven improvements that allow financial processes to scale, drive real-time reporting, and enable impactful analyses.

 - Deliver thoughtful ad hoc analyses for executive and business partner with strong judgment, speed, and attention to detail.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Experience leveraging AI in financial workflows. You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - 4-6 years of experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, or Strategic Finance in the technology industry; or in accounting, investment banking, consulting, treasury, or private equity

 - Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, budget vs. actuals, annual planning, and long-range planning

 - Comfortable partnering directly with senior leadership and building cross-functional relationships

 - Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and a desire to continually up-level current approaches and processes

 - Strong work ethic, reliability, and attention to detail — “get it done” attitude




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with a high-growth tech company, including native AI, SaaS, or consumption-based businesses

 - Experience with NetSuite, Workday, Zip, and planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Anaplan)

 - Working knowledge of SQL

jobs.title: Fund Controller - Senior Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Fund Controller - Senior Manager
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Job description
Requisition ID:  1727473

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Fund Controller

Position Summary

The Fund Controller is responsible for the overall financial governance, oversight, and representation of a portfolio of Real Estate / Private Equity funds serviced.

Acting as the primary finance lead and trusted advisor to the client, the Fund Controller provides fund-level accountability for financial reporting, investor deliverables, audit coordination, regulatory compliance, and operational performance. The role serves as the key interface between the client and EY's delivery teams, ensuring that all outputs produced through EY's Managed Services platform are accurate, complete, timely and fit for investor, auditor and regulatory use.

The Fund Controller operates within a global delivery model leveraging EY's technology-enabled platform, including fund accounting, treasury, consolidation, reporting and workflow solutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Fund Governance and Fund Representation

• Serve as the designated Fund Controller for a portfolio of client funds.
• Provide overall governance and financial oversight across all fund processes.
• Review, challenge and approve financial outputs prepared by EY delivery teams.
• Assess whether reporting outputs are fit for investor, auditor, lender and regulatory purposes.
• Act as the final approval authority for fund-level reporting deliverables.
• Escalate significant risks, accounting issues and operational matters to client leadership and EY management.

2. Client Relationship Management

• Act as the primary finance contact for assigned clients.
• Lead governance and operating committee meetings.
• Build trusted relationships with CFOs, Fund Directors, Portfolio Managers and Investors.
• Provide proactive insights regarding fund performance, risks and reporting matters.
• Support business development opportunities and contribute to account growth initiatives.

3. Oversight of Fund Accounting Operations

• Oversee end-to-end fund administration activities performed by EY delivery teams.
• Challenge accounting treatments and complex transactions.
• Review:
o NAV calculations
o Consolidations
o Capital calls and distributions
o Debt and financing activities
o Waterfall calculations
o Investment accounting
o Foreign currency translations
• Ensure compliance with agreed reporting calendars and service level agreements.

4. Financial Reporting & Investor Deliverables

• Review and approve:
o Financial statements
o Consolidated reporting packages
o Investor reporting
o Board reporting materials
o Fund performance analyses
• Ensure reporting remains audit-ready throughout the reporting cycle.
• Drive consistency of reporting across fund structures and jurisdictions.

5. Audit and Regulatory Oversight

• Coordinate statutory audits and investor audit processes.
• Act as the primary contact for external auditors.
• Challenge audit observations and oversee remediation actions.

6. Service Provider Coordination

• Oversee interactions with:
o Property Managers
o Administrators
o Depositaries
o Banks
o Auditors
o Tax Advisors
o Legal Advisors
• Monitor service quality and performance.
• Resolve operational issues and coordinate complex stakeholder interactions.

7. Oversight of EY Delivery Teams

• Lead multidisciplinary EY teams across Luxembourg and Global Delivery Services.
• Review quality of work produced by accounting, controlling and reporting teams.
• Define review standards and escalation thresholds.
• Drive continuous improvement, standardisation and automation initiatives.
• Promote efficient utilisation of EY technology platforms and managed service tools.

8. Risk Management & Control

• Identify operational, financial and reporting risks.
• Challenge unusual transactions and accounting judgments.
• Ensure robust documentation, governance and audit trail requirements are maintained.
• Review and monitor key controls across the end-to-end operating model.

Required Experience

Education

• Master's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business Administration.
• Professional qualification strongly preferred:
o ACCA
o CPA
o CA
o CFA

Experience

• 8–15 years of experience in:
o Fund Administration
o Private Equity
o Real Estate
o Infrastructure
o Alternative Investments
o Asset Management Servicing
• Strong experience managing audits, investor reporting and complex fund structures.
• Experience working within a global operating model and managing offshore delivery teams.

Technical Expertise

Strong knowledge of:

• IFRS, Lux GAAP, US GAAP
• Fund Accounting
• Consolidation
• NAV Oversight
• Capital Activity Management
• Fund Structures and Waterfalls
• Debt and Treasury Management
• Regulatory Framework
• Internal Controls and Governance

Experience with:

• Yardi
• eFront
• Investran

Key Competencies

Client Leadership

• Executive presence
• Relationship management
• Stakeholder influence
• Commercial mindset

Technical Excellence

• Strong accounting judgment
• Analytical rigor
• Regulatory awareness
• Risk assessment

Operational Leadership

• Team leadership
• Global delivery management
• Process optimisation
• Change management

What we offer you

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

jobs.title: EXPERIENCED RESEARCHER IN THE FIELD OF FRUGAL/GREEN AI (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The LIST AI Initiative, supported by the LIST Board of Directors, aims to expand LIST's AI capabilities and maximise the impact of AI innovation both within LIST (AI applied to scientific research in all LIST RDI units and AI applied to improve the performance of LIST corporate support functions) and outside LIST (AI applied to improve products, services and processes of private and public organisations through collaborative projects and/or contract research).
One of the key areas of interest in the LIST AI initiative is that of Frugal AI, understood in a very broad sense: from the analysis of “frugality” of current AI models to the selection/adaptation of models to be deployed in constrained resources (in terms of energy, memory…) depending on the client requirements as part of the design process of a new software system with sustainability concerns.

In this context, LIST is seeking to recruit an AI experienced researcher with a strong specialization and interest in the field of Frugal AI (and similar terms: green AI, low-resource AI, constrained AI, …).

You will join the LIST AI Initiative team as a member of the SWRDI research group and collaborate with peers in a dynamic and evolving research environment within the SWRDI group, the HANDS unit and, in general, with other LIST units requiring expertise in the Frugal AI field.

The SWRDI team specializes in the design and development of smart (i.e. AI-enhanced) software systems. We believe energy concerns should be part of the software design from its early stages and therefore, we believe there is the need to specify resource requirements as part of the requirements engineering phase. These requirements will be then analysed against the energy/memory requirements of AI models to optimize the system behaviour while minimizing the resources consumed by the AI components in it.

We'll expect from you to lead research and innovation (RDI) activities in Frugal AI. As an experienced researcher, you will take the lead in:
• Delivering Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) activities.
• Developing and coaching the LIST RDI teams in this topic; and
• Maximising the impact of Frugal AI initiatives through externally funded projects with public or private organisations.
Your role will include:
• Lead the research, development and innovation (RDI) activities on the Frugal AI topic, defining and shaping research directions in line with LIST's strategic objectives.
• Drive the development of innovative Frugal AI technologies and methodologies.
• Develop and manage RDI project proposals, ensuring alignment with strategic research objectives at the group and unit level. Identify funding and grant opportunities; prepare and submit proposals to secure financial support for RDI activities.
• Oversee the execution of RDI projects with external partners, ensuring that they meet their objectives, timelines and budgets.
•  Align with ongoing standards around Frugal AI and Green AI and explore opportunities and collaborations with the consortia behind those standards.
• Establish and maintain collaborations with industrial partners, public organisations, research institutes and universities to enhance research impact and technology transfer.
• Actively participate in EU and (inter)national consortia and contribute to collaborative research projects.
• Increase LIST's visibility in the AI field through publications, presentations and participation in relevant forums and conferences.

Deep scientific and technical expertise, demonstrated by publications and successful RDI projects, in at least some of these topics is required:
• Frugal AI / Green AI and, in general, the design and deployment of AI models in low-resource environments.
• Generative AI, including large language models (LLMs), multimodal foundation models, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning and optimisation techniques for LLMs.
• Use of AI to improve sustainability aspects of AI and non-AI systems based on an analysis of their current architecture and operational data.
• Machine learning and neural network architectures, including convolutional, recurrent and transformer networks.
• MLOps and model management to streamline ML development.
• Multimodal input and how multimodality impacts frugality.
• Data management, data valorisation and data processing techniques, including data sandboxes, data spaces, data synthesis and data augmentation.
• AI evaluation, assessment, testing and benchmarking, including AI sandbox.
• Knowledge of the latest trends and developments in AI, with the ability to apply these advances to practical, real-world challenges.
• Experience working with business domain experts to apply the above AI innovation capabilities in at least one vertical domain in the private and/or public sector, such as finance, space, cybersecurity, energy, mobility and logistics, defence, manufacturing, education, health, central or local government, etc.
• Sustainable practices and global initiatives in the area (UNESCO sustainable development goals, digital product passport initiatives, product circularity data sheets…) that may have influence in the evolution and growing interest in Frugal AI.
• Software engineering and, in particular, low-code technologies. This includes some knowledge of low-code and no-code AI approaches.

In addition, we would appreciate proven experience in the following soft skills:
• Passion for AI research and technology with a relentless drive for innovation.
• Proven experience in leading and managing RDI projects in AI/ML with a track record of successful project delivery and innovation.
• Experience of building and maintaining collaborative networks with academic, industrial and research partners, with excellent networking skills.
• Proven ability to work effectively in a multicultural and international environment, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-expert audiences.
• Experience in organising workshops, seminars and conferences to disseminate research findings and promote community engagement.
• Ability to identify emerging research areas and technology trends and set the direction for future research efforts and technological advances.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education
• PhD + at least 2 years of experience in advanced AI RDI activities.
Language skills
• Fluent English is a requirement. French, German or Luxembourgish is an advantage.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do

• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 50 nationalities represented in our workforce

jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Director of Operations
Uplift360
Location: House of BioHealth, Esch-sur-Alzette, L-4354
Job Title: Director of Operations – Governance, Systems & Scaling
Job Type: Full time, permanent
Salary: €95,000 per annum

About the Role

This is a pivotal leadership role responsible for designing, building and leading Uplift360's operational backbone.
As Operations Director, you will oversee the company's operational infrastructure, business services, corporate operations, governance and support functions across Luxembourg and the United Kingdom, ensuring the organisation operates efficiently, compliantly and at scale.
Working directly with the Co-Founders, CTO and Senior Leadership Team, you will establish the operational systems, governance frameworks and management disciplines required to support accelerated growth, investor readiness, customer delivery and industrial expansion.
A key objective of the role is to help Uplift360 scale intelligently through the adoption of automation, AI-enabled workflows and modern digital operating systems. You will be expected to identify opportunities to increase organisational productivity, strengthen decision-making and reduce operational overhead through the effective application of technology.
Success in the role will be measured not only by organisational growth, but by your ability to build a scalable operating model that combines exceptional people, robust processes and intelligent technology - enabling growth without a proportional increase in administrative complexity or headcount.
The role has management responsibility for the HR function and broader business services team. However, this is not an HR leadership position. The Operations Director will ensure that the HR function is appropriately resourced, managed and aligned to business priorities, but will not personally deliver HR services or own the company's people strategy.
Responsibility for HR strategy, workforce planning, organisational design, reward strategy and board-level people governance remains with the founders and designated HR leadership.
This role combines strategic leadership with operational execution and is ideally suited to an experienced operational leader who has successfully scaled organisations in high-growth, venture-backed or industrial environments.

About Uplift360

Uplift360 is an Advanced Materials Company securing sovereign supply for Europe's defence, security and vital industries.
We secure and produce critical advanced materials, including carbon fibre and aramids, for European defence and industry by sourcing, recovering and regenerating high-value materials into secure industrial supply chains.
As geopolitical instability, supply chain fragility and industrial competition intensify, access to advanced materials is becoming a defining strategic advantage. Uplift360 is building the infrastructure and technology required to secure it.

As a Director of Operations, your key accountabilities will include:

Business Operations and Operational Excellence:  Lead the development and continuous improvement of Uplift360's operating model, ensuring efficiency, accountability and scalability across Luxembourg and UK operations.

Corporate Services, Risk and Compliance

• Provide leadership across corporate infrastructure, governance, risk management and business support functions.
• Establish and maintain operational governance, reporting and performance frameworks.
• Develop scalable processes, controls and workflows across the business.
• Lead operational planning and resource coordination across Luxembourg and UK operations.
• Oversee procurement, supplier management and operational service providers.
• Drive continual operational improvement initiatives.
• Develop KPIs, dashboards and management reporting.
• Facilitate leadership operating rhythms, action tracking and accountability.
• Ensure operational processes scale effectively as the company grows.

Digital Transformation and AI-Enabled Scaling

• Lead the development of a modern, technology-enabled operating model capable of supporting rapid growth, stronger decision-making and industrial scaling without adding unnecessary administrative burden.
• Develop and implement a roadmap for operational scalability through automation, AI and process optimisation.
• Identify and automate repetitive administrative, reporting and coordination activities.
• Deploy practical digital tools for workflow management, document control, action tracking, meeting cadence and cross-functional collaboration.
• Champion data-driven decision-making through dashboards, management reporting and operational analytics.
• Partner with functional leaders to simplify workflows, reduce hand-offs and remove avoidable inefficiencies.
• Ensure AI and technology solutions are deployed responsibly, securely and in line with company governance requirements.

Strategic Projects and Company Execution

• Act as a key operational partner to the founders in delivering strategic, cross-functional and growth-critical initiatives.
• Lead company-wide projects that improve organisational capability and effectiveness.
• Coordinate strategic planning activities, leadership initiatives and cross-functional execution priorities.
• Support customer, investor, partner and government stakeholder engagement where operational coordination is required.
• Ensure operational readiness for audits, funding reviews, due diligence exercises and growth milestones.
• Drive execution of business priorities through structured programme management, action tracking and escalation discipline.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Personal Qualities:

• 10+ years' experience in Operations Leadership, Business Operations, General Management, Chief of Staff or related leadership roles.
• Experience within high-growth, venture-backed, technology, manufacturing, industrial or deep-tech environments.
• Proven track record of building scalable operational frameworks and business systems.
• Experience leading cross-functional business services and operational support functions.
• Practical experience implementing automation, AI-enabled workflows, digital collaboration tools, dashboards or process improvements that materially improve organisational productivity.
• Strong understanding of governance, risk management and operational compliance.
• Demonstrated success partnering with founders and executive teams.
• Strong commercial, organisational and stakeholder management capability.
• Fluent English with the right to work in Luxembourg/EU.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Personal Qualities:

• Experience operating across Luxembourg and UK environments.
• Manufacturing, advanced materials, engineering, chemicals, defence or industrial sector experience.
• Experience supporting grant-funded programmes.
• Familiarity with ISO, operational governance or regulated environments.
• Experience overseeing operational finance functions.
• French and/or German language capability.

Why Join Uplift360?

We are a family friendly company that believes in the importance of supporting our employees to find and maintain an excellent work life balance. Your physical, mental and financial wellbeing matters to us.

jobs.title: Julgestustöötaja-tegevusjuhendaja
jobs.description:
Töö asukoht Valga maakonnas Valga vallas (tööandja pakub majutust, hüvitab transpordikulud).

Tööülesanded: MTÜ Valga Abikeskus avab uue üksuse, kus pakutakse ööpäevaringset erihoolekandeteenust autismispektrihäirega inimestele.
Tegevusjuhendaja on vahetu teenuse osutaja, kelle tegevuse eesmärk on luua turvaline, struktureeritud ja toetav keskkond, mis arvestab kliendi individuaalsete eripäradega. Tööülesannete täitmine eeldab head füüsilist vormi ja aktiivset kaasamõtlemist teenuse arendamisel ning loomulikult kliente toetavat hoiakut.

Omalt poolt pakume: Motiveerivat töötasu; meeldivat meeskonda; vahetustega töögraafikut (paindlik tööaeg); vajadusel tasuta ööbimisvõimalust asutuses (tuba jagatakse); sõidukompensatsiooni igal kuul; tööalaseid koolitusi; kohapealset väljaõpet; tasuta toitlustust.

Muud nõuded: Otsime inimesi, kes on loomult rahulikud, kannatlikud ja järjepidevad, samas aktiivse hoiakuga ning uuendusmeelsed.
Tegevusjuhendaja väljaõpe ei ole otseselt tööle saamisel nõutav, küll aga eeldame valmidust õppima asumiseks ning kvalifikatsiooni omandamiseks. Ka tööandja pakub koolitamisvõimalusi. Oluline on vähemalt keskhariduse olemasolu ja kasuks tuleb eelnev töökogemus sotsiaalvaldkonnas, loomulikult ka varasemalt läbitud vastav väljaõpe. NB! Isik ei tohi töötada tegevusjuhendajana, kui teda on karistatud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest, mis on suunatud isiku vastu (nt vägivald) või mis seab ohtu teiste inimeste elu ja tervise. Tööle asumisel kontrollitakse alati karistusregistri väljavõtet.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

Koormus, vahetused: öösiti

jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. You’ll play an instrumental role in defining our enterprise sales motion, contribute to the future of our product, and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly targets

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts; understand client needs deeply, align Linear’s solutions to business objectives + shape decision criteria. Effectively communicate and align our value proposition to decision-makers

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

 - Help build the foundation and define our enterprise sales process

What we're looking for

 - 3+ years selling to the enterprise, and 7+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling a technical product to both engineering and product leadership; bonus if you have experience selling collaboration or project management software

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Ability to understand complex client needs, craft tailored discovery, and drive sales through consultative approaches.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.description:
## About Outsite

 

Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.

 

## About Outsite for Teams

 

Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

 

## Role Overview

 

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.

 

This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

 

## Key Responsibilities

 

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound

- Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder

- Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base

- Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging

- Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages

- Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities

 

### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management

- Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture

- Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close

- Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged

- Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets

 

### 3. Collaboration & Handoff

- Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound

- Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals

- Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time

 

### 4. Reporting

- Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers

- Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

 

## Required Skills & Experience

 

- 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)

- Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders

- Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads

- Able to work autonomously and independently 

- Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive 

- Comfortable working European timezone hours

- Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job

- Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to

- Comfortable using AI in workflow

 

## Nice to Have

 

- Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams

- Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot

- Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space

- Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product

 

## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

 

- A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)

- A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM

- First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed

- Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing

- Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

 

## Benefits

 

- Remote, travel encouraged

- Credits for Outsite locations 

- Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

Are you a skilled and passionate baker who loves crafting high-quality baked goods – and ready to take charge of production in a bakery known for its high standards? Would you like to build strong teams and play a key role in further developing our bakeries in Flåm and Lærdal? Then we’d love to hear from you!

Flåm Artisan bakery is looking for an experienced baker to lead the production team.

About us:

Flåm Bakeri opened in 2016 and has been a fantastic success ever since. Last summer, we moved into brand-new, spacious premises on the waterfront in the heart of Flåm. Our second location, Laksen Bakeri & Kafé in Lærdal, has seen similar growth. Together, we offer a wide range of products, including artisan breads, traditional Norwegian sweet buns, and classic international pastries – as well as local juices, sandwiches, pizza, and barista coffee. We also do daily deliveries of bread and pastry products to Myrkdalen Resort, our hotels in Flåm/Aurland and Sognaporten.

As Head of Bakery Production, you will play a central role in ensuring our bakeries deliver top-quality baked goods every day. You’ll be a key partner to Gro, manager at 3 of our venues, and help drive the development of our production processes, product range, and team culture.

Key responsibilities:

  • Plan and organize the daily production of baked goods across our locations to ensure freshness and quality at all times
  • Actively participate in production while maintaining high standards and efficient workflows
  • Collaborate with the leadership team to develop and adapt our product offerings in line with customer preferences and market trends
  • Follow established food safety and hygiene procedures (IK-mat) and ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations
  • Support administrative tasks such as shift planning and recruitment
  • Foster a positive and inclusive team culture with a focus on motivation, collaboration, and well-being
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of production routines and product development

    Qualifications:

  • Certificate of apprenticeship (fagbrev) as a baker or equivalent experience in food production
  • Several years of experience from an artisan bakery, with solid knowledge of production techniques and quality control
  • Experience with cake baking is a plus
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to lead and inspire a team
  • Driver’s license (Class B)
  • Good English communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Knowledge of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is an advantage, but not a requirement

We offer:

An exciting position in an ambitious and dynamic company committed to people and community. You’ll join a proud and passionate team within one of Norway’s leading tourism companies, where we encourage both personal and professional growth. At Norway’s Best, we value diversity and inclusion – it’s reflected in our culture. Our employees are encouraged to ask questions, be themselves, and are seen and respected for who they are.

Some of our employee benefits:

  • Competitive employment terms
  • Pension and insurance schemes through Nordea Liv and Gjensidige
  • Discounts and offers on products and activities from Norway’s Best

Konsernet har sitt hovudkontor i Flåm, og kontorstader i Myrkdalen, på Voss, i Bergen og Narvik. Vi har ein nasjonal ambisjon og er ein konsolidator i norsk reiseliv. NBG er i front på heilskapleg reisemålsutvikling, og har i dag ei verksemd bygd på våre heilårssatsingar i Flåm, Myrkdalen og Narvik. I over 25 år har vi posisjonert Flåm, med Flåmsbana og Nærøyfjorden, til å bli eit av Norges mest populære reisemål. I pudderparadiset Myrkdalen, med Myrkdalen Fjellandsby, har vi den største skidestinasjonen på Vestlandet. I nord eig vi Narvikfjellet i Narvik og verdens nordlegaste dyrepark Polar Park i Bardu. jobs.description:
We are strengthening ASIC Design Team in Murata Finland. Therefore, we are looking for a Senior Analog Design Engineer to join our team in Vantaa, Finland.

Murata Finland is developing leading edge gyroscope and accelerometer safety-critical sensors for global automotive, industrial and healthcare markets. We design full custom mixed mode ASICs from concept level to volume production including wafer level testing. Murata has flexible remote work policy and way of working can be planned according to your personal needs. The job includes on-site work, and part of it can also be done remotely.

Based on your experience and preferences in this position you have opportunity to focus and develop your skills in one of the following roles:

· ASIC Sr. Design Engineer role focusing on block level design and verification or

· Technical Lead role taking responsibility of a specific ASIC design area including leading a small sub team or

- In analog technical lead role, you will take responsibility for a specific ASIC design area and become an expert on that. You work together with a small group of designers leading their design activities and providing support for them. As a technical lead you will also work closely with ASIC PM, other technical leads and stake holders in ASIC project.


· ASIC Project Manager role leading the work of entire ASIC project.

- After you gain experience on Murata ASIC projects there is a possibility to take also a project manager role.


Your main responsibility areas are:

· ASIC specification and system description

· ASIC design, verification and reporting

- Including modules like bandgap, LDO, PLL, ADC, DAC, different SC-circuits and high voltage circuits


· Characterization specifications and result analysis

· Support for production wafer test and result analysis

To be successful in these roles, these are the expected qualities and skills:

- Technical education (e.g. M.Sc., Ph.D. or D.Sc.) with emphasis on microelectronics

- 5+ years of experience in analog ASIC design

jobs.description:
Your mission at Voi 

For the position as a Driver & Mechanic - (Fleet Specialist) you'll have the possibility of working in two different areas, depending on workload and suitability. We have our mechanical team, where you will be responsible for the maintenance and repair of our vehicles. This means keeping our scooters in top shape and provide strong support to our team on the ground. We also have our In field team, where you'll be utilising our vans to perform different tasks in the Stavanger area, making sure our operations runs as efficiently as possible. Here are some exciting tasks awaiting you as a Fleet Specialist:

  • Ensuring the logistics of collecting and providing Voi scooters.⚙️

  • Searching for and collecting damaged scooters. 🛴

  • Battery replacement.🔋

  • Performing quick on-site repairs of the scooters.🔧

  • Diagnosing and repairing broken vehicles.🔧

  • Recycling and dismantling vehicles that cannot be repaired. ♻️

  • Assisting with the acceptance, packaging, and provision of new vehicles and batteries arriving at the warehouse. 🔍

  • Supporting our on-site team as needed, whether it's identifying damaged vehicles, clearing parking spaces, or setting up fallen vehicles.🤝

What you'll need to embark

We're looking for a highly motivated and responsible team player who can handle tasks and solve problems independently. With a proactive approach, you should be skilled in finding innovative solutions and achieving set objectives. In addition, the right candidate should have:

  • A valid drivers license for Norway preferred

  • Fluent english, both verbal and written

  • Previous experience with tools or mechanical practices

  • General familiarity with digital tools and applications

  • Local knowledge of Oslo and experience driving in the city

  • The ability to remain calm in stressful situations (such as difficult parking or traffic)

Job conditions 

  • Working hours: Part time 60% - Rotating shifts

  • Contract type: Fixed term

  • Start date: ASAP

NOTE: our Talent Acquisition is based in UK, you will receive a phone call from a UK number (+44)

Why Voi?

Working at Voi is more than just a job; it's a personal Voiage where you'll grow as a professional and be part of a diverse team and culture that's committed to making a positive impact on society. In addition to this, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Join Europe's leading micromobility company and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups

  • Make a direct impact on our ongoing success and contribute to the development of the micromobility industry in Stavanger.

  • Collaborate with inspiring, motivated, and diverse colleagues who share a common goal

  • Be a part of the micromobility revolution and help create sustainable cities that are clean, quiet, and free from pollution

Are you ready to embark on the Voiage with us?

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Since 2018, Voi has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 150,000+ vehicles in 110+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 400+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.

Diversity Matters

As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more - therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

jobs.description:
Kajaanin kaupungin Vesiliikuntakeskuksessa Kaukavedessä on haettavana liikunnanohjaajan määräaikainen tehtävä ajalle 27.8.2026-30.5.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Liikunnanohjaajan tehtäviin kuuluu uinninopetus, vesiliikuntaryhmien ohjaus ja uinninvalvonta sekä Kaukaveden palveluiden suunnitteluun ja viestintään liittyvät tehtävät. Arvostamme asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä, vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä yhteistyökykyä monien asiakasryhmien sekä työyhteisön kesken.

Tehtävän kelpoisuutena on soveltuva liikunta-alan tutkinto. Eduksi katsomme hakijalta SUH Ry:n uimaopettaja- ja uinninvalvojatutkintoja sekä aikaisempaa työkokemusta liikunnanohjaajan työstä.

Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä 30 päivän kuluessa valitsemispäätöksen tiedoksisaannista nähtäväksi lain 504/2002 mukainen rikosrekisteriote sekä erikseen pyydettäessä todistus huumausainetestistä. Tehtävän koeaika on neljä kuukautta.

Ennen tehtävän alkamista työntekijän tulee suorittaa Kuluttajaviraston säädöksien mukainen hengenpelastusuinti hyväksyttävästi.

Työaika on 38,25 h/vko. Palkkaus määräytyy Kunnallisen yleisen virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Työ on viikonlopputyötä sisältävää kaksivuorotyötä.

Ympäristötekninen toimiala

Ympäristöteknisellä toimialalla näet työsi jäljen konkreettisesti päivittäin. Huolehdimme siitä, että Kajaani on viihtyisä ja sujuva kaupunki: kadut ja puistot ovat kunnossa, liikuntapaikat kutsuvat liikkumaan ja rakennettu ympäristö kehittyy kestävän kehityksen periaatteiden mukaisesti.

Toimiala vastaa laajasti mm. kaavoituksesta ja maankäytöstä, kunnallistekniikasta, toimitiloista, kiinteistöistä, liikuntapalveluista sekä rakennusvalvonnasta ja ympäristönsuojelusta. Meillä työskentelee ammattilaisia suunnittelijoista ja insinööreistä kunnossapidon osaajiin ja lupaviranomaisiin. Työnantajana Kajaanin ympäristötekninen toimiala tarjoaa sinulle monipuolisia työtehtäviä, mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja olla mukana suunnittelemassa ja toteuttamassa tulevaisuuden Kajaania yhdessä muiden toimialojen,kumppaneiden ja kaupunkilaisten kanssa.

Kajaanin kaupunki on monialainen työnantaja, joka arvostaa työn ja perhe-elämän tasapainoa. Perheiden monimuotoisuus nähdään vahvuutena, ja haluamme kehittää jatkuvasti käytäntöjämme entistä perheystävällisemmiksi. Lue lisää Kajaanin kaupungista työnantajana: kuntarekry.fi/kajaaninkaupunki

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja
jobs.description:
Haetaan lähihoitajaa mielenterveyskuntoutujien palvelukotiin. Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa, joka sisältää myös yksintyöskentelyä. Työntekijältä vaaditaan oma-aloitteisuutta, luotettavuutta sekä yhteistyötaitoja. Valmiutta ja rohkeutta itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja kykyä kohdata asukkaat rauhallisesti ja ennakkoluulottomasti. Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja kykyä tehdä itsenäisiä päätöksiä. Työ sisältää asukkaiden ohjausta ja avustamista kaikissa arkipäivän asioissa sekä kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä. Arjen pyörittäminen, kuten ruoan laitto, siivous, pyykkihuolto ja kaupassa käynti ovat tärkeä osa työtäsi. Tehtävät tehdään yhdessä asukkaiden kanssa heidän toimintakykyään tukien ja vahvistaen. Vastaat asukkaiden turvallisesta lääkehoidosta ja dokumentoinnista.

Kyseessä aluksi määräaikainen työsuhde 30.8.2026 saakka ja sen jälkeen työtä tarjolla joustavasti. Saat pitkän ja huolellisen perehdytyksen kokeneiden työntekijöiden rinnalla. Perehdytystä jatketaan aina niin kauan, kunnes tunnet olosi täysin varmaksi, ennen ensimmäistä itsenäistä työvuoroasi. Palkkaus määräytyy Yksityisen sosiaalialan TES:n mukaisesti. Tervetuloa mukaan avoimeen, rempseään ja mukavaan työporukkaamme.

jobs.title: Katsastaja, Porvoo
jobs.description:
Katsastaja Porvooseen

Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme katsastajaa Porvooseen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Voit olla jo kokenut alan ammattilainen tai urasi alkuvaiheessa – tärkeintä on halu tehdä työsi hyvin ja kehittyä tehtävässä. Kokeneelle tekijälle tarjoamme mahdollisuuden aloittaa työskentely itsenäisesti heti, kun taas aloittelevalle katsastajalle järjestetään kattava perehdytys ja koulutus tehtävään. Asiaksyrityksemme on valmis kustantamaan katsastajankoulutuksen, vaatimukset tähän on autoalan ammattitutkinto tai erikoisammattitutkinto.

Odotamme sinulta:
* Soveltuvaa koulutusta (katsastajan koulutus tai vähintään autoalan ammattitutkinto)
* Hyvää asennetta ja vastuullista työotetta
* Suomen kielen taitoa (ruotsin ja englannin osaaminen katsotaan eduksi)
* Aiempi kokemus alalta on plussaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä
Tarjoamme sinulle:
* Kattavan perehdytyksen ja tuen työssä kehittymiseen
* Mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön arvostetussa yrityksessä
* Kilpailukykyisen palkan
* Vakituisen työsuhteen

Palkkaus: Kokeneelle katsastajalle tarjoamme 4000-4500€/kk. Työsuhteessa noudatetaan Huoltokorjaamoiden työehtosopimusta.

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Lähetä hakemuksesi pian ja tule osaksi osaavaa tiimiä!

jobs.title: Pædagog 32 timer til Maria Mikkelsens Børnehus
jobs.description:
Vi søger en pædagog, 32 timer ugentligt.

Hvem søger vi:

Vi søger en uddannet pædagog, som er engageret, har høj pædagogisk faglighed samt har lyst til at arbejde primært med børnehavebørn.

Maria Mikkelsens Børnehus er beliggende i Kolding midtby. Vi er en lille privat institution.

Vi er normeret til 65 børn hvoraf de 17 kan være vuggestuebørn.

Vi er fordelt på to børnehavegrupper og en vuggestuegruppe.

 

Vi glæder os rigtig meget til at møde dig, som:

  • Har et godt overblik i en travl hverdag

  • Er omsorgsfuld, empatisk, nærværende og i øjenhøjde

  • Er nysgerrig på at forstå børnenes opfattelse af verden, og tager udgangspunkt i børneperspektivet

  • Har hjertet på rette sted og brænder for sit arbejde

  • Er rig på initiativer, og ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger

  • Tør reflektere over egen praksis og tør give kollegaer feedback

 

Det er desuden vigtigt for os, at du er en stabil, loyal, fleksibel og en omstillingsparat kollega. Du skal være indstillet på at skulle arbejde både i vuggestue og i børnehaven, og at du kan arbejde indenfor Børnehusets åbningstid, som er mellem 6.30 og 16.45

 

Vi kan tilbyde dig:

jobs.title: Junior CNC Machinist / CNC Operator
jobs.description:
Start your CNC career with a modern manufacturing company.

 

EasyPartz is looking for a motivated Junior CNC Machinist / CNC Operator who wants to build a long-term career in precision manufacturing.

You will become part of an experienced machining team and develop your skills through daily hands-on work, practical shop-floor learning, and mentorship from experienced CNC machinists. We are looking for people who enjoy practical work, take pride in producing high-quality components, and are eager to continuously develop their technical skills.

International candidates are welcome. For qualified applicants, EasyPartz can support the Danish work permit and visa application process where applicable.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate CNC milling and turning machines under the guidance of experienced machinists.

  • Assist with machine setup, tooling, and workholding.

  • Read and interpret technical drawings and manufacturing instructions.

  • Perform in-process and final measurements using inspection equipment.

  • Monitor machining operations and report deviations.

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and well-organized workplace in accordance with 5S principles.

  • Follow company procedures for quality, safety, and production reporting.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement and efficient workshop operations.

 

Requirements

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Vocational education or practical experience in CNC machining, machining technology, metalworking, or a related mechanical field.

  • Basic understanding of CNC machining principles and manufacturing processes.

  • Ability to read technical drawings and use standard measuring equipment, or the willingness to develop these skills quickly.

  • Good mechanical aptitude and attention to detail.

  • A responsible attitude towards quality, safety, and teamwork.

  • English communication skills sufficient to work effectively in an international production environment.

  • Motivation to relocate to Denmark and build a long-term career with EasyPartz.

Experience with CNC milling, CNC turning, Fusion 360, Fanuc, Haas, or robotic machine tending is considered an advantage but is not required.

 

What We Offer

  • Permanent full-time employment.

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

  • Pension and private health insurance.

  • Mentorship from experienced CNC machinists.

  • Modern CNC machines and manufacturing technologies.

  • A clean, well-organized, and safety-focused production environment.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression within the company.

  • Support with relocation and Danish work permit processes for qualified international candidates.

 

About EasyPartz

EasyPartz is a growing Danish precision machining company located in Søborg, just outside Copenhagen. We specialize in CNC milling and turning, producing high-quality precision components for customers across Europe in industries where quality, precision, and reliability are essential.

We are building a digitally driven manufacturing environment, continuously investing in CNC technology, automation, robotics, and digital production systems. By combining skilled craftsmanship with modern manufacturing technologies and Lean principles, we are creating a workplace focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Whether you are starting your career or expanding your experience, you will work alongside skilled professionals in a collaborative environment where learning, responsibility, and continuous development are part of everyday work.

 

Apply

Please send us:

  • Your CV

  • A short introduction about yourself

  • Information about your education and machining experience

Applications are reviewed continuously, and the position will be filled as soon as the right candidate is found.

jobs.title: Professor / Associate Professor in Biomedical Innovation
jobs.description:
The Department of Biomedicine at Faculty of Health Sciences at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as Professor / Associate Professor per 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a full-time permanent position.

This initiative is a direct extension of Aarhus University’s Strategy 2030, in which research-based innovation and entrepreneurship are central strategic priorities. To strengthen the university’s capacity to translate research into innovation, the university leadership has established a number of new research and innovation positions across Aarhus University. These positions are intended to foster an innovation mindset throughout the university while generating tangible societal impact through research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and collaboration.

The primary focus for this position is research-based innovation. We are looking for scientists with medical research background who sees opportunities in collaboration with the strong existing research groups at Aarhus University and Aarhus University Hospital and leading international institutions.

About the Department
The Department of Biomedicine provides research-based teaching of the highest quality and is responsible for a large part of the medical degree programme. The department employs approx. 600 people from all over the world, and they make use of the department's modern laboratory, core and animal facilities. The Department of Biomedicine focuses on innovation and entrepreneurship. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities as Professor / Associate Professor
We offer an attractive career opportunity for researchers with a strong track record in medical research and innovation. The successful candidate is expected to:

  • strengthen the department’s research, innovation, and research-based teaching, and contribute to the academic development of Aarhus University and its national and international profile.

  • conduct original, internationally recognized research and demonstrate scientific excellence at the highest international level.

  • have experience with commercialization of research and technology including protection of intellectual property (IP) rights.

  • contribute to the Faculty of Health Sciences’ strategic priorities in innovation and collaboration by supporting the commercialization of research, building innovation capacity, and developing collaborations with external partners.

  • actively engage in Aarhus University’s innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem and contribute to translating research into societal impact through innovation, entrepreneurship, spinouts, and collaborations with industry.

  • contribute to academic citizenship by actively engaging in the department's academic community and fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and respectful working environment.


An attractive start package can be negotiated.

You will report to the Head of Department Thomas G. Jensen.

Your competences as Professor / Associate Professor
You are ready to take co-responsibility for the development of the department's activites and for ensuring that we maintain a good work environment. You naturally involve yourself in interdisciplinary collaboration at departmental, faculty and university level as well as nationally and internationally. As a leader, you inspire others and build strong relationships with students, colleagues and partners.

We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish.

In the assessment of the candidates, consideration will be given to:

  • the ability to promote and utilize research results

  • experience with innovation activities

  • the ability to contribute to the development of internal and external cooperation

  • track record in attracting funding

  • visions within the research and innovation area

  • track record for commercialisation of research results, including protection of intellectual property

  • track record for fostering collaboration with industry

  • business development

  • experience and insight to the Danish life science industry

  • patenting, licensing and technology transfers

  • visions within the innovation area


In order to be assessed as qualified for a Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

In order to be assessed as qualified for an Associate Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

If you wish to apply for both positions, please submit two separate applications.

Shortlisting will be used.

Questions about the position
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Head of Department Thomas G. Jensen tel.: (+45) 2778 2805.

Your place of work will be the Department of Biomedicine, Høegh-Guldbergs Gade 10, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

We expect to conduct interviews in the beginning of November 2026.

Terms of employment - professor

  • In making the appointment, emphasis will be placed on a high degree of original production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material, hereby documenting that the applicant has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.

  • Moreover, there will be an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime professor is DKK 866.461,38 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed professor supplement and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Professors have the authority to negotiate pay on their own behalf.



Terms of employment – associate professor

  • Appointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of appointment as an assistant professor, but may also be obtained in other ways.

  • The applicant is required to have completed a university pedagogical programme or an equivalent programme.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime associate professor is DKK 706.233,06 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed associate professor supplememt and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.



Other terms of employment

  • Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  • The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).

  • Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.

  • Travel and moving expenses may be covered according to the employee in question and, to a limited extent, the accompanying family.

  • Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.



Application - professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The ten publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)



Application – associate professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - associate professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The five publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - associate professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - associate professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)


We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.title: Liikuntakoutsi
jobs.description:
Kuhmo on Suomen metsäkeskeisin kaupunki, joka on tunnettu korkeatasoisesta musiikki- ja kirjallisuuskulttuurista, erityisesti kamarimusiikista ja Kalevalasta sekä yhteisöllisestä elämäntavasta, jossa arvostetaan hyvän jakamista, osaamista ja laatua. Kuhmo - täyttä elämää metsän ja kulttuurin valtakunnassa!

Kuhmon kaupungin kasvun ja oppimisen palvelualueella on haettavana määräaikainen liikuntakoutsin työtehtävä Tuupalan yhtenäiskoulussa ajalla 10.8.2026 - 30.6.2027. Työ voi alkaa sopimuksen mukaan myös myöhemmin.

Haluatko olla mukana lisäämässä lasten ja nuorten liikettä, hyvinvointia ja osallisuutta? Etsimme innostavaa ja kehittämismyönteistä liikuntakoutsia vahvistamaan Kuhmon perusopetuksen liikunnallista toimintakulttuuria sekä tukemaan lasten ja nuorten aktiivista elämäntapaa. Tehtävässä pääset kehittämään uusia toimintamalleja ja rakentamaan pysyviä käytäntöjä lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin tukemiseksi yhdessä koulun oppilaiden, aikuisten ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa.

Liikuntakoutsin työtehtävät pitävät sisällään esim.
liikunnallisen toimintakulttuurin kehittäminen yhdessä Liikkuva koulu -tiimin ja koulun henkilökunnan kanssa
välituntitoiminnan organisoimista, välkkäritoimintaa sekä muita oppilaiden osallisuutta vahvistavien toimintamallien kehittämistä
liikunnallisten tapahtumien ja kampanjoiden järjestäminen yhdessä muiden toimijoiden kanssa
liikuntatietoisiin opetus- ja toimintatapoihin ohjaamista ja kannustamista
oppituntien taukojumppaa
vähän liikkuville lapsille ja nuorille suunnattujen liikunta- ja hyvinvointitoimien suunnittelua ja toteuttamista
Move!-prosessin kehittämiseen osallistuminen
Tuupalan yhtenäiskoulun liikunnallisen vuosikellon ideointi yhdessä koulun oppilaiden, aikuisten ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa
osallistuminen hankkeen seurantaan, arviointiin ja raportointiin.

Edellytämme tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta, kuten liikunta-, kasvatus-, terveys- tai hyvinvointialan ammatillinen tai korkeakoulututkinto tai muu soveltuva koulutus. Työaika on 38,25h/vko ja palkkaus on KVTES:n mukainen tasopalkka 2 612,32 € kuukaudessa. Työsuhteen koeaika on pituudeltaan puolet palvelussuhteen kestosta.

Tehtävään valitun on toimitettava nähtäväksi hyväksytty lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan sekä lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen voimassa oleva rikosrekisteriote 30 päivän kuluessa valintapäätöksen tiedoksisaannista.

Odotamme sinulta kokemusta lasten ja nuorten liikunnan, kasvatuksen tai ohjaustoiminnan parista. Arvostamme intoa ja halua kehittää uutta, oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta sekä organisointitaitoja. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja kyky toimia yhteistyössä eri-ikäisten lasten, nuorten ja aikuisten kanssa on työssä onnistumisen kannalta tärkeää. Toivomme sinulta myös innostunutta ja kannustavaa asennetta liikunnallisen elämäntavan edistämiseen ja kykyä kohdata lempeästi ja kannustavasti erilaiset liikkujat. Perusosaaminen tietojärjestelmien (mm. MS Office, Teams, Wilma, Webropol) käytöstä auttaa tehtävän hoitamisessa.

Tuupalan yhtenäiskoulussa opiskelee lukuvuonna 2026-27 n. 450 oppilasta vuosiluokilla 1-9. Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen ja monipuolisen työn kuhmolaisten lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin edistämiseksi. Saat mahdollisuuden kehittää uusia toimintamalleja ja vaikuttaa koko koulun liikunnalliseen toimintakulttuuriin. Saat työssäsi mahdollisuuden hyödyntää omaa asiantuntemustasi ja kehittää ammattitaitoasi. Työyhteisön tuki ja yhteistyöverkostot auttavat sinua tehtävän menestyksellisessä hoitamisessa.

Mielenkiintoisen työn lisäksi Kuhmo tarjoaa monipuoliset harrastusmahdollisuudet, upean luonnon ja rauhoittavan elämänrytmin. Kaikki palvelut ovat kävelymatkan päässä toisistaan. Henkilöstöetuna tarjoamme mm. E-passin.

Tervetuloa mukaan rakentamaan liikkuvampaa, aktiivisempaa, osallistavampaa ja yhdenvertaisempaa arkea kuhmolaisille lapsille ja nuorille!

Tehtävään haetaan Kuntarekry.fi-palvelun kautta osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi. Hakuaika päättyy keskiviikkona 5.8.2026 klo 15.00. Haastattelut voidaan aloittaa jo hakuaikana.

Hakemukseen on liitettävä kelpoisuuden osoittavat todistukset ja cv. Alkuperäiset todistukset esitetään haastattelussa tai muulla sovittavalla tavalla.

Description de l'entreprise

CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l'intégration et l'exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l'énergie, l'industrie, le transport, l'aéronautique et la cybersécurité.

Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d'innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d'affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites.

En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante.***Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance.
* Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain.
* Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l'innovation.

Explorer, observer, sécuriser l'espace de demain.

Avec 50 ans d'expertise, notre Business Unit Espace est un partenaire de confiance des agences spatiales, maîtres d'œuvre et opérateurs de satellites à travers l'Europe.

Forte d'un savoir-faire reconnu, elle contribue activement à renforcer la performance, la sécurité et l'innovation de l'écosystème spatial.

Nos équipes apportent leur expertise sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des missions : observation de la Terre, systèmes de navigation et de télécommunication, sciences et exploration interplanétaire, surveillance et sécurité de l'Espace. Portées par l'IA et nos solutions souveraines, nous repoussons chaque jour les frontières technologiques des programmes spatiaux européens.

Rejoindre cette Business Unit , c'est façonner le futur de l'espace aux côtés d'experts passionnés.

Description du poste

Nous recrutons un(e) Ingénieur(e) DevOps pour rejoindre notre Business unit Espace au sein de notre agence Space Processing & Intelligence spécialisée dans le traitement et l'hybridation des données spatiales .

Vos missions

Vous rejoignez l'équipe DEVOPS, en charge de l'administration des environnements de développement et la mise en place des plateformes d'intégration continue pour les différents projets de la BU Espace.***Auditer des besoins projet, définir la stratégie
* Mettre en place des outils
* Réaliser des pipelines CI/CD
* Assister et expertiser pour les évolutions des besoins

L'environnement technique***GitLab, Kubernetes, Kustomize, Helm, ArgoCD, Ansible, Terraform
* Cloud (providers européens essentiellement) / Openstack
* OpenSource
* Langages variés (Python, Node, Java, C/C++, Golang, Rust)
Qualifications

De formation Bac+5 écoles d'ingénieur ou équivalent, vous possédez une expérience entre 3 et 5 ans en tant que DevOps . La connaissance du secteur spatial est un véritable atout. Vous maitrisez la plateforme de conteneurisation Docker / OCI ainsi que le logiciel Kubernetes .

La maitrise de l' anglais professionnel (lu, écrit et parlé) est indispensable.
Vous êtes à l'écoute , autonome, curieux(se) et aimez le travail en équipe ? Vous aimez débattre au sein de l'équipe pour faire évoluer les choix et solutions techniques au cours du temps ? Alors vous êtes la pépite que nous recherchons !

Informations supplémentaires

Rejoignez une entreprise où l'humain, l'innovation et l'impact se rencontrent.

Chez CS, nous offrons Une expérience collaborateur enrichissante , portée par un environnement de travail conçu pour favoriser la flexibilité, l'autonomie et le bien-être au quotidien.
* Un parcours d'intégration complet pensé pour embarquer chaque talent dès le premier jour et une Academy pour développer vos compétences, enrichir votre expertise et construire les parcours professionnels qui vous ressemblent.
* Un engagement sociétal fort : plus de 3000 associations soutenues, une politique handicap active, une culture inclusive, une démarche de numérique responsable, et des partenariats comme Elles bougent pour inspirer les talents féminins de demain.

.et bien d'autres avantages à découvrir en nous rejoignant !

Notre singularité ? L'alliance unique entre expertise technologique, projets critiques et engagement humain. Entreprise innovante et responsable, nous construisons un environnement éthique, inclusif et tourné vers l'avenir. Ouverts à tous les talents, nous croyons que la diversité est une richesse.
