jobs.title: RESEARCH & TECHNOLOGY ENGINEER - AI PRODUCT MANAGEMENT (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belval | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The AI Readiness and Assessment (AIRA) research group at LIST is seeking a highly motivated professional to lead the development of Luxembourg AI Factory services into mature offerings meeting market needs. Operating at the intersection of applied AI, service/product design, and go-to-market strategy, this position focuses on taking services in the Luxembourg AI Factory and turning them into coherent, valuable assets for the ecosystem's target users: startups, SMEs and large corporations. The ideal candidate is a practical strategist, comfortable moving between technical product content, human-centered design, and communication.
• Service Design and Management: You will manage Luxembourg AI Factory's services and take them to the next level of maturity and market readiness.  
• User Feedback: You will conduct user studies, gather input from service users, and continuously refine the product design, product backlogs, and implementation roadmaps, with a particular focus on AI Assessment and Sandboxing Services.
• Communication and Marketing Strategy: You will define the positioning, messaging and channel strategy for each productized asset, ensuring consistent branding and tone across the AI Factory's public-facing outputs and stakeholder communications.
• Build Go-to-Market Assets: You will create the supporting materials that make each service easy to understand, adopt and promote across the ecosystem.
• Support Ecosystem Engagement: You will engage with project partners and the wider ecosystem — including the open-source community, contributors and community governance — to formulate recommendations that guide them through a coherent journey across services.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
• Master's degree in Service Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, Innovation Management, or a closely related discipline
• Ph.D. in those disciplines is considered an asset

Experience
• Experience in service design and/or service management
• Experience with digital product design and communication
• Experience conducting user research or user studies (interviews, surveys, focus groups, usability testing, etc.) is an asset
• Any hands-on experience with AI-related projects or tools is a plus
Hard skills
• Advanced expertise in Digital Product and Service Design: Service design methods (service blueprint, journey mapping), UX/UI design tools (Figma or equivalent), experience in conducting user research (interviews, usability testing)
• Value proposition & Business design: positioning of services, value proposition frameworks, experience translating technical capabilities into user benefits
• Communication & Marketing: familiarity with marketing and communication strategies and product branding
• AI literacy: familiarity with AI concepts and the AI policy landscape
Soft skills
• Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to scientific rigor and interpretability
• Notions of explainability and trustworthiness in AI
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex concepts to non-specialists
• Intellectual curiosity and motivation to work on applied, impact-driven research
• Ability to work independently while contributing constructively to a collaborative project environment

Language skills
• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits
• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online
Your application must include:
• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A scientific CV with contact details
• Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions
We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.
As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.
This position offers a gross monthly salary between €6'000 and €6'679, paid over 13 months (€79'200–€86'800 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience .

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Instruktor/ Veespordijuhendaja (eFoil – elektriline lendav laud) suvehooajaks
jobs.description:
Oleme valmis värbama ka alaealisi. Hooajaline töö mere ääres — õpetad inimesi sõitma elektrilise surfiga, nautima elu ja tundma vabadust

Tööülesanded: Mida sa tegelikult teed?
Sa ei istu kontoris. Sa ei vasta e-kirjadele 8 tundi järjest. Hommikul tuled mere äärde. Päike tõuseb Tallinna lahel. Võtad vastu esimesed külalised — mõned erutunud, mõned natuke hirmul. Annad neile 15-20 minutit ohutusinstruktaaži. Selgitad. Naeratad. Tekitad usalduse. Lähed nendega vette või paadiga kõrval. Näed hetke, kui inimene esimest korda lendab üle vee. Nende nägu ütleb kõik. Filmid neid paadilt, kaldalt — sisu, mis läheb viraalseks. Hoolitsed varustuse eest nagu oma asja eest. Laed akud, puhastd tahvlid, hoiad kogu ala korras ja puhtana. Järgmine klient peab nägema täiuslikku — mitte seda, mis järele jäi. Õhtul — loojang mere kohal. Saun. Ice bath.Jacuzzi. Klientide tänulikud sõnad.

Omalt poolt pakume: Mida sa saad vastu?
→ Tasuta eFoil-sõit! Klientidele see maksab 200€ tunnis. Sinu jaoks — tasuta. → Töö maailma ühe coolima spordiga päikesetõusu ja -loojangu ajal → Tulemustasu + boonused → Sinu nägu on meie sotsiaalmeedia — ehitame koos brändi → Võimalus meiega kasvada — Euroopa, maailm on järgmised → Oled osa millestki, mida pole varem olnud — uue turu ehitamine

Muud nõuded: Keda me otsime?
→ Sa oled füüsiliselt aktiivne — see töö nõuab ikka jõudu, vastupidavust ja liikumist → Sa oskad hästi ujuda ja tunneksid end vabalt avatud vees → Suhtled inimestega loomulikult — see on su tugevus, mitte kohustus → Räägid eesti keelt + inglise ja boonuseks - vene keelt → Oled vastutustundlik ja rahulik ka siis, kui kõik ei lähe plaanipäraselt Me otsime inimest, kes näeb mis on vaja — ja teeb ära. Kes kliendi naeratuse nimel läheb sammu kaugemale ilma, et keegi paluks. Kes vee peal teeb kiireid otsuseid ise — rahulikult, kindlalt. Kes võtab vastutuse enda peale — mitte ei otsi, kelle peale näidata. Positiivsus ei ole siin soov. See on nõue. Energiat, initsiatiivi ja täielikku pühendumist — iga päev, mitte ainult headel päevadel. Suur boonus (aga mitte kohustuslik): → Kogemus surfimises, kite, wake, SUP või muus veespordis → Oled filminud videoid või tead, kuidas Instagram/TikTok toimib → Oled varem töötanud instruktori, giidi või teenindajana Pole kunagi eFoil'i sõitnud? Pole probleemi. Õpetame sind.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

Koormus, vahetused: 0.5 - 1.0

The successful candidate will be responsible for inspecting, diagnosing, servicing and repairing motor vehicles. Main Responsibilities • Carry out routine and scheduled vehicle servicing and maintenance. • Inspect vehicles and diagnose mechanical, electrical and electronic faults. • Repair or replace engines, transmissions, braking systems, steering systems, suspension systems, exhaust systems and electrical components. • Carry out oil and filter changes, brake checks, coolant system servicing and general maintenance. • Conduct thorough vehicle inspections to identify wear, damage and potential faults. • Carry out auto body repairs, including dent removal, panel repair and panel replacement. • Repair vehicle bodywork following accident damage. • Remove and replace damaged vehicle body parts where necessary. • Ensure all repair and maintenance work is completed in accordance with safety standards and manufacturer specifications. • Refer to technical manuals, service bulletins and diagnostic software when carrying out repairs. • Maintain accurate records of inspections, servicing, repairs and parts used. • Provide updates regarding vehicle condition and repair progress. • Complete all assigned work within the required timeframe. • Follow all workplace health and safety procedures. Essential Requirements • At least three years of relevant experience in motor vehicle maintenance, mechanical repair or auto body repair. • A relevant automotive qualification is required. • Good knowledge of vehicle mechanical, electrical and electronic systems. • Experience using vehicle diagnostic equipment and standard garage tools. • Ability to diagnose faults accurately and carry out repairs independently. • Knowledge of auto body repair methods, including dent removal, panel repair and surface preparation. • Good manual and technical skills. • Commitment to maintaining high safety and quality standards. • Good communication and interpersonal skills. • Proficiency in an Asian language would be considered an advantage. Key Skills • Vehicle diagnostics • Mechanical repair • Auto body repair • Skilled trade experience • Manual and technical ability • Problem-solving • Teamwork • Time management • Health and safety awareness

jobs.title: Researcher in the field of materials for Li-ion Batteries
jobs.description:
About the position

Position as Researcher available at the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology (SMN), University of Oslo.

The position is for a period of 15,7 months.

Preferred starting date 01.01.2026.

Place of work is Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology at Gaustad, Oslo. 


Project description

We are searching for a skilled, creative and ambitious researcher to join our scientific activities within the field of battery materials. The candidate will work in a dynamic team of approximately 10 PhD/MS students and researchers and, therefore, should be skilled to work in team as well as independently.

The successful candidate will be involved in two activities involving synthesis, electrode design and advanced characterization of the materials for Li-ion and Na-ion bat-teries under two projects funded by the Norwegian Research Council.

The candidate will focus on:

  • Synthesis of materials
  • Electrode development
  • Optimization of materials, electrochemical evaluation and operando characterization, including 
    • data acquisition
    • development of electrochemical cells for X-ray based operando tech-niques
    • data treatment   
  •  Experiments using synchrotron facilities are foreseen, depending on access and travel regulations.

The candidate will work closely with all group members, who are involved in similar research activities and should have knowledge and understanding of the electrochemical characterization of battery materials in addition to the advanced knowledge in X-ray based characterization techniques.

The position will be part of the Battery research group within the Nanostructures and Functional Materials (NAFUMA) section. The Battery research group consists of approximately 20 members focused on multiple battery chemistries. The group also performs research on understanding of reaction mechanisms in batteries using operando characterisation.

The NAFUMA section is part of Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology (SMN). Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology is an interdisciplinary centre, a collaboration between four research groups in physics and chemistry, and it spearheads the MN Faculty's efforts for sustainable energy solutions. The Centre embodies UiO’s focus on renewable energy, materials science, and nanotechnology.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe's leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Chemistry, Materials Science or a closely related field. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense will be eligible for the final appointment
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Documented experience within the field of battery materials (Na-ion and Li-ion) – from synthesis of materials to fabrication of batteries
  • Documented experience with X-ray-based characterization (XRD, PDF and X-ray spectroscopy)
  • Knowledge of electrochemical characterization of battery materials
  • Demonstrated experience with using large scale facilities (ESRF, Diamond, etc) for operando characterization

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience in handling large data sets
  • Experience in synchrotron-based measurements in multimodality mode
  • Experience with solid-state NMR for characterization of battery materials

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to conduct high-quality independent research within a broad collaboration
  • Self-motivation, creativity, genuine curiosity about the subject, work discipline, professional ethics, and ambition
  • Good social, communication and collaboration skills and ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary scientific environment
  • Interpersonal communication skills and the ability to work as part of a team
  • We are looking for a candidate who is willing and able to quickly learn and apply new methods and teach the other members of the group

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 600 000 - to 730 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • Separate letter of motivation
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

Please see Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology (SMN) is an interdisciplinary focus field for material and energy research at the University of Oslo. SMN has focused on basic research in renewable energy and environmentally friendly use of fossil energy sources. The center consists of research groups from the Department of Physics and the Department of Chemistry, has about 100 employees from around the world and manages more than 80 projects funded by EU, RCN and others.

jobs.title: Stilling som tilkaldevikar til lille privat integreret daginstitution.
jobs.description:
Vi søger en tilkaldevikar som har lyst til indlevelse og en mulighed for at blive en del af Jellerød Børnegård.

Kan du se dig selv arbejde med både vuggestue- og børnehavebørn og være praktisk blæksprutte, er dette måske stillingen for dig.

Vi søger en udadvendt, nærværende og initiativrig personlig, med et positivt livssyn og en anerkendende tilgang, som har lyst til at være med til at videreudvikle et spændende læringsmiljø for børnene. Jellerød Børnegård er en fuldt aldersintegreret lille privat daginstitution med ca. 54 børn og 14 faste medarbejdere, derudover gør vi brug af faste tilkaldevikarer.

Vi har gode fysiske rammer. Vi har et stort fælles alrum, der rummer mange muligheder for aktiviteter på tværs af huset. Køkkenet, som er i børnehøjde, giver også god mulighed for børnedeltagelse og indsigt i forberedelsen af maden. Al maden tilberedes af vores køkkendame.

  • Vuggestuebørnene er fordelt på to stuer og er i alderen fra 0-3 år. Med fokus på læringsmiljøet, arbejdes her med en fast struktur for store gruppe-børnene, inden børnehavestart.

·       Børnehavebørnene er fordelt på to stuer og er i alderen fra ca. 3-6 år. Med fokus på læringsmiljøet, er stuerne forskelligt indrettet i forhold til legemuligheder. Hverdagens leg og læring tager blandt andet udgangspunkt i vores planlagte temauger og traditioner.

Vi har også en meget stor grøn legeplads og et nærområde, der giver gode muligheder for aktiviteter og ture.

I hverdagen arbejder vi bl.a. med:

  • Inkluderende børnefællesskaber, med fokus på ”børn gør det godt når de kan”.

  • Læring og læringsmiljøer, blandt andet med udgangspunkt i vores planlagte temaer

  • Den didaktiske tankegang i forhold til planlægning af hverdagen

  • At sproget er en integreret del af de daglige aktiviteter og i dialogen med børnene

  • Sproggaven og Dialogisklæsning

  • Fri for Mobberi, som vi supplerer med vores samling om morgenen

  • Førskolegruppen, hvor vi bl.a. arbejder med både Hørsholm Kommunes ”projekt overgange” og Kokkedalsskolen i Fredensborg.

  • Vi er ligeledes på vej i en rejse mod at blive pædagogisk idrætsinstitution.

Vi søger en vikar som:

  • Har lyst til at tage del i huset

  • Er bevidst om sig selv, reflekterende og nysgerrig på at snakke pædagogik

  • Kan lide at lege og være nærværende

  • Kan bidrage til at give omsorg i daglige praksis

  • Kan se såvel den store gruppe børn – som det enkelte barns behov

  • Vægter dialog og samarbejde højt i hverdagen, og har erfaring flair for service og forældresamarbejde.

  • Kan arbejde i tidsrummet fra kl. 7-17, er fleksibel og har lyst til at yde en ekstra indsats, når der er behov for det.

  • Der vil være mulighed for vikartimer i køkkenet, når vores køkkendame har ferie

  • Kan være praktisk, så som oprydning, feje mm.

Har du noget særligt du brænder for at byde ind med, vil vi også rigtig gerne høre om dette.

Hvis du finder ovenstående interessant, så send din ansøgning vedlagt relevante papirer allerede i dag til: pist@jellerod.dk eller Hejo@jellerod.dk . Du er også meget velkommen til at kontakte os og høre mere om stillingen på telefon  93 39 29 80, du skal spørge efter leder Pia Starberg eller souschef Henriette Jøns.

Ansøgningsfrist: Når rette vedkomne er fundet, og vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår: Inden for gældende overenskomst

 GDPR

Jellerød Børnegård er dataansvarlige for de oplysninger, som du sender os i din jobansøgning via email. Se vores datapolitik for yderligere information.

Når du ansøger, accepterer du, at vi registrerer og samler dine personlige oplysninger, som du angiver i forbindelse med din ansøgning. Dette gælder også videopræsentationer, billeder mm.

Vi kan dele din ansøgning med vores medarbejdere, som er involveret i rekrutteringen og tredjeparter, som hjælper os med processen. Dette inkluderer også rekrutteringsfirmaer, som udbyder personlighedstests mm.

Vi opbevarer din ansøgning samt de andre oplysninger, som du har angivet, indtil rekrutteringsprocessen er afsluttet, og i den periode efterfølgende, hvor vi mener, at din ansøgning er relevant for os, men aldrig mere end 6 måneder.

Ved at indsende dine personlige oplysninger accepterer du:

  • at du har læst og forstået ovenstående persondatapolitik

  • at oplysningerne som du har indtastet, er sande og efter din ærlige mening også det mest korrekte. Herunder forstår du også, at hvis ikke oplysningerne stemmer overens, kan det forårsage, at ansøgningen ikke accepteres eller ikke vil tages i betragtning

  • at du giver samtykke af egen fri vilje til, at vi må indsamle og anvende dine oplysninger

jobs.title: 2 Pædagog med interesse for pædagogisk idræt, overgangsarbejde og læreplaner søges til vores lille, hyggelige private daginstitution med hjertet på det rette sted.
jobs.description:
Vil du have et kig ind i idræt, leg og bevægelse? Nu har du chancen for at blive en del af Jellerød Børnegård – en lille privat institution, hvor faglighed og fællesskab vægtes højt.

Vi søger to pædagoger i faste stillinger på 33 timer ugentligt.

Vi søger to pædagoger med hjertet på det rette sted. Vi håber, at du:

  • er motiveret for at arbejde med tilknytning og det lille barn,

  • trives i en organisation, hvor struktur og mange husaftaler allerede er defineret og nyligt evalueret,

  • tør overveje, hvorfor du gør, som du gør, og dermed reflekterer over egen praksis,

  • er åben, professionel, imødekommende og respektfuld i din tilgang til børn, forældre og kolleger,

  • er nysgerrig, lyttende og nærværende i dialog og samvær,

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt med at planlægge, udføre, dokumentere og evaluere din pædagogiske praksis,

  • kan tage ansvar for dagens gang i fællesskab med nærmeste kolleger og vuggestueafdelingen,

  • interesserer dig for at bidrage til et godt arbejdsmiljø og kollegialt fællesskab – det sociale blandt kollegerne er betydningsfuldt for os.

Stillingen er på 33 timer ugentligt. Når du har været hos os lidt, har du mulighed for at blive idrætscertificeret pædagog i pædagogisk idræt via Danmarks Idrætsforbund og VIA University College. Derudover deltager vi i kurser på pædagogiske dage, som vi afholder to gange årligt.

Lidt om os:
Jellerød Børnegård er Kokkedals mindste institution, og vi værner om, at småt er godt. Vi har plads til 24 vuggestuebørn og 32 børnehavebørn fordelt på fire stuer. På stuen vil I være én pædagog og to medhjælpere. De ældste vuggestuebørn fra begge stuer danner et par gange om ugen deres egen store gruppe med en fast pædagogisk medarbejder – dette arbejde vil du også blive en del af. Vi har desuden en køkkenmedarbejder, som sørger for alle børnenes måltider.

Vi arbejder med den nye styrkede læreplan og anvender værktøjerne Hjernen og Hjertet, Sprogtrappen, Sproggaven, dialogisk læsning og Fri for Mobberi. Det er en fordel – men ikke et krav – at du har kendskab til disse.

Efter vores seneste tilsyn arbejder vi målrettet på at vedligeholde vores praksis, da vi tre år i træk har ligget i den høje ende af feltet.

Vi arbejder altid ud fra vores børnesyn: ”Børn gør det godt, når de kan.”
Det betyder, at børn gør det godt, når vi voksne gør det muligt for dem at gøre netop det. Det er derfor de voksnes opgave at få øje på barnets intentioner i dets adfærd. Dette kommer også til udtryk i vores refleksioner over, hvorfor vi gør, som vi gør.

 

Noget af det, der kendetegner os, er:

  • Små fællesskaber Gør, at du ikke skal jonglere med det store fællesskab hele tiden. Samt tryghed og nærhed vægtes højt som skabes i små børnefællesskaber.

  • Større fælleskaber Gør at vi som hus føeler os som en enhed og at børnegruppen for kendskab til hinanden på tværs af alder og køn.

  • Bevægelse og DGI-principper betyder brug kroppen uanset alder-dans-hop-skub-fjol. Men indragelse af børn i hverdagens gøremål er et most.

  • Ture ud af huset Betyder vi bestræber os på at gå tur i lokalområdet 1 g. ugenligt. Udover den årlige bondegårdstur. De største har forøgelsen af Idrættens hus i vinterhalvåret.

  • Vi er empatiske og rækker ud for at favne, hjælpe og støtte hinanden.

  • Vi vægter fleksibilitet vi hjælper på kryds og tværs og løfter i flok, så alle har en aktiv rolle som er vigtigt.

  • Vi har respekt for faglighed, træffer beslutninger i fællesskab, tilegner os ny viden og deler den på tværs af personale- og faggrupper.

  • Nærværende ledelse betyder at du ikke skal booke et møde 3 måneder frem for at få sparring.

Vi ligger tæt på Kokkedal Station og tæt på skov, vand og strand.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte leder Pia Starberg på 60 61 56 45, hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen og Jellerød Børnegård.

Ansøgning og CV med emnet ”Ansøgning” sendes til pist@jellerod.dk.
Indkomne ansøgninger vurderes løbende, og samtaler afholdes løbende.

Ansøgningsfrist: Når den rette kandidat er fundet.
Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt.

Læs mere om os på www.jellerod.dk

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår: Fastsættes efter forhandling inden for gældende overenskomst.

jobs.title: Global Supply Chain Policy & Development Lead
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Director of Global Supply Chain and sitting within DRC's FRISC/Supply Chain unit, this role leads policy & development for supply chain, with a focus on strengthening DRC's ability to develop, innovate, and deliver impactful supply chain outcomes. Operating as a strategic architect, you will design and implement forward-looking supply chain policies, governance, and processes that strengthen DRC's competitive advantage, operational excellence, and sector-wide impact, with a primary technical emphasis on procurement policy and governance, sourcing models, and category strategy development.

Your main duties and responsibilities will be:

  • Drive the organisation-wide procurement and supply chain development agenda, aligned with DRC's strategy, the humanitarian sector reform agenda, and the evolution from legacy to next-generation supply chain capabilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain global supply chain policies, quality standards, and governance frameworks, conducting periodic reviews and driving harmonisation of processes across operations

  • Act as Business Process Expert (BPE) for the Procure-to-Pay (P2Pay) process within DRC Dynamics 365, enabling digitalisation and process simplification across global supply chain systems.

  • Lead the development of organisation-wide category strategies anchored in data, supplier segmentation, and sector best practice, including sourcing models and consolidation opportunities

  • Establish performance frameworks, dashboards, and KPIs that translate supply chain policy, systems, and category strategy into measurable organisational value

  • Build organisational capability through training, coaching, and technical support, sharing evidence and lessons learned to advance sector-wide humanitarian supply chain excellence

  • Develop business cases and secure stakeholder alignment for strategic supply chain investments and system upgrades

  • Support Director of Supply Chain in strategic engagement with public and private sector partners, and initiating scalable pilots in logistics, technology, and financial services

 

About you

To be successful in this role we expect you to combine strong strategic & technical supply chain expertise with the ability to influence and drive change across a decentralised, multi-country organisation, translating policy and strategy into practical, adopted outcomes. Moreover, we also expect the following:

Required

  • 7-10 years' experience within one or more technical supply chain areas, preferably including policy development, strategy development, process optimisation and/or competency development

  • 3-5 years' experience with ERP systems and associated compliance monitoring

  • Demonstrated in-country & or Regional/HQ experience managing supply chain operations in developing country contexts with NGOs and/or the UN

  • Master's or equivalent relevant academic degree

  • Fluent English

Desirable

  • Danish, French, Spanish and/or Arabic language skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365
     

In this position, you are expected to demonstrate DRC’s five core competencies: 

Striving for excellence: You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process. 

Collaborating: You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback. 

Taking the lead: You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation. 

Communicating: You listen and speak effectively and honestly. 

Demonstrating integrity: You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment.

 

We offer

Contract length: Permanent

Work location: Lyngbyvej 100, Copenhagen, Denmark

Start date: 1st September 2026

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with Danish Refugee Council’s agreement with the relevant union. Please refer to our website for more details. For questions regarding the vacancy please contact gaurav.verma@drc.ngo


Application process

All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Closing date for applications: 3rd August 2026

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo.

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

jobs.title: Product Sales Specialist - Pet Health (CST timezone)
jobs.description:
Must Love Dogs!!

At Tribe Wellness, we're more than just a tribe – we're a movement. Rooted in courage, empowerment, and integrity, we've pioneered solutions that transform the world's wellness brands into revenue-generating machines. We bridge the gap between brands and revenue by turning our clients’ customers into lifetime supporters, and we do that by turning good salespeople into great salespeople.

At Tribe Wellness Sales, we’re on a mission to help pets live longer, healthier lives through supplements that actually deliver. But here’s the catch: too many pet owners grab a product online and then flounder—unsure how to use it or missing the guidance to make it work. That’s where you, our Product Sales Specialist (called a Protocol Review Specialist in our world), make the difference. Without you, pets miss out on better health, owners lose confidence, and our mission stalls. With you? You’re the spark that turns a purchase into a transformation—for pets and their people.


What You'll Do:

  • Sell: You’ll sell products and services for our pet client, a company built for pet owners, by pet owners, with over a million happy dogs and growing!

  • Grow: Work with a broad range of potential customers, transforming clients’ prospects into brand loyalists.

  • Learn: Work closely with our dedicated leaders, leveraging our top-notch training resources to master the art of selling and representing Tribe's ethos.

  • Earn: Operate with no cap on commission, providing limitless earning potential to integrate with our operations seamlessly.

  • Live: Work from home in a global remote environment, utilizing our communication tools and platforms.

 

What's In It For You:

  • Earnings: This is a commission-only role. You will have between 8 and 18 appointments scheduled for you each day (more if you want them and you are closing sales). You will earn a 20% commission on the gross margin of every sale you make. Please tell us how much you want to earn, and we will show you what it takes to get there. Each sale is between $250 and $2,500.

  • The Tribe Tool Kit: We have a battle-tested tool kit we provide for all our sales consultants, including Rippling and Salesforce, ensuring you're primed for success the second you hit the phones.

  • Remote Work: You’ll have the freedom of a fully remote position, allowing for a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.

  • Be Part of the Tribe: No matter your title, you’ll join a community that values partnership, advocacy, and growth. We believe in nurturing our team members and fostering an environment of collaboration, support, and mutual success.

 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Highly-driven self starters, who are motivated by growth opportunities and the drive to excel in sales.

  • Knowledge, background, or raw passion around health and wellness.

  • Excellent verbal and written skills, with top-notch communication skills and a knack for building genuine connections.

  • The ability to work 40 hours per week (8 hours per day) starting at 8 AM CST.

  • Reliable internet and equipment are required. Because this position involves frequent phone and video calls, you’ll need a setup that can support clear, uninterrupted conversations.

    This means you should have:

    • A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with a working mic, camera, and a headset, so you can comfortably run our call system, Salesforce, and Zoom at the same time.

    • Ethernet connection strongly preferred because it provides the most consistent call quality. (Usually requires only an inexpensive cable you plug into your desktop/laptop and modem.)

    • Enough dedicated internet speed to support calls and video without freezing, delays, or dropped audio. Minimum [10] Mbps download / [5] Mbps upload of dedicated bandwidth, with latency under ~150ms, jitter under ~30ms, and packet loss under ~1%.

Join us if you’re ready to play a pivotal role in reshaping the world of pet health and wellness while thriving in a growth-centric global environment with amazing people. If that sounds like you, Tribe Wellness is your tribe. Apply today and work with a very different type of company.

jobs.title: Product Quality & Configuration Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a driven Product Quality & Compliance Engineer to lead product quality, digital traceability and defence compliance across our R&D, production, and supplier ecosystem.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product development, quality, and compliance. Your focus will be on owning and embedding digital traceability across our R&D and production processes, ensuring quality, consistency, and transparency throughout the product lifecycle, while maintaining and continually improving our ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System (QMS).

You will be Quadsat’s core quality and compliance ambassador both internally and externally, working across R&D, Production, Supply Chain, Commercial, and with our customers to ensure our products meet the highest standards without compromising the agility and innovation that define Quadsat.

A key part of the role will be to build and own the practical configuration management and digital traceability system that connects engineering work, product releases, BOMs, SBOMs, verification evidence, production builds, defects, and delivered product configurations.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving quality and compliance across our engineering and production ecosystem. On a day-to-day basis you can expect to:

  • Drive and govern product quality assurance from early concept and design stage through to verification, production, release and lifecycle support.

  • Build, own, and continuously improve Quadsat’s configuration management and digital traceability setup across tools such as Jira, Confluence, PDM, and production records, ensuring that product baselines, releases, BOMs, SBOMs, defects, deviations, and delivered product configurations are controlled and actively used.

  • Own the engineering governance and digital traceability framework in our Jira environment, including workflow and issue structures, traceability, dashboards, release planning and other related processes.

  • Support the R&D Director in managing development activities through Jira, ensuring that processes and requirements are effectively planned, tracked, and integrated into development and release workflows.

  • Coordinate development cycle reviews, compliance reporting, and engineering metrics using Jira data and provide insights to the R&D Director, developers and other stakeholders to enable informed quality-driven decision-making.

  • Coordinate internal and external product testing activities required to demonstrate product performance, quality, and compliance.

  • Lead compliance initiatives to prepare Quadsat's products and engineering processes for future qualification against defence and customer-specific standards, including frameworks such as MIL-STD, STANAG, AQAP, and DO-178, as required by our customers.

  • Maintain and continuously improve Quadsat's ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring effective governance, process maturity, and a culture of continuous improvement.

Skills & Experience

  • Educational background in engineering or technical field.

  • Proven experience working in a quality or compliance role, translating technical standards and compliance requirements into actionable engineering processes and development activities.

  • Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Solid understanding of risk management, DFMEA, requirements management, verification, validation, and test coverage methodologies.

  • You are a Jira super user with hands-on experience setting up and maintaining practical engineering governance, configuration management, release management, defect tracking, traceability, and compliance workflows in Jira or similar systems.

  • A pragmatic mindset that balances agility, engineering effectiveness, and defense-grade quality expectations.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

All candidates must be eligible to obtain security clearance with the Danish Defence and NATO authorities.

Our Dynamic Work Environment

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, pragmatic engineering, and people who want their work to have a lasting impact beyond individual projects.

About Quadsat

Quadsat develops and builds long-range electronic warfare payloads and software that support multi-domain military operations through fast and precise radio frequency detection and geolocation across the electromagnetic spectrum. Our technology enables defense organizations to maintain mission-critical connectivity, ensure resilient communication infrastructures, and achieve operational readiness.

Contact

For recruitment related questions please contact Aislinn Campbell, HR Director, by mail at afc@quadsat.com or by phone at +45 71 74 97 81.

jobs.title: Job i Portugal - Teknisk supporter for Audi - Opstart den 20. august - Med firmabolig - Ingen erfaring nødvending.
jobs.description:
Dansktalende Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi.

Opstart den 20. august - Med firmabolig. Vi mangler to medarbejdere, så du kan starte alene eller sammen med en af dine venner.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger tekniske supportere til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som Kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

jobs.title: Job i udlandet -Tag dit sabbatår i udlandet – få job, oplevelser og gratis professionel rådgivning af Cathrine.
jobs.description:
Tag dit sabbatår i udlandet – få job, oplevelser og professionel rådgivning så du kommer trygt afsted.

Jeg hedder Cathrine, og jeg arbejder hos JobHuntWorldwide. Jeg kender følelsen af at stå med lysten til at tage af sted, men ikke helt vide, hvordan man gør det. Det er præcis derfor, jeg er her, til at gøre processen nem og tryg for dig.

Drømmer du om at bruge dit sabbatår på noget helt andet end hverdagen i Danmark? Jeg hjælper unge danskere med at finde arbejde i udlandet – både hvis du vil udvikle dig fagligt, møde nye mennesker eller bare prøve noget helt nyt for en periode.

Vi samarbejder med virksomheder i bl.a. Spanien, Grækenland, Portugal, Malta, Cypern, Vietnam og Filippinerne, og mange stillinger kræver ingen tidligere erfaring.

Hvad kan du forvente?

✔ Gratis og uforpligtende karrieresamtale

Vi starter altid med en personlig snak om dine ønsker for dit sabbatår. Vil du opkvalificeres? Vil du have et socialt fællesskab? Eller vil du bare prøve noget helt nyt? Jeg hjælper dig med at finde den løsning, der passer til dig.

✔ Hjælp til at finde det rette job

Dine muligheder afhænger af, hvornår du vil afsted, og hvor længe du kan være væk. Mange virksomheder ansætter uden erfaring, mens andre har specifikke krav – det gennemgår vi sammen.

Du skal som udgangspunkt kunne sige ja til 4–6 måneder, og du får naturligvis betalt ferie, så du kan rejse hjem undervejs.

✔ Professionel forberedelse til jobinterview

Når vi har fundet et match, præsenterer jeg dig for virksomheden og klæder dig på til interviewet. Du får:

  • Feedback på dit CV

  • Råd om spørgsmål du bør stille

  • Forventningsafstemning om bolig, løn, kontrakt og praktiske forhold

Jeg følger dig hele vejen frem til din første arbejdsdag.

Hvilke typer job kan du få?

Der er mange muligheder – alt efter dine ønsker og kompetencer. Eksempler:

  • Kundeservice og teknisk support

  • Rejsebranchen og booking

  • Telemarketing og mødebooking

  • Reception og administration

  • Fundraising

  • Online kundekommunikation

  • Online gaming Presenter

  • Specialiserede roller (fx gaming support, ansvarlig spilrådgivning, medicinsk assistance)

Nogle stillinger inkluderer betalt fly, hotel eller firmabolig, afhængigt af landet og virksomheden.

Vigtige råd, før du siger ja.

Jeg hjælper dig med at træffe den rigtige beslutning ved at gennemgå bl.a.:

  • Arbejdsforhold og kontrakt

  • Boligmuligheder og økonomi

  • Løn, udbetaling og ferie

  • Oplæring og forventninger

  • Stabilitet i projektet

  • Hvad du ønsker at få ud af dit ophold

Det er vigtigt, at du vælger et job, der passer til dine mål – ikke bare det første og bedste.

Sådan kommer du i gang.

Du kan booke en gratis og uforpligtende karrieresnak med mig, hvor vi gennemgår dine muligheder og hjælper dig med at finde det rette match.

jobs.description:
Er du gået i stå i din karriere i Danmark, måske er det tid til at du tager på det senere sabbatår i udlandet?

Vi hjælper danskere med at tage til udlandet for at finde ro, livskvalitet og en anderledes hverdag.

En af vores kandidater på 64 år, med 30 års ledererfaring havde altid drømt om at arbejde i Grækenland. Han troede, det var for sent – men fra i år sidder han i kundeservice med udsigt til Middelhavet og lever sin drøm. Hans historie viser, at det aldrig er for sent at tage springet, og at erfaring og livserfaring er en styrke, som virksomheder i Sydeuropa værdsætter højt.

Hvorfor vælge udlandet som din nye start?
Du får mulighed for at opleve en ny kultur, et mildere klima og en anderledes livsstil. Du kan bruge dine eksisterende kompetencer i kundeservice, rejsebranchen eller hospitality – eller prøve noget helt nyt. Mange virksomheder tilbyder oplæring, betalt ferie og interne udviklingsprogrammer, så du kan vokse i jobbet.

Praktiske overvejelser:
Du skal have en mindre opsparing med, da du ofte først får fuld løn efter en måned. Der kan være udgifter til depositum og husleje, som skal betales ved ankomst. Vi hjælper dig med at afklare kontraktforhold, boligmuligheder, sundhedsforsikring og opsigelsesvilkår. Det er vigtigt at tale med en professionel karrierecoach, så du får den rette sparring og undgår dyre fejl.

Derfor er vi med dig hele vejen:
Vi afdækker dine kompetencer og ønsker. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til din profil. Vi forbereder dig til interviewet og sikrer, at du stiller de rigtige spørgsmål. Vi støtter dig frem til din første arbejdsdag – og videre, hvis du ønsker at udvikle dig i virksomheden.

jobs.title: Center for Engineering and Science ved Absalon søger en adjunkt eller lektor eller timelærere
jobs.description:
Føler du dig hjemme i grænselandet mellem robotteknologi, automation, maskinteknologi og Industri 4.0? Hvis ja skal du læse videre.

Er du drevet af at formidle og videregive din faglighed og erfaring?

Brænder du for at udvikle en ny uddannelse i tæt samarbejde med dygtige og engagerede kolleger, studerende og lokale virksomheder? Så kan det være dig, vi står og mangler til vores studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved efter- og videreuddannelsen i Automation og Drift.

Absalon etablerer september 2027 ny diplomingeniøruddannelse i Robotteknologi og automation. Diplomingeniøruddannelse i Robotteknologi og automation vil indgå i en tæt sammenhæng med diplomingeniøruddannelsen i Maskinteknologi og efter- og videreuddannelsen på akademiniveau i Automation og drift.

På ingeniøruddannelserne er det vores ambition at uddanne de bedste ingeniører i Danmark. Vi målretter vores uddannelse til arbejdsmarkedet ved at samarbejde tæt med den danske maskin-, automations- og procesindustri samt virksomheder og andre aktører i Biotekbyen Kalundborg og i Campus Kalundborgsamarbejdet, der bl.a. rykker ind i et nyt campusbyggeri i september 2028. Læs meget mere her. https://www.biotekbyen.dk/

Din profil
Vi søger en underviser, der brænder for at uddanne inden for grænseområdet mellem robotteknologi, automation, maskinteknologi og Industri 4.0. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i nedenstående:

Du er en dygtig og motiverende underviser, der er engageret i de studerende. Du bidrager sammen med dine kolleger til at skabe et aktivt, fagligt og socialt studiemiljø. Og det er vigtigt, at du kan bidrage positivt til den nære faglige relation, vi har mellem undervisere og studerende.

Du medvirker til at få det faglige, det praktiske og samarbejdet til at fungere godt. Vi er mere end en arbejdsplads, og vi drives af et stærkt kammeratskab og en fælles faglig interesse.

Du har lyst til at indgå i et arbejdsfællesskab og være med til at etablere en ny uddannelse. Vi opbygger og udvikler løbende vores ingeniøruddannelse, og meget skal gøres for første gang. Med den rette profil får du en central rolle i beskrivelsen og opbygningen af ny uddannelse med fokus på robotteknologi og automation Bl.a. skal vi i gang med at indrette og skaffe det rette udstyr til kommende robot- og automationslaboratorier.

Hvis du har indsigt i industriens behov for ingeniørkompetencer inden for robot og automationsområdet, vil det være en fordel.

Du har desuden nemt ved at indgå i dialog med virksomheder, både i forhold til muligheder for efter- og videreuddannelse og hvad angår samarbejde med studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne

Din ingeniørfaglighed kommer i spil i undervisningen, vejledningen og sparringen med kolleger inden for dele af følgende områder:
  • Integration og programmering af industrirobotter, f.eks. Universal robots, ABB, KUKA, FANUC
  • Siemens TIA-portal
  • Industrielle netværk
  • Vision-systemer og sensorteknologi
  • Safety-systemer og CE-mærkning
  • Integration af AI i robot- og automationsløsninger
  • PLC-, HMI- og SCADA-løsninger
  • CAD og 3D print
  • Teknisk dokumentation inden for maskin- og el-området.

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har en baggrund som ingeniør og er gerne lektorbedømt
  • har relevant erhvervserfaring inden for ingeniørfaget
  • kan undervise på dansk og også gerne på engelsk.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som underviser på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved Automation og Drift har du en række forskellige opgaver i løbet af en arbejdsuge.

Undervise og projektvejlede de studerende. Du skal primært undervise og vejlede de studerende teoretisk og værksteds- og projektbaseret inden for dine fagområder. Du skal selv tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisningen og samtidig være med til løbende at udvikle undervisningen.

Undervise på efter- og videreuddannelse (EVU) og på grunduddannelse. Du skal undervise studerende på fuldtidsstudium såvel som kursister med et fuldtidsarbejde ved siden af deres uddannelse på EVU. Til undervisningen på EVU kan også knytte sig opgaver med opsøgende kontakt til virksomheder og præsentation af uddannelsesudbud.

Fagligt samarbejde som en del af hverdagen. Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du sparrer og samarbejder med dine kolleger. Sammen sørger I f.eks. for at tilrettelægge gode undervisningsforløb, udvikle undervisningsmaterialer, og måske er der et arrangement tilknyttet centret, som skal stables på benene.

Har du erfaring med og interesse i enkelte administrative opgaver vil det være en fordel. Ligesom det vil være en fordel, hvis du har interesse i at spille en central rolle i etablering af ny uddannelse inden for robotteknologi.

Undervisningen på de forskellige uddannelsesudbud vil fortrinsvis være på vores Campus Kalundborg, men på EVU-området kan der forekomme undervisning på Absalons campus i Roskilde. Du skal være forberedt på, at noget undervisning kan foregå i weekend eller på aftener.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver ansat i Centre for Engineering and Science, som driver uddannelserne Bioanalytiker, Radiograf, Diplomingeniør i bioteknologi, Diplomingeniør i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelserne Diplomuddannelse i bioteknologi, Procesteknologi og kemi, Akademiuddannelse i Automation og Drift, samt Akademiuddannelse i Innovation, produkt og produktion.

Du bliver en del af et team med uddannelsesledere, adjunkter og lektorer. På vores uddannelser i Kalundborg er vi 20 ansatte undervisere, og ved Diplomingeniør i Maskinteknologi er vi fem lektorer og en adjunkt fast tilknyttet. Vi arbejder på at skabe den bedste ingeniøruddannelse i tæt samarbejde med biotekindustrien i Nordvestsjælland samt vores engagerede studerende. Vi værdsætter høj faglighed og løser opgaver samt udfordringer i fællesskab, hvor vi alle er bevidste om vigtigheden af at bidrage til fællesskabet og til centrets samlede målsætning.

Vi holder til i nybygget campusbygning fra 2021 og i nabobygningen Helix Lab. Fra 2028 vil vi være en del af nyt Campus Kalundborg-byggeri.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 41.232, - kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.537, - kr. inkl. pension. Der er mulighed for at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse pr. 1. oktober 2026, meget gerne før
  • Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Jesper Stensbo Knudsen, jesk@pha.dk, 7248 3224
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 14. august 2026
  • Vi forventer at afholde samtaler løbende, dog senest i uge 34 og 35.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

For stillingen gælder det, at du ansættes som adjunkt eller lektor alt efter dine kvalifikationer.

På Absalon er adjunkturet en 3-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og hvor alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Head of Client Excellence (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Job description

Head of Client Excellence

We are looking for an experienced Head of Client Excellence to join a RegTech company providing SaaS solutions to the financial services industry. The company supports leading asset managers, management companies, depositaries, fund administrators, and other financial institutions in managing their oversight and controls, optimizing business processes, strengthening data governance, and automating operational workflows.
Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, this is a senior, strategic, and hands-on position combining business development, sales, client excellence, operational transformation, and consulting. The successful candidate will lead strategic initiatives aimed at improving revenue
generation, service delivery, strengthening client relationships, and driving operational excellence while contributing to the company's commercial growth.

Core Expectations

• Build trusted relationships with clients while identifying opportunities to expand existing accounts and develop new business.
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of the financial services industry, particularly the asset management ecosystem and its operational challenges.
• Combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and a strong sense of ownership.
• Provide strategic leadership across client excellence and professional services initiatives.
• Drive organizational improvements through process optimization, governance, and cross functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Development & Commercial Growth

• Actively prospecting new organizations and initiating conversations with potential clients.
• Building and managing a strong commercial pipeline through structured prospecting, relationship development, and disciplined follow-up.
• Owning the full sales cycle, from initial engagement and solution presentation through negotiation and closing.
• Developing compelling business cases and demonstrating value to senior business and technical stakeholders.
• Setting and achieving ambitious business development targets linked to revenue growth and market expansion.
• Monitoring market trends, competitor positioning, and evolving clients needs to identify new opportunities.
• Supporting account expansion strategies, including upselling, cross-selling, and partner-led opportunities where relevant.
• Identify and develop new business opportunities within the financial services industry.

Strategic Leadership & Operational Excellence

• Drive process optimization initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and service quality.
• Implement practical governance and reporting frameworks to support operational performance and decision-making.
• Develop KPIs and performance metrics to monitor delivery, resource utilization, and client outcomes.
• Promote a culture of continuous improvement through structured feedback and best practice sharing.

Consultancy & Client Excellence

• Lead strategic initiatives to continuously improve client experience and professional services delivery.
• Act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders, supporting organizational transformation and change management initiatives.
• Develop scalable operating models, delivery standards, and best practices to enhance consistency and efficiency.
• Foster collaboration across Professional Services, Product, Commercial, and Technology teams to ensure seamless client delivery.
• Monitor delivery performance and recommend improvements to maximize client satisfaction and operational effectiveness.

Contracts, licensing, pricing and commercial models

• High familiarity and experience with making commercial proposals to customers.
• Have contracts and contract management in the fingers.
• Be able to seamlessly apply and guard licensing, pricing and contracting practices of the company.
• Can create new commercial models if and when needed.

Profile

Professional Qualifications

• Master's degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Management, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in consulting, professional services, business transformation, client success, or strategic leadership roles.
• Experience in process optimization, organizational improvement, and operational excellence.
• Good knowledge of the financial services industry, particularly asset management, including its operating models, regulatory environment, and key market participants.
• Experience working with SaaS, RegTech, FinTech, or technology-enabled services is highly desirable.
• Commercial mindset with experience developing client relationships and contributing to business growth.
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence) is an advantage.
• Excellent communication skills in English; French or any additional language is considered an asset.

Personal Characteristics

• Strategic, hands-on, and results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
• Excellent relationship builder, able to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
• Client-focused with a consultative mindset and a passion for delivering value.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate ideas into practical solutions.
• Highly communicative, team player with other functions such as Product and Finance, and dares to challenge customers by protecting the interest of the company when needed.
• High level of integrity, accountability, and collaborative spirit.

jobs.description:
HRVATSKI DUHANI dd dio su grupe British American Tobacco, jedne od vodećih svjetskih multinacionalnih kompanija u području duhanske industrije. Zahvaljujući našim zaposlenicima nastavili smo rasti, stoga tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za rad na poziciji: Tehničar/ka na pakiranju – Električar/ka Mehaničar/ka Glavne odgovornosti i zadaci:

  • Upravljanje hidrauličnom prešom gotovog proizvoda - Automatski/Ručni mod
  • Popravak i remont linija obrade duhana, linija sjetve i otkupa duhana
  • Rad na čišćenju u II smjeni, po potrebi otklanjanje manjih kvarova

  • Svakodnevno kontroliranje ispravnosti vezačica izlaznih proizvoda (SIGNODE), kao i zamjena povezne trake nakon potrošene
  • Rastavljanje strojeva u slučaju potrebe, popravak i zamjena neispravnih komponenti strojeva
  • Izvršava preventivne i interventne radove održavanja električnih i mehaničkih instalacija, sustava automatske kontrole i električnih motora
  • Prati rad, funkcionalnost i stanje električne i mehaničke opreme na tvorničkoj razini
  • Održavanje, popravci i zamjena električnih i mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svog djelokruga.
  • Radi na remontu pogona obrade duhana (GLT), linija otkupa duhana i linija sjetve duhana
  • Redovno provjerava radno stanje opreme, radi tehnička podešavanja, obavještava Voditelja održavanja o uočenim problemima

  • Iskustvo u razumijevanju tehničke dokumentacije
  • Položen ATK ispit stručni ATK ispit strojara kotlovskog postrojenja i pripreme vode

  • Može raditi pod pritiskom i učinkovito upravljati vremenom
  • Izvrsna sposobnost vođenja evidencije
  • Komunikacijske vještine
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Sposobnost da se sam motivira i motivira druge
  • Sposobnost postavljanja prioriteta

  • Okruženje koje pokreće: podršku od strane kolega i voditelja, kontinuirani razvoj kroz stručno usavršavanje, obilježavanje događaja gdje slavimo uspjeh i izražavamo zahvalnost prema našim zaposlenicima.

jobs.title: Risk Manager Power & Gas (m/w/d) Trading (Risk-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Die team Gruppe kümmert sich mit rund 5.000 Mitarbeitenden um die Grundbedürfnisse aller Menschen: Ob es um die Ernährung, die Gestaltung von Wohn- und Lebensräumen oder um Energie für den Alltag geht. Als wichtiger Teil dieser Gruppe bietet die team SE mit ihren rund 350 engagierten Mitarbeitenden zentrale Dienstleistungen, die diese Mission in allen Geschäftsbereichen der team Gruppe vorantreiben.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du eine zentrale Verantwortung für die Risikosteuerung im Energiehandel. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Power‑ und Gas‑Portfolios über Ländergrenzen hinweg transparent, kontrolliert und im Einklang mit der konzernweit definierten Risikobereitschaft gesteuert werden.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Überwachung von Commodity-, Markt-, Kredit- und operationellen Risiken für Strom, Gas und Zertifikate (GO’s, VERs, Biomethan, EUA2) sowie tägliche Steuerung der Clearing‑Konten
- Entwicklung und Pflege von Exposure‑Reports & Dashboards für eine transparente und granulare Risikoübersicht in Echtzeit
- Durchführung von Stresstests, Szenarioanalysen und Backtesting zur Bewertung potenzieller Verluste und Treasury‑Auswirkungen
- Modellierung und Controlling von Risikoparametern (Spot, Ausgleichsenergie, Hedging, Volatilität, Margin)
- Validität Price-Forward-Curve
- Entwicklung von Modellen und Prozessen zur besseren Risikokontrolle
- Sicherstellung regulatorischer Compliance (z.B. REMIT, MiFIR, MiFID, usw.) sowie Governance über Limits, Handelskontrollen und Eskalationsprotokolle
- Bewertung von risikoadjustierter Performance (VaR, Margin‑at‑Risk, P&L‑Attribution)

Dein Profil:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium in Finance, Wirtschaft, Mathematik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Risikomanagement von Energiehandel (Power & Gas)
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in VaR, Margin-at-Risk, Stresstests, Backtesting
- Sicherer Umgang mit Risikomanagement-Software und Datenanalyse-Tools
- Analytische Fähigkeiten, Detailgenauigkeit und starke Entscheidungsstärke
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch sowie Teamfähigkeit
- Du bringst Kenntnisse in Datenmodellierung und Systemintegration mit
-
Starte zum nächstmöglichen Termin in eine spannende und unbefristete Vollzeitstelle in Hamburg oder Fredericia und werde Teil der dynamischen Welt des Power & Gas Tradings – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!
